papers.title: Architecting Fairness-Aware LLM Interactions
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as decision-support tools but may generate stereotypical, discriminatory, or unfair responses. As LLMs become embedded in decision-critical software systems, fairness can no longer be treated as a downstream evaluation step, but must become an architectural concern of the interaction itself. Yet current fairness approaches operate as standalone evaluation techniques, lacking a reusable mechanism to verify and mitigate violations at runtime. We propose a fairness-assurance architecture grounded in three reusable design patterns, instantiated as a multi-agent framework that evaluates and iteratively refines LLM responses before delivery. A preliminary evaluation across eight configurations involving different LLM families shows that the architecture identifies fairness violations and iteratively produces compliant responses in all configurations, with behavior differing depending on the model-family composition. These results provide initial evidence for the joint instantiation of the proposed patterns and a first step toward architecting non-functional properties into LLM-based systems.

papers.title: The Long Con on the Web: Earn-then-Exploit Fraud Attacks against Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents increasingly operate with web access and high privileges, creating a new attack surface where web fraud can directly target autonomous agents. Existing studies mainly focus on malicious links, prompt injection, and interface deception, while content-level web fraud against agents and the amplification of attacks through agent trust remain underexplored. In this paper, we present EtE (Earn-then-Exploit), a web fraud attack framework against coding agents, in which a malicious website first provides multiple rounds of genuinely verifiable assistance to establish trust and then introduces task-related instructions that cross intended operational boundaries. To systematically evaluate its effectiveness, we construct 56 organizational environments (8 task contexts x 7 attack consequences) and evaluate three representative coding agents. EtE achieves an average scene-level attack success rate of 71.4%, including 85.7% on Codex-GPT-5.5, 67.9% on ZCode-GLM-5.3-Flash, and 60.7% on QwenCode-Qwen3.7-Plus, significantly outperforming all injection-based baselines. More importantly, our experiments reveal that coding agents exhibit trust-like behavioral reliance on previously helpful Web sources, and that such accumulated credibility significantly increases their susceptibility to subsequent malicious instructions. Based on this finding, we propose action-authorization separation (AAS), which prevents web content from directly authorizing privileged actions and reduces the attack success rate to 0% while preserving 100% task completion, outperforming all evaluated defense baselines.

papers.title: Constructing Budgeted KGW Evasion through Token-Event Evidence Replacement
papers.abstract: KGW watermarks bias sampling to accumulate keyed detection evidence. We construct budgeted evasion through token-event evidence replacement using ordinary phrase rewrites. Our construction jointly selects compositions of LLM-proposed alternatives from an independent model and measures global token-edit distance on complete outputs. At the largest attainable cost within the budget, exact coverage search maximizes removal of original scored token pairs. It uses a known tokenizer without the key, detector feedback or queries to the watermarked model. Exact accounting separates source evidence removed, evidence created and length effects, with initial strength setting the required reduction. Separate signed-event analysis found that mean suppression arose mainly from removing watermark-enriched source events. In controlled, occurrence-counted, one-token-context KGW tests on short passages, 39 of 82 qualified, initially detected sources yielded rewrites with terminal detector score Z < 4 that passed blinded source-relative model review, at a mean actual token-edit cost of 16.0% under a 20% allowance. To examine whether this initial requirement can be inferred, a separate historical 95-passage study estimated initial detector score Z0 from generation traces with correlation 0.793 and an in-sample association beyond length. This aggregate information did not establish improved allocation, and the separate no-trace stopping test did not reliably exploit cheaper reviewed crossings in the candidate bank. Comparisons did not establish an advantage over simpler selection and ordinary constrained rewriting. The construction makes budgeted evidence replacement executable while exposing limits in signed reduction and recognition of sufficient editing.

papers.title: AgentCap: Capability-Based Runtime Authorization for Secure LLM Agent Execution
papers.abstract: Language-model agents commonly collapse two decisions that security systems separate: selecting an action and determining whether that action is authorized. When a model exercises standing authority, indirect prompt injection can convert influence over its reasoning into unauthorized effects. We present AgentCap, a runtime authorization layer that externalizes this decision from the model and mediates every tool invocation through an MCP wrapper. Each request declares an intent, and AgentCap evaluates policy constraints over trust, workflow prerequisites, mutually exclusive authority, and the provenance of security-sensitive arguments. Authorized requests receive short-lived, budget-bounded capability tokens that are validated at the tool boundary. Delegation is restricted to session-bound parent-child chains that preserve action and resource while budget and lifetime can only be attenuated, preventing authority from being expanded or reused across unrelated agent sessions. A declarative policy language provides a common representation for runtime enforcement and predeployment analysis. Across AgentDojo and InjecAgent, AgentCap reduces attack success in every evaluated model-benchmark setting, including zero attack success with GPT-5.4 on both benchmarks. Controlled adversarial scenarios further show that AgentCap blocks every attempted unauthorized execution (ASR 0%) while preserving all legitimate operations exercised. These results demonstrate that agent security requires authorization of model-proposed effects at the tool boundary, independently of the model's reasoning.

papers.title: Can Jev Improve Demonstration Retrieval for In-Context Learning?
papers.abstract: Demonstration selection plays a crucial role in the effectiveness of in-context learning (ICL) for large language models (LLMs). Extensive research has explored various retrieval strategies to identify informative demonstrations and improve downstream performance. Recently, the emergence of Jev, a decision-oriented language model capable of producing probabilistic judgments, offers a new perspective on evaluating demonstration utility. This motivates us to investigate a fundamental question: Can Jev improve demonstration retrieval for in-context learning? In this paper, we demonstrate that Jev can effectively enhance demonstration retrieval by directly assessing the utility of candidate demonstrations for a given query. However, applying Jev to large-scale retrieval introduces substantial computational overhead, as each candidate requires an additional decision-making inference. To address this limitation, we propose a simple yet effective knowledge distillation approach that transfers Jev's utility estimation capability to a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP). By learning to approximate Jev's probabilistic judgments, the distilled model enables efficient demonstration ranking while maintaining competitive retrieval performance. Our study highlights the potential of decision-oriented language models for demonstration selection and provides an efficient framework for integrating their decision-making capabilities into ICL.

translation.title: Jev 能否改进上下文学习的示例检索？
translation.abstract: 示例选择对大语言模型（LLM）上下文学习（ICL）的有效性起着关键作用。大量研究探索了各种检索策略来识别信息丰富的示例并提升下游性能。最近，Jev 的出现——一种能够产生概率性判断的面向决策的语言模型——为评估示例效用提供了新视角。这促使我们研究一个基本问题：Jev 能否改进上下文学习的示例检索？本文证明，Jev 可以通过直接评估候选示例对给定查询的效用，有效增强示例检索。然而，将 Jev 应用于大规模检索会带来显著的计算开销，因为每个候选都需要额外的一次决策推理。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种简单而有效的知识蒸馏方法，将 Jev 的效用估计能力迁移到轻量级多层感知机（MLP）上。通过学习逼近 Jev 的概率判断，蒸馏后的模型能够高效地进行示例排序，同时保持有竞争力的检索性能。我们的研究凸显了面向决策的语言模型在示例选择上的潜力，并提供了一个将其决策能力融入 ICL 的高效框架。
translation.brief: 针对示例检索中评估示例效用计算开销大的问题，提出用知识蒸馏将决策模型 Jev 的效用判断能力迁移到轻量级 MLP 上以实现高效检索。

papers.title: Reading Between the Chapters: A Graph-Free RAG Rebuilt With AI and Human Feedback
papers.abstract: Many questions about a book can only be answered by connecting passages chapters apart, such as a cough heard three times across a horse's life. We introduce CrossChapterQA, 1,853 such questions over 14 public-domain books. Each question lists the two to six chapters it needs (spanning half the book at the median) and the relation linking them, cites evidence from each, and has two independent reference answers graded blind. We use it to build LadderRAG, which indexes a book as passages, summaries and book-level cards for about $0.41 and answers a question for under a cent. Its first version failed mostly at retrieval. We redesigned it four times, steered by an LLM judge's verdicts and our analyses of failed answers: a design-level counterpart of RLAIF and RLHF in which feedback changes the architecture, not model weights. We also report the two redesigns that made answers worse. On the 191 questions its first version got wrong, the final version retrieves over twice as many required chapters on held-out books (recall 0.36 to 0.79), and ten annotators rate its answers 6.5/10 on average (764 ratings).

translation.title: 章节之间读出答案：用 AI 与人类反馈重建的无图 RAG
translation.abstract: 关于一本书的许多问题只有通过连接相隔数章的段落才能回答，例如一匹马一生中三次被听到的咳嗽声。我们提出 CrossChapterQA，包含针对 14 本公有领域书籍的 1,853 个此类问题。每个问题列出所需的二至六章（中位数跨越半本书）及其关联关系，引用每章的证据，并有两个经盲评的独立参考答案。我们用它构建了 LadderRAG，它将一本书索引为段落、摘要和书级卡片，索引成本约 0.41 美元，回答一个问题不到一美分。其第一版主要在检索上失败。我们依据 LLM 评审的判定和我们自己对失败答案的分析，对其进行了四次重新设计：这是 RLAIF 和 RLHF 在设计层面的对应物——反馈改变的是架构而非模型权重。我们也报告了两次使答案变差的重新设计。在其第一版答错的 191 个问题上，最终版本在留出书籍上检索到的所需章节数翻了一倍多（召回率从 0.36 提升到 0.79），十名标注者对其答案的平均评分为 6.5/10（共 764 次评分）。
translation.brief: 针对跨章节长程问答中检索失败的问题，构建 CrossChapterQA 基准并基于 LLM 评审与人工分析迭代重构无图 RAG 架构 LadderRAG。

papers.title: Old Is Not False: Valid-Time Memory for Interactive Video World Models
papers.abstract: Interactive video world models draw each frame from a memory bank of earlier frames stamped with their capture times. With frames, weights and noise fixed, reversing the timestamps of two views flips the state that generators of two families draw: they take the newest timestamp as the truth. That reading is right as long as states never return. After an agent undoes an action, the newest view of a region is outdated and the only view of the present is older; memories for changing worlds delete that older view, and memories that keep it hand the generator the past. Temporal databases separate when a record is stored from when its content holds, its valid time. ReDate keeps every frame and dates each retrieved token by its valid time, read from the agent's action log. The frozen generator then reads a reverted region as one that has just reached a new state, so ReDate needs no training. We prove that trusting the newest timestamp is right exactly when every current view is dated after every outdated one, that without a view taken after the return only the action log tells a reverted region from an up-to-date one, and that a generator able to draw from its own prediction gains more from re-dating than from deletion when the moved tokens keep little weight. After an undo, ReDate raises the share of FAR's steps showing the current state from 0.36 to 0.62 and HY-WorldPlay's from 0.003 to 0.19. We also propose a calibrated state metric to test any memory after undos.

translation.title: 旧不等于假：交互式视频世界模型的有效时间记忆
translation.abstract: 交互式视频世界模型从带有采集时间戳的早期帧记忆库中生成每一帧。在帧、权重和噪声固定的情况下，交换两个视图的时间戳会翻转两类生成器所读取的状态：它们将最新时间戳视为真相。只要状态从不回退，这种解读就是正确的。当智能体撤销一个动作后，某区域的最新视图已过时，而唯一反映当前状态的视图更旧；面向变化世界的记忆会删除那个较旧的视图，而保留它的记忆则会把过去交给生成器。时序数据库将记录的存储时间与其内容的有效时间（valid time）分开。ReDate 保留每一帧，并根据从智能体动作日志中读取的有效时间为每个被检索的 token 标注日期。冻结的生成器随即将回退的区域读取为刚刚到达新状态的区域，因此 ReDate 无需训练。我们证明：只有当每个当前视图的时间戳都晚于每个过时视图时，信任最新时间戳才是正确的；在没有回退后采集的视图时，只有动作日志能区分回退区域与最新区域；当被移动的 token 权重很小时，能够从自身预测中生成的生成器从重新标注日期中获益多于从删除中获益。撤销动作后，ReDate 将 FAR 显示当前状态的步骤比例从 0.36 提升到 0.62，将 HY-WorldPlay 的从 0.003 提升到 0.19。我们还提出一个经过校准的状态指标，用于在撤销后测试任何记忆机制。
translation.brief: 针对动作撤销后视频世界模型误将过时帧当作当前状态的问题，提出 ReDate，依据动作日志中的有效时间为检索 token 重新标注日期，无需训练即可修复状态判断。

papers.title: DramaVQA: Probing Detailed Understanding of Ultra-Long TV Dramas
papers.abstract: Despite recent progress in long-form video understanding, current benchmarks mostly focus on short clips or hour-scale videos. This leaves a major gap in evaluating ultra-long video understanding, where videos often last tens of hours. To bridge this gap, we introduce DramaVQA, a large-scale benchmark built upon long-form TV dramas. Containing approximately 20K question-answering (QA) pairs, the scale of DramaVQA exceeds previous long-video datasets, such as Video-MME and LVBench, by an order of magnitude. Our benchmark has two main features that make it stand out from existing datasets. First, we establish a scalable, LLM-assisted annotation pipeline that uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to generate complex questions, followed by strict human checking to ensure high data quality. Second, DramaVQA introduces a multi-level time structure; queries are designed across different video lengths, with the hardest questions requiring overall understanding across the entire drama. Extensive evaluations show that state-of-the-art MLLMs face major challenges when tested on these very long videos, highlighting the need for agentic AI algorithms capable of managing long-term memory. The project is available at this https URL

translation.title: DramaVQA：探测对超长电视剧的细粒度理解
translation.abstract: 尽管长视频理解近来有所进展，现有基准大多聚焦于短视频片段或小时级视频。这在评估超长视频理解方面留下了重大空白，此类视频往往长达数十小时。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 DramaVQA，一个基于长篇电视剧构建的大规模基准。DramaVQA 包含约 2 万个问答（QA）对，其规模比 Video-MME 和 LVBench 等以往长视频数据集高出一个数量级。我们的基准有两个使其区别于现有数据集的主要特点。第一，我们建立了一个可扩展的、LLM 辅助的标注流水线，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成复杂问题，随后进行严格的人工检查以确保高数据质量。第二，DramaVQA 引入了多层次的时间结构；查询跨越不同视频长度设计，最难的问题需要对整部剧的整体理解。大量评估表明，最先进的 MLLM 在这些超长视频上面临重大挑战，凸显了对能够管理长期记忆的智能体 AI 算法的需求。项目见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对超长（数十小时）视频理解缺乏评测基准的问题，构建基于电视剧的大规模 QA 基准 DramaVQA，采用 LLM 辅助标注流水线与多级时间结构设计。

papers.title: Designing Informative Actions: Action Construction for Long-Horizon Research Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model agents support automated scientific research by connecting literature analysis and planning with experimentation. Evaluating which action an agent selects does not establish which experiment its instruction specifies, because omitted interventions or replication counts leave consequential choices to the executor. We introduce a reading-set framework for evaluating action construction under a common cost rule. Across 30 synthetic states, complete-design requests increase affordable efficiency by 465.98% and 327.91% relative to the action-name baseline in the two model families, respectively. An author-constructed research-action evaluation dataset provides 60 scenarios for complementary judgment evaluation. On this dataset, the scenario-level information-per-cost measure has a mean within-scenario correlation of 0.733 with judgments from 18 human participants. The framework makes design specification and execution ambiguity measurable, providing a reproducible basis for assessing how research agents translate scientific intent into informative, budget-feasible experiments.

translation.title: 设计信息性动作：面向长程研究智能体的动作构建
translation.abstract: 大语言模型智能体通过将文献分析与规划和实验相结合来支持自动化科学研究。评估智能体选择了哪个动作并不能确定其指令规定了哪个实验，因为省略的干预或重复次数会将关键选择留给执行者。我们引入一个阅读集框架，在统一的成本规则下评估动作构建。在 30 个合成状态上，完整设计请求在两个模型家族中相对于动作名称基线分别将可负担效率提升 465.98% 和 327.91%。一个由作者构建的研究动作评估数据集提供了 60 个场景用于互补的判断评估。在该数据集上，场景级单位成本信息量指标与 18 名人类参与者的判断之间的场景内平均相关性为 0.733。该框架使设计规范与执行歧义变得可度量，为评估研究智能体如何将科学意图转化为信息丰富且预算可行的实验提供了可复现的基础。
translation.brief: 针对智能体动作指令存在执行歧义、无法确定具体实验设计的问题，提出阅读集框架与单位成本信息量指标来评估长程研究智能体的动作构建质量。

papers.title: Decision-Centric Research: A Calibrated Decision Model and Benchmark for Scientific Agents
papers.abstract: Scientific agents make consequential choices about evidence, next actions and research strategy, but choices embedded in generated text are difficult to evaluate independently. Decision-Centric Research (DCR) is introduced to make individual choices the common unit of supervision, prediction and evaluation through typed predictions over an explicit Research State. DCR defines 24 decision types, ten of which are instantiated in the Research Decision Benchmark (RD-Bench) of 2,000 rule-generated cases. The Decision-Centric Research Model (DCRM) shares a candidate-token readout across types to produce answers and option probabilities in one forward pass. Under a held-out research-domain split, a 0.6B DCRM (state-aware) achieves 89.4% Top-1 accuracy, compared with 27.8% for DCRM (question-only) trained with the same recipe and 36.4% for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. All 30 type-seed comparisons against DCRM (question-only) are significant after Holm correction. After held-out calibration, the resulting prediction sets contain a mean of 1.515 candidates at 97.1% empirical label coverage, reducing mean set size by 57.4% relative to DCRM (question-only) at similar coverage. These results establish a compact state-aware decision layer with accurate typed prediction and an inspectable uncertainty interface.

papers.title: From Static Models to Editable CAD: A Design-Intent-Aware Framework for Reverse Parametrization
papers.abstract: Neutral CAD formats such as STEP typically preserve geometry but not feature histories or parameter dependencies. Thus, they are inherently limited for iterative design that requires modifications, a critical limitation for design optimization that relies on iterative processes. This study presents a design-intent-aware reverse-parametrization framework that converts history-free STEP parts into editable Grasshopper definitions and represents their assembly relations. Without task-specific training, the framework combines kernel-measured features, geometric relations, a compressed attributed adjacency graph, and multiview renderings. An LLM assigns dimensions independent, fixed, or dependent roles, confirms candidate joints, and interprets verification reports. Kernel- and rule-based modules perform measurement, parameter binding, geometry construction, and verification. Evaluation distinguishes default-shape preservation, design-intent reflection, and edit validity, with the latter examined through assembly-level editing examples involving checks for geometry regeneration, joint alignment, interference, and mechanism closure. As an example, five components of a mechanical mechanism were used, and across 25 runs, the mean global and analytic-feature-region intersection over unions (IoUs) were 0.984 and 0.983, respectively; all runs passed the combined shape-preservation criterion. In a separate request experiment, the requested dimension was selected as an independent variable in 19 of 20 runs. Product-level examples show coordinated changes in part geometry and assembly design while preserving assembly relations and avoiding inter-part interference. These results demonstrate editable reconstruction of history-free CAD models under the evaluated geometric and assembly constraints, indicating potential for subsequent design optimization.

papers.title: Who Schedules Agent Memory? A Sidecar Approach to Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract: As large language model agents increasingly undertake complex, long-horizon tasks, memory has become an important component for supporting sustained decision-making and action. Existing methods primarily focus on memory storage, updating, and retrieval, but often overlook how memory scheduling affects task execution: the main agent must identify memory needs, initiate retrieval, and wait for results while advancing the task, increasing both scheduling burden and execution time. To address this problem, we propose MemSidecar, which decouples memory scheduling from task execution through two independently selectable modes. Hooks directly delivers bound memory to the main agent when execution events match predefined conditions. Foresight uses an independent agent to predict potential queries, retrieve results in parallel, and store them in a cache, delivering matching and valid results when actual requests arrive. Hooks and Foresight achieve scores of 41.23% and 44.34% on MCP-Persona, respectively, while effectively reducing execution costs and latency and improving the efficiency of long-horizon agent execution.

papers.title: CheXPoT: Post-Hoc Visual Verification and Correction of VLM-Generated Radiology Reports
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise for chest radiograph report generation, but adoption remains limited because of hallucinated findings that are not grounded in the image. Correcting these hallucinations and improving overall report quality remains a significant challenge. Prior work has addressed this problem by refining models with reinforcement learning, preference optimization, or chain-of-thought supervision, often at substantial compute cost. To address this gap, we introduce CheXPoT, a program-of-thought (PoT) framework that verifies each generated finding against image features and removes those it cannot ground. CheXPoT decomposes generated reports into predicates with RadGraph and an LLM, grounds these predicates against a DenseNet-121 and Grad-CAM visual evidence table, executes PoT verification code, and rewrites reports after removing unsupported predicates. On a 4,145-image held-out split, CheXPoT yields statistically significant precision gains on 8 of 14 CheXpert classes and F1 gains on 5, with no significant decreases in either metric. CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 19.2% (MedGemma-4B) to 46.8% (MedGemma-4B + CheXPoT) and micro-average F1 from 23.0% to 49.4%, absolute gains of 27.6% and 26.4% respectively. We also tested CheXPoT on other VLM report generators. On LLaVA-Med, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 4.5% to 17.7% and micro-average F1 from 6.3% to 19.4%. On MAIRA-2, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 15.6% to 42.1% and micro-average F1 from 21.0% to 45.3%. Our results suggest that inexpensive post-hoc visual verification may improve VLM trustworthiness by correcting unsupported findings from generated reports. CheXPoT lays a foundation for tools that help validate VLM-generated radiology reports and reduce unsupported findings. These innovations may subsequently help increase trust and adoption of VLM tools in Medicine.

papers.title: EduExplain: A Benchmark for Explanation-Set Retrieval and Storyboard Construction in Educational Explanation
papers.abstract: Generating an educational explanation for a learner's query is not a single retrieval step but a pipeline: a system must first retrieve a compact set of complementary resources--passages, figures, examples, activities--that jointly support an explanation, then structure that set into an ordered, timed, role-assigned plan before rendering it as a lesson or video. Existing retrieval benchmarks evaluate neither stage at the level these applications require: they score individual documents rather than explanation sets, and provide no ground truth for how a set should be organised into an explanation. We present EduExplain, a benchmark providing human-validated ground truth for both stages. Built from secondary-level science textbooks, it comprises 6,921 typed, multimodal resources and 2,123 concepts, and pairs each of 321 learner-oriented queries with one or more human-validated explanation sets (retrieval ground truth) and 741 reference storyboards (structuring ground truth). The benchmark exposes characteristics absent from prior datasets: heterogeneous multimodal retrieval units, multiple valid explanation sets per query, and plans whose quality depends on pedagogical role composition, grounding, and timing rather than relevance alone. We describe an LLM-assisted, human-validated construction pipeline, report inter-annotator agreement for both layers, and establish baselines for each stage--lexical, dense, multimodal, and cross-encoder retrieval paired with four selection strategies, and free-form and fixed-template storyboard construction. Our results show that first-stage retrieval quality dominates retrieval-stage performance, that off-the-shelf diversity-based selection underperforms simple top-ranked selection, and that unconstrained and rigidly templated structuring both fall short of the reference plans. The benchmark is available at this https URL.

papers.title: AI Data Analysis: A New Approach - Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis
papers.abstract: AI data analysis today is three fragmented worlds: LLMs understand semantics but cannot compute; BI aggregates precisely but is stateless; ML processes large-scale data on a stateful kernel but lacks semantics. This paper proposes a combination mechanism, named Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis, that fills a still-open gap - the multi-engine joint context: the data context is embedded into LLM conversational analysis, where the LLM serves only as the semantic, reasoning, and orchestration layer (not computation) and connects four engines through the 1M context window - Python and R ML kernels, SQL over relational databases, Cypher over graph databases - yielding two multiplications, "semantics and precise computation" and "relational and graph", under enterprise-grade governance. The novelty is a four-dimensional coordinate system: horizontal (engine kinds), vertical (state flow - the watershed), spatial (business generalization), temporal (iterative convergence); a deterministic grounding method (one-shot injection of this http URL + this http URL, M+S) carries the spatial and temporal dimensions. Empirically, all four dimensions are substantiated: horizontally, four engines are quantified - SQL, Cypher (96.5% on CypherBench movie), ML in Python and R (TabReD weather); vertically, state flows across engines and grounding is reused across kernels; spatially, SQL generalizes across three business databases - AdventureWorks 91.3%, financial 95.3%, formula_1 94.6% (average), about 20-23 points above single-shot SOTA 74.45%; temporally, accuracy converges monotonically as notes accumulate. The core invariant - the separation of semantics from computation plus a cross-data-domain persistent context - does not expire as LLMs and agents evolve or engine forms change.

papers.title: VCoT-SQL: Enhancing Text-to-SQL Generation through Dual Chain-of-Thought Validation Training
papers.abstract: Open-source LLMs provide a flexible alternative to closed-source models for Text-to-SQL but still struggle with complex queries. Finetuning with chain-of-thought (CoT) data improves reasoning, yet standard datasets lack CoT annotations, requiring synthetic generation. Existing synthesis methods only verify the final answer, allowing flawed reasoning steps to corrupt the training data. We propose VCoT-SQL, a framework that improves Text-to-SQL generation through intermediate-step validated CoT supervision and a dedicated SQL validator, which enables small open-source models to outperform frontier closed-source models. VCoT-SQL trains two complementary models on curated reasoning traces: an SQL generator using clause-level CoT templates where reasoning steps are verified via execution and schema alignment checks, and an SQL validator using diagnostic CoT templates to detect syntactic, semantic, and type level errors. We further design a hierarchical schema filtering pipeline that integrates and refines complementary retrieval strategies to distill relevant database elements. VCoT-SQL achieves 66.82% execution accuracy on challenging dataset BIRD dev and 86.8% on Spider test, improving the base 7B model by 7% on BIRD. Notably, our CoT synthesis relies on 7B models yet outperforms methods that use 72B-scale or even proprietary closed source teachers for data generation, demonstrating that rigorous step-level validation can be more effective than scaling up teacher model size. Our dataset and code are available at this https URL.

papers.title: AdKnob: Ad Intensity Control and Labeling for LLM-Native Advertising
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-native advertising has emerged as a viable monetization channel as LLM service providers seek sustainable revenue streams. However, integrating native ads into LLM responses introduces two largely understudied challenges: (1) controlling ad intensity -- how prominently advertising content appears -- and (2) ad labeling -- identifying which segments of the generated text constitute advertising. We propose AdKnob, a framework jointly addressing both challenges. For ad intensity control, we introduce new ad control tokens without pretrained semantic associations and align the model via direct preference optimization to generate ads at each desired level. For ad labeling, we propose an attention rollout-based attribution mechanism that identifies ad segments by tracing their attribution to input ad-related tokens, requiring no additional inference cost. We further construct MI-KnobSet, the first multi-level ad intensity preference dataset for LLM-native ads. Experiments across six LLMs and human evaluations show that AdKnob achieves uniformly spaced ad intensities where baselines collapse to a narrow range, achieves the highest ad labeling accuracy while being over 500x faster than the strongest baseline, and is preferred over baselines by human evaluators up to 89.6% of the time.

papers.title: Can Agentic AI Undermine Its Own Assurance Loop? Closed-Loop Dependency Assurance for Cognitive Network Digital Twins
papers.abstract: Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Network Digital Twins (NDTs) are increasingly combined to form Cognitive Digital Twins (CDTs) that translate operational intents into network changes and support closed-loop management. However, a network change may achieve its intended objective while disrupting the monitoring or recovery mechanisms needed for subsequent decisions. For example, a service may be rerouted while its latency-monitoring traffic continues along the original path, producing measurements that no longer reflect the service's performance. We propose Closed-Loop Dependency Assurance (CLDA), an assurance mechanism that augments agentic AI-enabled NDTs with dependency-aware validation. In our framework, an agentic AI planner generates and refines network plans, while the NDT evaluates the projected network outcomes of these plans. CLDA extends this analysis using a Loop Dependency Graph (LDG) that connects service requirements to monitoring mechanisms, forwarding paths, failure domains, and recovery prerequisites. CLDA projects candidate actions onto these dependencies, checks intermediate states of multistep plans, and supports deterministic make-before-break repairs using temporary monitoring mechanisms. Unlike the Large Language Model (LLM)-based planner, CLDA uses explicit, deterministic rules for assurance decisions and repair. We evaluate CLDA through controlled reconfigurations, a 240-trial LLM-based planning campaign, and live network execution. A separate synthetic study examines deterministic assurance scalability across network models representing up to 1,024 routers.

papers.title: Toward Counterfactual Learning for Selective Re-Examination in Agentic Visual Search
papers.abstract: Visual search over high-resolution images requires a vision-language model (VLM) not only to determine where to inspect, but also whether another observation is warranted before committing to an answer. Existing prompting, demonstrations, and outcome-based reinforcement learning can encourage re-examination, yet do not directly supervise whether it is beneficial at a particular search state. We introduce ReSee, a benchmark of re-examination decisions comprising 3,227 visual-search trajectories and 8,827 explicit commit-or-re-examine decisions, with counterfactual adjudication that distinguishes states where additional inspection is warranted from those where commitment is preferable. Building on this formulation, we propose CARE (Counterfactual Advantage for Re-Examination), a decision-level reinforcement learning method that compares paired continuations under commit and re-examine verdicts from the same search state. Their cost-aware return difference estimates the counterfactual value of an additional observation and is assigned only to the corresponding verdict tokens, providing localized credit for whether search should continue. Experiments expose limited re-examination selectivity in existing VLMs and show that CARE significantly improves accuracy and decision selectivity over GRPO across two backbones, with higher accuracy and fewer visual requests on six unseen OOD benchmarks.

papers.title: ShiftRAG: Bypassing the Textual Bottleneck via Decoupled Learning and Continuous Soft Tokens
papers.abstract: Despite advances in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), suppressing hallucinations during complex reasoning remains a persistent challenge. We identify that existing RAG pipelines suffer from a textual bottleneck: by passing only raw text to the generator, they discard discriminative signals of the retriever. Furthermore, recent attempts to unify retrieval and generation within a single LLM induce severe objective conflict and exacerbate the rank collapse of decoder-only architectures, degrading performance on both tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce ShiftRAG, a decoupled RAG framework that employs a single LLM backbone but isolates discriminative retrieval learning from autoregressive generation. To bridge these decoupled modes, we project retrieval alignments into continuous soft tokens, establishing a high-bandwidth interface that infuses the generator with retrieval-side signals. Concurrently, our soft orthogonality objective mitigates rank collapse, while layer-wise relevance dynamics preserve the fine-grained latent space required for highly discriminative evidence separation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that ShiftRAG significantly improves retrieval and question answering performance over state-of-the-art baselines. ShiftRAG preserves foundational capabilities of the backbone while maintaining a favorable efficiency-performance trade-off on general text encoding and generative tasks.

translation.title: ShiftRAG：通过解耦学习与连续软令牌绕过文本瓶颈
translation.abstract: 尽管检索增强生成（RAG）取得了进展，但在复杂推理过程中抑制幻觉仍然是一个持续的挑战。我们发现现有RAG流水线存在文本瓶颈：由于只将原始文本传递给生成器，它们丢弃了检索器的判别信号。此外，近期试图在单个LLM内统一检索与生成的做法会引发严重的目标冲突，并加剧decoder-only架构的秩坍缩，导致两项任务的性能均下降。为解决这些局限，我们提出ShiftRAG，一个解耦的RAG框架，它采用单个LLM骨干，但将判别性检索学习与自回归生成隔离开来。为连接这些解耦的模式，我们将检索对齐投影为连续软令牌，建立一个高带宽接口，将检索侧信号注入生成器。同时，我们的软正交目标缓解了秩坍缩，而逐层相关性动态则保留了高判别性证据分离所需的细粒度潜在空间。大量评估表明，ShiftRAG在检索和问答性能上显著优于最先进的基线。ShiftRAG在保持骨干基础能力的同时，在通用文本编码和生成任务上维持了良好的效率-性能权衡。
translation.brief: 针对RAG中文本瓶颈和统一检索生成导致的目标冲突与秩坍缩问题，提出解耦框架ShiftRAG，通过连续软令牌将检索信号注入生成器并以软正交目标缓解秩坍缩。

papers.title: What Breaks and What Comes Back: Capability Damage and Recovery in Depth-Pruned Small Language Models
papers.abstract: Depth pruning removes whole Transformer blocks to make a language model smaller and faster, but the damage is not spread evenly across what the model can do, and a short fine-tuning run, called healing, decides what comes back. We measure this for small models used as agents. Four instruction-tuned models of 1.2-1.7B parameters (Llama-3.2-1B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and OLMo-2-1B) are pruned and healed, and six capabilities are tracked: structured output, function calling, instruction following, mathematical reasoning, safety refusal and knowledge. Three results hold across the families. First, function calling and math collapse in every model (retention 0.00-0.07 of the unpruned score), and the order in which capabilities break agrees closely across the four (Kendall's W = 0.92; 0.62 after correcting for chance floors). Second, which parameters are trained matters as much as which data: fully tuning the last three blocks instead of adding low-rank adapters to all blocks costs up to 0.18 in capped mean retention on three families, and one 300k-token pilot per scope detects this. Third, we test a planner that allocates a 1M-token healing budget from 21 short pilot heals. At a fixed budget it raises the weakest capability on two families, although only one of these gains survives a test that also resamples training seeds. Once its 3.48M pilot tokens are counted, uniform healing with the same total number of training tokens matches or beats every planned variant on every family and retains math significantly better on three of them in an item-level test (on one when seeds are also resampled). Healing longer is a strong and simple baseline that planned recovery must beat. Code, per-item predictions and every result are public.

translation.title: 什么会损坏、什么能恢复：深度剪枝小语言模型的能力损伤与恢复
translation.abstract: 深度剪枝通过移除整个Transformer块使语言模型更小更快，但损伤并非均匀分布在模型的各项能力上，而一次短暂的微调（称为healing）决定了哪些能力能够恢复。我们针对用作智能体的小模型测量了这一现象。四个指令微调模型（1.2-1.7B参数：Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、SmolLM2-1.7B和OLMo-2-1B）经过剪枝和healing，并跟踪六项能力：结构化输出、函数调用、指令遵循、数学推理、安全拒答和知识。三个结果在各模型家族中均成立。第一，函数调用和数学在所有模型中崩溃（保留率为未剪枝得分的0.00-0.07），且四者的能力损坏顺序高度一致（Kendall's W = 0.92；经机会底线校正后为0.62）。第二，训练哪些参数与训练哪些数据同样重要：在三个家族中，完全微调最后三个块而非为所有块添加低秩适配器，会使封顶平均保留率最多损失0.18，且每个范围一次30万token的试点即可检测到这一点。第三，我们测试了一个从21次短试点healing中分配100万token healing预算的规划器。在固定预算下，它在两个家族上提升了最弱能力，但其中只有一个增益在同时重采样训练种子的测试中得以保留。一旦计入其348万试点token，使用相同总训练token数的均匀healing在每个家族上都匹配或超越所有规划变体，并在其中三个家族的条目级测试中显著更好地保留数学能力（在重采样种子时为一个家族）。更长时间的healing是一个强大而简单的基线，规划式恢复必须超越它。代码、逐条预测和所有结果均已公开。
translation.brief: 研究深度剪枝对小语言模型各能力的损伤与healing恢复规律，发现函数调用和数学最易崩溃，且均匀延长healing是规划式恢复难以超越的强基线。

papers.title: LADS: Lease-Aware Delivery Scheduling of Tool Results for Language Model Agents
papers.abstract: Web agents complete multi-step online tasks through repeated browser actions and model calls. Their returned observations lie on the critical path to subsequent decisions. When concurrent browser actions finish in bursts, observations can accumulate on a constrained return path to a shared inference service, while waiting histories compete for reusable cache state. Conventional delivery rules prioritize short transfers or immediate cache reuse but overlook how sending a result earlier can help a request resume sooner and free cache-protection capacity for other waiting requests. We present LADS (Lease-Aware Delivery Scheduling), a tool-result scheduler that couples cache-aware delivery with bounded prefix leases. Its key insight is that resumption lets extra protection references retire, making lease quota available to protect another waiting history. LADS prioritizes timely handoffs using current lease ownership and an estimated resumption delay, with bounded departures from Cache-first order. Compared with ReAct using first-in, first-out (FIFO) tool-result delivery, LADS reduces mean complete-workflow latency by 44.6% under bursty tool returns and by 42.4% on Web-derived burst replay.

translation.title: LADS：面向语言模型智能体的租约感知工具结果交付调度
translation.abstract: Web智能体通过反复的浏览器操作和模型调用完成多步在线任务。其返回的观察结果位于后续决策的关键路径上。当并发的浏览器操作成批完成时，观察结果可能在受限的返回路径上堆积到共享推理服务，同时等待的历史会竞争可复用的缓存状态。传统的交付规则优先考虑短传输或立即的缓存复用，但忽视了更早发送结果如何能帮助请求更早恢复，并为其他等待请求释放缓存保护容量。我们提出LADS（Lease-Aware Delivery Scheduling），一个将缓存感知交付与有界前缀租约相耦合的工具结果调度器。其关键洞察是：恢复执行会让额外的保护引用退役，从而释放租约配额来保护另一个等待的历史。LADS利用当前租约所有权和估计的恢复延迟来优先安排及时交付，并在Cache-first顺序基础上做有界偏离。与使用先进先出（FIFO）工具结果交付的ReAct相比，LADS在突发性工具返回下将平均完整工作流延迟降低44.6%，在源自Web的突发回放中降低42.4%。
translation.brief: 针对并发工具结果突发返回导致的延迟和缓存竞争问题，提出租约感知的交付调度器LADS，利用租约释放与恢复延迟估计优化交付顺序。

papers.title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
papers.abstract: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results. To quantify estimation error, we derive an accurate analytical approximation to the error distribution when estimating full-benchmark scores from a subset, showing that most subsets yield small errors, while a few produce much larger errors, resulting in a long-tailed distribution. This means random sampling alone can achieve surprisingly strong performance with high probability, but remains unstable due to rare large errors. We further show that this instability is inherent to modern foundation models and persists even as more models are evaluated. Based on these findings, we introduce BestRand, a stable and low-cost benchmark compression method that preserves the efficiency of random sampling while substantially reducing its high-error tail. We validate BestRand on 70+ text, multimodal, and agent benchmarks, and further extend it to VLA evaluation. Compared with competitive methods, BestRand reduces high-error risk by 50.2% and estimation error by 16.4% on average, while requiring only 51.3% of the construction cost. It further reduces OOD estimation error by 21.8% on average across score-range, model-family, and temporal shifts. Together, our theory provides practical guidance for understanding and predicting the accuracy and reliability of benchmark compression, while BestRand enables stable and accurate compression at low cost. The code and data are publicly available onhttps://github.com/George-Ling3/BestRand.

translation.title: 随机就几乎够了吗？基于BestRand的稳定低成本基准压缩
translation.abstract: 基准压缩通过在能紧密匹配全基准结果的小子集上评估模型，来降低往往高昂的模型评估时间和成本。为量化估计误差，我们推导了从子集估计全基准分数时误差分布的精确解析近似，表明大多数子集产生小误差，而少数子集产生大得多的误差，形成长尾分布。这意味着随机采样本身就能以高概率取得惊人的强性能，但由于罕见的大误差而保持不稳定。我们进一步表明这种不稳定性是现代基础模型固有的，即使评估更多模型也持续存在。基于这些发现，我们提出BestRand，一个稳定且低成本的基准压缩方法，它保留随机采样的效率，同时大幅削减其高误差尾部。我们在70多个文本、多模态和智能体基准上验证BestRand，并进一步扩展到VLA评估。与竞争方法相比，BestRand平均将高误差风险降低50.2%、估计误差降低16.4%，而构建成本仅需51.3%。在分数范围、模型家族和时间偏移下，它还将OOD估计误差平均降低21.8%。总之，我们的理论为理解和预测基准压缩的准确性与可靠性提供了实用指导，而BestRand能以低成本实现稳定准确的压缩。代码和数据已在https://github.com/George-Ling3/BestRand公开。
translation.brief: 针对基准压缩中随机采样的长尾高误差不稳定问题，提出BestRand方法，在保留随机采样效率的同时削减高误差尾部。

papers.title: When 200 OK Is Not an Answer: Silent Fetch Failures in Agentic Web Content Acquisition
papers.abstract: Web agents and answer engines fetch pages at question time, and liveness checks of cited sources treat an HTTP 200 response as success. We measure how often that assumption fails and what it does to measurements built on fetched pages. We fetched 10,307 URLs in three days with a polite static client and a rendered browser client: pages from 1,507 sites in five strata, random non-existent paths on every site, and the 4,795 URLs cited by expert-verified claims in ExpertQA. We define a taxonomy of what a 200 response contains, label the static 200 responses automatically, and check the labels against 300 items reviewed by an LLM-based assistant; a human check of 60 of them retained every reviewed usability label after discussion. By the automatic labels, 20.9% of the pages that a static client receives with status 200 do not contain the page's main content: app shells, bot challenges, block pages, error and placeholder pages, and partial content. On the held-out test split, the reviewed sample lowers this estimate from 25.5% to 20.0%. 13.1% of the sites whose random-path probe was answered returned 200. The error propagates: for the cited sources, treating 200 as content overstates the share of claim-source pairs that can be checked against live content by 12.2 points and inflates the apparent silent citation-drift rate from 5.8% to 21.9%. Cheap heuristics catch most of it. Text length, probe comparison and redirect-to-root, combined and tuned on held-out sites, recover 86% of unusable reviewed responses at a false-alarm rate near 5%. Content-reading detectors perform comparably: the best, the text classifier, gains five to seven points of recall at more than twice the false-alarm rate. We argue that agents and their evaluations should report fetch outcomes explicitly instead of inferring them from the status line and will release the labelled data and code.

translation.title: 当200 OK不是答案：智能体Web内容获取中的静默抓取失败
translation.abstract: Web智能体和答案引擎在提问时抓取页面，而对引用来源的活性检查将HTTP 200响应视为成功。我们测量了这一假设失效的频率及其对基于抓取页面构建的测量的影响。我们在三天内用礼貌的静态客户端和渲染浏览器客户端抓取了10,307个URL：来自五个分层的1,507个站点的页面、每个站点上的随机不存在路径，以及ExpertQA中经专家验证的声明所引用的4,795个URL。我们定义了200响应内容的分类体系，自动标注静态200响应，并用基于LLM的助手检查的300项来核对标签；对其中60项的人工检查经讨论后保留了所有已审查的可用性标签。根据自动标签，静态客户端收到状态200的页面中有20.9%不包含页面的主要内容：应用外壳、机器人挑战、封锁页面、错误和占位页面以及部分内容。在留出测试集上，经审查的样本将这一估计从25.5%降至20.0%。随机路径探测得到响应的站点中有13.1%返回200。误差会传播：对于被引用的来源，将200视为内容会使可对照在线内容核验的声明-来源对占比虚高12.2个百分点，并将表面上的静默引用漂移率从5.8%夸大到21.9%。廉价的启发式方法能捕获大部分问题。文本长度、探测比较和重定向到根路径，在留出站点上组合调优后，以接近5%的误报率恢复了86%的不可用已审查响应。内容读取检测器表现相当：最好的文本分类器以两倍以上的误报率换取五到七个百分点的召回提升。我们认为智能体及其评估应显式报告抓取结果，而不是从状态行推断，并将发布标注数据和代码。
translation.brief: 测量Web抓取中HTTP 200响应实为无有效内容（应用外壳、封锁页等）的静默失败率及其对引用核验测量的影响，并提出低误报的启发式检测方法。

papers.title: Elastic Precision: Software-Hardware Co-Design of a Mixed-Precision Architecture for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the data movement and computation costs of large language model (LLM) inference, but uniform widths can waste precision and degrade model quality. Existing mixed-precision methods do not fully account for how the other input of the current GEMM tile affects output error when selecting one input's width. Using both inputs to guide precision introduces additional estimation and selection overheads on conventional hardware. We propose Coffee, a runtime precision allocation architecture for long-context LLM inference. Under a fixed average bit-width budget, Coffee combines statistics from both current input matrices to estimate output errors at candidate widths and select each subarray's two input widths, allocating more bits where they yield greater estimated error reductions. Its mixed-precision hardware supports the selected widths in data access and computation, while overlapping error estimation and width selection with transfers and computation to limit stalls. The same read path supports attention-guided KV reads during decoding, reducing memory traffic. Coffee achieves lower perplexity and higher average zero-shot accuracy than the evaluated quantization baselines, and higher long-context retrieval recall than PLENA. For long-context decoding, system modeling projects up to $2.55\times$ the throughput and $2.61\times$ the energy efficiency of the reconfigured PLENA baseline, and up to $4.96\times$ and $12.56\times$, respectively, compared with the B200 GPU baseline.

translation.title: 弹性精度：面向长上下文 LLM 推理的混合精度架构软硬件协同设计
translation.abstract: 低比特量化可以降低大语言模型（LLM）推理的数据搬运与计算开销，但统一位宽会浪费精度并降低模型质量。现有混合精度方法在选择某一输入的位宽时，未能充分考虑当前 GEMM tile 的另一输入对输出误差的影响。利用两个输入共同指导精度选择会在传统硬件上引入额外的估计与选择开销。我们提出 Coffee，一种面向长上下文 LLM 推理的运行时精度分配架构。在固定平均位宽预算下，Coffee 结合当前两个输入矩阵的统计信息来估计候选位宽下的输出误差，并为每个子阵列选择两个输入的位宽，将更多比特分配给能带来更大估计误差降低的位置。其混合精度硬件在数据访问与计算中支持所选位宽，同时将误差估计与位宽选择同传输和计算重叠以减少停顿。同一读取路径还支持解码期间的 attention 引导 KV 读取，降低内存流量。Coffee 相比所评估的量化基线取得了更低的困惑度和更高的平均零样本准确率，并比 PLENA 具有更高的长上下文检索召回率。对于长上下文解码，系统建模预测其吞吐量最高可达重构后 PLENA 基线的 2.55 倍、能效的 2.61 倍；相比 B200 GPU 基线，分别最高可达 4.96 倍和 12.56 倍。
translation.brief: 解决长上下文 LLM 推理中统一量化位宽浪费精度的问题，提出 Coffee 架构，利用双输入矩阵统计信息在运行时为各子阵列分配混合位宽并配套软硬件协同设计。

papers.title: Illusion: Safeguarding Topology Confidentiality in LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Behavior-Preserving Obfuscation
papers.abstract: The communication topology of Large Language Model Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MASs) governs how information propagates among agents and encodes critical domain knowledge and expert workflow design. It is valuable intellectual property and plays a decisive role in system utility and safety, yet remains vulnerable to inference attacks that stealthily reconstruct it from agent outputs. Existing defenses detect or mitigate such attacks but do not proactively conceal the topology itself. We propose \textit{Illusion}, a proactive topology obfuscation defense for LLM-MAS. \textit{Illusion} injects fake edges and fake messages to present attackers with a deceptive topology, while selecting low-impact candidates that preserve output-distribution equivalence and task-accuracy non-inferiority. The resulting fake edges are designed to be indistinguishable from genuine messages under black-box observation. Extensive experiments show that \textit{Illusion} reduces edge-level F1 from over 0.87 to 0.62 and graph similarity from over 0.94 to 0.71. It also largely preserves output distributions and task performance, and its fake edges resist both similarity-based and LLM-judge filtering, even under adaptive pruning.

translation.title: Illusion：通过保持行为的混淆手段保护 LLM 多智能体系统的拓扑机密性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）的通信拓扑决定了信息在智能体间的传播方式，蕴含关键的领域知识与专家工作流设计。它是有价值的知识产权，对系统效用与安全性起决定性作用，然而容易受到从智能体输出中隐蔽重建拓扑的推理攻击。现有防御手段只能检测或缓解此类攻击，无法主动隐藏拓扑本身。我们提出 Illusion，一种面向 LLM-MAS 的主动拓扑混淆防御。Illusion 注入虚假边和虚假消息，向攻击者呈现欺骗性拓扑，同时选择低影响的候选对象，以保持输出分布等价性和任务准确率不劣化。所生成的虚假边被设计为在黑盒观测下与真实消息不可区分。大量实验表明，Illusion 将边级 F1 从 0.87 以上降至 0.62，图相似度从 0.94 以上降至 0.71。它还基本保持了输出分布与任务性能，其虚假边能够抵御基于相似度和 LLM 评审的过滤，即使在自适应剪枝下依然有效。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 多智能体系统通信拓扑易被从输出推断的问题，提出通过注入保持输出分布与任务性能的虚假边和虚假消息来主动混淆拓扑。

papers.title: UI-UG 2: Advancing Mobile UI Understanding and Generation with Fine-Grained Supervision and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Mobile UI understanding and generation require both fine-grained component perception and reliable structured synthesis. Inspired by the unified direction introduced by UI-UG, we present UI-UG 2, a compact 4B-parameter multimodal large language model (MLLM) that advances mobile UI Understanding and Generation with broader task coverage, a front-end-aligned taxonomy, and online render-aware reinforcement learning. UI-UG 2 constructs a multi-source understanding corpus from RICO, VINS, Android in the Wild, and Android Control, annotated with an 80-category two-level UI taxonomy aligned with front-end component semantics, and pairs it with over 5,000 requirement-screenshot-JSON tuples for progressive structured UI generation through a domain-specific language (DSL). For understanding, UI-UG 2 introduces decomposed rewards for category prediction, OCR fidelity, color recognition, dense grounding, and GUI grounding. Unlike the offline Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)-style generation optimization in UI-UG, UI-UG 2 optimizes generation through end-to-end online Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO): sampled DSL outputs are rendered with a Playwright-based server-side pipeline and evaluated using LLM-as-a-Judge and contrastive preference ranking. Experiments show that UI-UG 2 achieves the strongest referring and dense-grounding results among the evaluated models on our 80-category benchmark, and achieves the best composite generation score among compared models at a compact scale (4B). More importantly, we observe a consistent understanding-to-generation transfer: adding fine-grained UI perception supervision improves generation quality under a fixed training budget, suggesting that component-level semantics provide a shared representational foundation for both tasks.

translation.title: UI-UG 2：以细粒度监督与强化学习推进移动 UI 理解与生成
translation.abstract: 移动 UI 理解与生成既需要细粒度的组件感知，也需要可靠的结构化合成。受 UI-UG 开创的统一方向启发，我们提出 UI-UG 2，一个紧凑的 4B 参数多模态大语言模型（MLLM），以更广的任务覆盖、与前端对齐的分类体系以及在线渲染感知强化学习推进移动 UI 理解与生成。UI-UG 2 从 RICO、VINS、Android in the Wild 和 Android Control 构建多源理解语料，使用与前端组件语义对齐的 80 类两级 UI 分类体系进行标注，并配以超过 5,000 个需求-截图-JSON 三元组，通过领域特定语言（DSL）实现渐进式结构化 UI 生成。在理解方面，UI-UG 2 为类别预测、OCR 保真度、颜色识别、密集定位和 GUI 定位引入分解式奖励。与 UI-UG 中离线的直接偏好优化（DPO）式生成优化不同，UI-UG 2 通过端到端在线 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）优化生成：采样的 DSL 输出经基于 Playwright 的服务端流水线渲染，并使用 LLM-as-a-Judge 和对比偏好排序进行评估。实验表明，UI-UG 2 在我们的 80 类基准上取得了所评估模型中最强的指代与密集定位结果，并在紧凑规模（4B）下取得对比模型中最优的综合生成得分。更重要的是，我们观察到一致的理解到生成迁移：在固定训练预算下，加入细粒度 UI 感知监督可提升生成质量，表明组件级语义为两项任务提供了共享的表示基础。
translation.brief: 解决移动 UI 理解与生成任务覆盖不足的问题，提出 4B 参数的 UI-UG 2 模型，结合前端对齐的细粒度分类标注与在线渲染感知 GRPO 强化学习进行训练。

papers.title: Labadain-MedQA: A Tetun Medical QA Dataset for Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have created opportunities for cross-lingual transfer of medical knowledge from high-resource to low-resource languages to support access to healthcare information. However, medical question-answering (QA) datasets for fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs remain scarce for Tetun. To address this gap, we translated MedAlpaca's Medical Flashcards and WikiDoc Patient Information collections into Tetun using Gemini 2.5 Flash, producing 39,077 medical QA pairs. Translation quality was assessed on 50 randomly sampled QA pairs (100 documents) using automatic metrics against human reference translations and evaluations by two native Tetun-speaking healthcare professionals, focusing on medical accuracy and Tetun fluency. Human translations achieved higher mean ratings than LLM-generated translations for both criteria (4.43/5 vs. 4.02/5), with statistically significant differences (Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p < 0.001). To assess downstream utility, we fine-tuned Gemma and Llama variants on the translated MedAlpaca dataset using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and evaluated them on 325 Tetun-translated United States Medical Licensing Examination multiple-choice questions. Gemma 4 12B fine-tuned using QLoRA achieved relative improvements in mean accuracy of 10.79% with 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) inference and 10.42% after merging the LoRA adapters into the BF16 base model, compared with the corresponding base models. These results highlight the viability of automatic dataset translation for Tetun medical QA and the effectiveness of PEFT in enhancing model performance. The datasets, models, and evaluation resources are accessible at this https URL to support reproducible research on Tetun medical QA and facilitate machine translation, cross lingual, and multilingual research.

translation.title: Labadain-MedQA：用于微调和评估大语言模型的德顿语医疗问答数据集
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进步为医疗知识从高资源语言向低资源语言的跨语言迁移创造了机会，以支持医疗信息的获取。然而，用于微调和评估 LLM 的医疗问答（QA）数据集在德顿语（Tetun）中仍然稀缺。为填补这一空白，我们使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 将 MedAlpaca 的 Medical Flashcards 和 WikiDoc Patient Information 集合翻译为德顿语，生成了 39,077 个医疗 QA 对。翻译质量通过 50 个随机抽样的 QA 对（100 份文档）进行评估，采用自动指标对比人工参考译文，并由两名母语为德顿语的医疗专业人员评估，重点关注医疗准确性和德顿语流畅度。人工翻译在两项标准上的平均评分均高于 LLM 生成翻译（4.43/5 对 4.02/5），差异具有统计学显著性（Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，p < 0.001）。为评估下游效用，我们使用参数高效微调（PEFT）在翻译后的 MedAlpaca 数据集上微调 Gemma 和 Llama 变体，并在 325 道德顿语翻译的美国医师执照考试选择题上进行评估。使用 QLoRA 微调的 Gemma 4 12B 在 4-bit NormalFloat（NF4）推理下平均准确率相对提升 10.79%，将 LoRA 适配器合并到 BF16 基础模型后提升 10.42%。这些结果凸显了自动数据集翻译用于德顿语医疗 QA 的可行性以及 PEFT 提升模型性能的有效性。数据集、模型和评估资源可通过此 https URL 获取，以支持德顿语医疗 QA 的可复现研究，并促进机器翻译、跨语言和多语言研究。
translation.brief: 解决德顿语医疗 QA 数据集稀缺的问题，通过 LLM 翻译 MedAlpaca 数据构建 39,077 对德顿语医疗问答数据集，并用 PEFT 微调验证其下游效用。

papers.title: SNAPPerf: Software-Aware Tabular Foundation Model for Retraining-Free Performance Prediction of Configurable Systems
papers.abstract: Modern software systems expose hundreds of configuration options whose combinations can substantially affect execution time, memory and energy usage. Measuring software performance resulting from a configuration set requires running a realistic workload. Since the configuration space grows exponentially, exhaustive benchmarking is infeasible. Prior work therefore trains models on a small set of measured configurations to predict the performance of the rest. Yet these models are specific to a particular software version, hardware platform, and workload, so changes require new measurements and retraining, and such changes are becoming more frequent with coding agents. We challenge this per-system training assumption with SNAPPERF (Software-aware, No-retraining, Adaptive Prediction), a sample-efficient tabular foundation model specialized for configurable software. SNAPPERF is pretrained once on synthetic data. Each new update only requires a few measured configurations as context to predict the rest without any per-system training or hyperparameter tuning. Across 39,866 configurations from 12 real-world systems, spanning 6 domains and 4 performance metrics, SNAPPERF reduces prediction error by 38% over the prior state of the art at the same measurement budget, and by 25% over the best general-purpose tabular foundation model. It matches the state of the art's accuracy with 54% fewer measurements on average. These results suggest that knowledge about software can be encoded in pretraining data rather than in per-system models, opening a new research direction in software-aware pretraining.

translation.title: SNAPPerf：面向可配置系统免重训性能预测的软件感知表格基础模型
translation.abstract: 现代软件系统暴露数百个配置选项，其组合会显著影响执行时间、内存和能耗。测量某组配置下的软件性能需要运行真实工作负载。由于配置空间呈指数增长，穷举基准测试不可行。因此先前工作在一小部分已测量配置上训练模型，以预测其余配置的性能。然而这些模型特定于某个软件版本、硬件平台和工作负载，任何变更都需要新的测量和重训练，而随着编码智能体的出现，此类变更日益频繁。我们挑战这种按系统训练的假设，提出 SNAPPERF（Software-aware, No-retraining, Adaptive Prediction），一个专为可配置软件设计的样本高效表格基础模型。SNAPPERF 仅在合成数据上预训练一次。每次新更新只需少量已测量配置作为上下文即可预测其余配置，无需任何按系统训练或超参数调优。在来自 12 个真实系统、覆盖 6 个领域和 4 项性能指标的 39,866 个配置上，SNAPPERF 在相同测量预算下将预测误差较先前最优方法降低 38%，较最佳通用表格基础模型降低 25%。它平均以少 54% 的测量达到与最优方法相当的准确率。这些结果表明，软件知识可以编码在预训练数据中而非按系统模型中，为软件感知预训练开辟了新的研究方向。
translation.brief: 解决可配置系统性能预测模型需随软件、硬件或工作负载变更而重训的问题，提出仅在合成数据上预训练一次、以少量测量配置为上下文即可免重训预测的表格基础模型 SNAPPERF。

papers.title: Self-Refining Prompt Induction for Streaming Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL assistants for streaming engines must handle dialect-specific types, windowing rules, and temporal semantics, including constructs poorly handled by generic prompts. We present Self-Refining Prompt Induction (SRPI), an offline method that converts generation failures into reusable dialect instructions while keeping model weights fixed. A Refiner revises the Generator's prompt using reference-conditioned feedback from three LLM judges; a sampled regression guard checks earlier successes, and a separate Compressor reduces prompt length. Inference uses the frozen prompt without retrieval or query repair. We evaluate cross-domain and cross-model transfer on Confluent Cloud Flink SQL using a controlled synthetic workload seeded by 30 expert-written examples, with 335 induction examples and 257 questions from held-out domains. The same induced prompt improves mean judge scores across seven Generators by 7.1-19.2 percentage points, including an increase from 85.3% to 97.5% for the induction model. A separate compression study reduces prompt length by 52.7% with a 0.19-percentage-point score decrease. An assistant using the induced prompt is in early access, with initial user feedback to inform subsequent refinement.

papers.title: RTP-LLM: Building an Evolvable and Reliable LLM Inference Engine at Alibaba Scale
papers.abstract: Large language models and inference techniques evolve rapidly, making model enablement a recurring production task rather than a one-time integration effort. At Alibaba, a shared inference infrastructure must keep pace with new models and serving capabilities while remaining reliable across heterogeneous production environments. To reconcile rapid evolution with production reliability, we present RTP-LLM, an open-source production inference engine developed and deployed at Alibaba. Its architecture separates model-specific execution from shared request processing, state management, and resource coordination. Explicit interfaces localize compatible model changes while allowing models and deployment configurations to reuse common serving mechanisms. RTP-LLM has evolved from an exploratory system into a shared production engine that supports $\sim$100 models and processes hundreds of trillions of tokens per day. We describe how its architecture and production practices accommodate model evolution and contain the impact of failures, and share lessons for building evolvable and reliable inference engines at enterprise scale.

papers.title: PACT: Defending Recommendation against Promotional News Rewriting via Attack-Diverse Score Consistency
papers.abstract: Personalized news recommenders are increasingly vulnerable to LLM-powered promotional attacks, where content providers rephrase headlines to manipulate rankings without altering underlying facts. Defending against such manipulation requires covering a wide spectrum of LLM generators and optimization strategies--ranging from stylistic prompting to reinforcement feedback--without incurring prohibitive training or inference costs. In this work, we present PACT (Pooled Attack Consistency Training), a model-agnostic defense that decouples relevance estimation from superficial rhetorical variations. PACT integrates three synergistic operations: it pools offline, fact-checked rewrites from multi-generator and multi-strategy attack sources; samples a constant number of variants at each training visit to yield an unbiased estimator of the pool-wide consistency objective under a fixed compute budget; and aligns original and rewritten ranking scores within the same user context jointly with click supervision. Requiring no architectural modifications or test-time filtering, PACT deploys the trained recommender with zero extra latency. Across nine experimental settings spanning three recommendation backbones and three unseen-generator attacks, PACT consistently achieves the lowest promotion rate and target exposure, outperforming the strongest defense baseline by up to 3.0 percentage points in promotion reduction under LANCE. Further evaluations verify that PACT's superiority holds robustly under unseen attack-strategy holdouts and adaptive white-box retraining, while keeping clean recommendation utility virtually intact.

PACT integrates three synergistic operations: it pools offline, fact-checked rewrites from multi-generator and multi-strategy attack sources; samples a constant number of variants at each training visit to yield an unbiased estimator of the pool-wide consistency objective under a fixed compute budget; and aligns original and rewritten ranking scores within the same user context jointly with click supervision. Across nine experimental settings spanning three recommendation backbones and three unseen-generator attacks, PACT consistently achieves the lowest promotion rate and target exposure, outperforming the strongest defense baseline by up to 3.0 percentage points in promotion reduction under LANCE. Further evaluations verify that PACT's superiority holds robustly under unseen attack-strategy holdouts and adaptive white-box retraining, while keeping clean recommendation utility virtually intact.

papers.title: Pulse: Long-Horizon Tasks Need Streaming Personalization
papers.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly undertake complex, long-horizon tasks that benefit from sustained personalized support through long-term memory. Existing memory-augmented methods retrieve and use memory primarily from the initial request, with limited awareness of ongoing execution and emerging personalization needs. Agents may therefore overlook user preferences and project constraints during multistep tasks. We propose Pulse, a streaming personalization method for long-horizon tasks. An independent, lightweight memory agent continuously monitors execution, identifies emerging personalization needs and potential preference conflicts, and uses user and project memories to provide targeted interventions at appropriate stages. Reinforcement learning optimizes when and how the memory agent intervenes, improving the timeliness and accuracy of personalized support. Pulse scores 71.9% on $\pi$-Bench and 46.4% on MCP-Persona, achieving the highest overall scores among the compared methods on both datasets while improving task execution efficiency.

papers.title: GURU: A Hierarchical Neuro-Symbolic Multi-Agent System for Verification-Aware Automation of Mission-Critical Digital Engineering and Operations
papers.abstract: An AI can find a safe action faster than any human, but it must never decide what counts as safe. We present GURU, a hierarchical neuro-symbolic multi-agent system for mission-critical digital engineering and operations, built on one partition of authority: learned models propose, rank, and accelerate; a symbolic rules engine checks every consequential action against hard limits before it executes; and validated physics confirms and decides. GURU runs a workflow as a closed control loop, with Navigation, Action, and Planning agents sharing one Common Internal Language and one training factory. Nuclear, aviation, and national-security guidance now requires this pattern; a harnessed language model keeps the model at the center, GURU puts a validated reference there. In computational fluid dynamics, the workflow raised the converged-simulation rate on unseen aircraft geometries from under 1 percent to 74 percent over 100 single-attempt cases, ran 54 live cases to Mach 6 on three facilities, and an ablation put the symbolic layer at 13 points of boundary-layer capture. Knowledge-graph retrieval and role adapters raised ParaView control success from 55 to 75 percent. In space domain awareness, where a language model cannot be trusted to decide, a frozen self-supervised world model under validated propagation scored highest of five methods at conjunction risk, including fully fine-tuned language models, with several-times-lower seed variance: the trustworthy design gives up nothing in accuracy, and the recipe transferred to reactor anomaly detection. A radar-to-avoidance debris pipeline was demonstrated in stages on a 2026 reentry; the hierarchy coordinates simulated teams of 200 aircraft. Training scaled near-linearly past 1,000 Aurora nodes and ran at 8,000. The approach extends to a control-grade microreactor digital twin with validated physics, not a learned model, as the safety basis.

papers.title: Jet-QSparse: Accelerating Agentic LLM Inference with 4-Bit Sparse Attention
papers.abstract: Long-horizon reasoning and agentic workloads strain KV-cache capacity and decode attention throughput. We present Jet-QSparse, a training-free method that combines compact NVFP4 cache storage with native FP4 query-key computation on Blackwell tensor cores. A dense scan scores the full key history and selects 128-token blocks for sparse FP16 value aggregation with FP32 accumulation, preserving higher precision in the output-forming step while enabling contiguous tile loads. Calibrated key centering and at most two BF16 pages per sequence and layer address quantization error; FP8 prefill uses a temporary arena while the persistent cache is packed directly from BF16 activations. Across four hybrid LLMs, a budget of 128 blocks per KV head shows no detected accuracy loss on the evaluated mathematical reasoning, coding, and agentic benchmarks, although some smaller budgets incur losses. With 64 blocks, Qwen3.8-27B achieves a $1.94\times$ end-to-end decode speedup over dense BF16 at 128K context and batch size 16 on one GB300, and the measured Qwen KV pools provide $2.58$-$2.76\times$ BF16's token capacity.

translation.title: Jet-QSparse：利用4比特稀疏注意力加速智能体式LLM推理
translation.abstract: 长程推理和智能体式工作负载对KV-cache容量和解码注意力吞吐量造成压力。我们提出Jet-QSparse，一种免训练方法，将紧凑的NVFP4缓存存储与Blackwell tensor cores上的原生FP4 query-key计算相结合。稠密扫描对全部key历史打分并选择128-token块，用于带FP32累加的稀疏FP16 value聚合，在输出形成步骤保留更高精度，同时支持连续tile加载。校准的key居中以及每序列每层至多两个BF16页用于处理量化误差；FP8 prefill使用临时arena，而持久缓存直接从BF16激活打包。在四个混合LLM上，每个KV head 128块的预算在所评估的数学推理、编程和智能体基准上未检测到精度损失，尽管部分更小的预算会有损失。在64块设置下，Qwen3.8-27B在单块GB300上、128K上下文和batch size 16时，相比稠密BF16实现1.94倍端到端解码加速，且实测Qwen KV池提供BF16的2.58-2.76倍token容量。
translation.brief: 解决长上下文智能体LLM推理中KV缓存容量与解码吞吐受限的问题，核心方法是免训练地结合NVFP4缓存存储与FP4稀疏注意力计算。

papers.title: Constraint Dependency Graph Retrieval for Compliance Detection on Long SKILL Documents
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents carry out business operations under enterprise documents we refer to as SKILL documents, which take the form of standard operating procedures (SOPs) that state the conditions to verify and the actions to take before an operation proceeds. Long, densely cross-referenced SKILL documents exceed the context budget of small deployed auditors. Similarity-based retrieval then brings in irrelevant rules while omitting mandatory prerequisites, and the two-stage audit policy provides no trainable signal for the retrieval stage. We present SkillCDG, a compliance detection framework that reformulates each SKILL document as a constraint dependency graph, shifting rule retrieval from similarity-based matching to closure-based selection under the deployment's context budget. Each atomic rule is anchored to its source text span as a graph node, and mandatory prerequisite relations form the sole edge type. Policy-generated retrieval keywords activate seed rules, whose dependency closure yields a compact and conditionally complete rule context within that budget. The same graph also supports a joint optimization scheme. The retrieval stage is trained with group-relative policy optimization using a verifiable reward that combines output-format validity with downstream verdict correctness, with closure non-emptiness serving as a validity gate, while selective on-policy distillation concentrates teacher supervision on high-entropy reasoning tokens, with verdict and termination tokens always included, to improve verdict accuracy. Experiments on three enterprise datasets and two public benchmarks show that SkillCDG improves accuracy and F1 over the full-document and retrieval-based baselines.

translation.title: 面向长SKILL文档合规检测的约束依赖图检索
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在企业文档（我们称为SKILL文档）下执行业务操作，这些文档以标准操作规程（SOP）形式说明操作继续前需验证的条件和需采取的行动。长且密集交叉引用的SKILL文档超出小型部署审计器的上下文预算。基于相似度的检索会引入无关规则同时遗漏强制性前置条件，且两阶段审计策略无法为检索阶段提供可训练信号。我们提出SkillCDG，一个合规检测框架，将每个SKILL文档重构为约束依赖图，把规则检索从基于相似度的匹配转变为部署上下文预算下的基于闭包的选择。每条原子规则锚定到其源文本片段作为图节点，强制性前置关系构成唯一的边类型。策略生成的检索关键词激活种子规则，其依赖闭包在该预算内产生紧凑且条件完备的规则上下文。同一图还支持联合优化方案：检索阶段使用可验证奖励（结合输出格式有效性与下游判定正确性，以闭包非空作为有效性门控）进行group-relative policy optimization训练，同时选择性on-policy蒸馏将教师监督集中于高熵推理token（始终包含判定和终止token）以提升判定准确率。在三个企业数据集和两个公开基准上的实验表明，SkillCDG在准确率和F1上优于全文和基于检索的基线。
translation.brief: 解决长SKILL文档合规检测中相似度检索遗漏强制前置条件的问题，核心方法是将文档重构为约束依赖图并用基于闭包的规则选择与强化学习联合优化。

papers.title: Dependable Agents Need Hard and Fuzzy Rules
papers.abstract: Language models let software read requests in ordinary language, but they keep rules as people do: usually, and less so under pressure. Conventional code keeps rules exactly, but it cannot read a request. We argue that dependable agents need both, because the two kinds of rule cover overlapping and unequal regions of what an agent might do. Code holds the limits that can be stated exactly. Learned fuzzy rules cover the judgment that cannot. We test the hard layer in three domains, purchasing, delegation of authority and data access, on 1,340 episodes written by authors outside our team. Models left to decide for themselves executed unauthorized actions in up to 151 of 340 purchasing episodes and 269 of 470 delegation episodes, and the strongest model breached in every condition. A hard guard between proposal and action executed none, and an exhaustive search of 183,204 proposals agreed. In a further test, where an outsider wrote the owner's rules and a program mapped them to the guard, two episodes breached at a boundary we had written down in advance. We then test the pair. Concept Programming instills a named rule in a model and measures its errors on wording it never saw. A small model taught four judgment rules this way flagged 95 of 96 rule-breaking purchases that no exact rule can see, and 4 of 108 legitimate requests. Placed in front of the guard, it left 1 of 192 rule-breaking requests unstopped, where the guard alone left 77 and 70, and the guard still held every exact limit. A prompted frontier model did about as well, so the claim is that a small taught rule can do the job, not that it does it better.

translation.title: 可信赖的智能体需要硬规则与模糊规则
translation.abstract: 语言模型让软件能够阅读自然语言请求，但它们像人一样遵守规则：通常遵守，压力下则不然。传统代码精确地保持规则，但无法阅读请求。我们主张可信赖的智能体两者都需要，因为这两类规则覆盖智能体可能行为中重叠且不等的区域。代码承载可精确表述的限制，学习到的模糊规则覆盖无法精确表述的判断。我们在采购、授权委托和数据访问三个领域测试硬规则层，使用团队外作者撰写的1,340个回合。自行决策的模型在最多151/340的采购回合和269/470的授权回合中执行了未授权操作，且最强模型在所有条件下都有违规。置于提议与行动之间的硬守卫未执行任何违规，对183,204个提议的穷举搜索也证实了这一点。在进一步测试中，由外部人员撰写所有者规则并由程序映射到守卫时，有两个回合在我们预先写下的边界处违规。随后我们测试两者组合。Concept Programming向模型注入一条命名规则并测量其在未见措辞上的错误。一个以这种方式学习四条判断规则的小模型标记了96个精确规则无法察觉的违规采购中的95个，以及108个合法请求中的4个。置于守卫之前，它在192个违规请求中漏掉1个，而守卫单独漏掉77和70个，且守卫仍守住每条精确限制。一个提示的前沿模型表现大致相当，因此我们的主张是小型学习规则可以胜任这一工作，而非做得更好。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体在压力下违反规则的问题，核心方法是结合精确的代码硬守卫与通过Concept Programming注入的模糊判断规则。

papers.title: Synergetic Autonomous Intelligence: Three Axioms for Recursive Semi-Closed Learning
papers.abstract: We introduce Synergetic Autonomous Intelligence (SAI), a theory and design program for learning systems that form, preserve, revise, and compose relations while continuing to learn. SAI is built on three axioms: consequential distinctions must not become orphaned (U); identity is determined by future-faithful continuation under a declared contract (I); and unresolved defects are repaired by the least lawful local completion at the lowest admitted grade (L). We model a model, agent, tool, team, or environment boundary as a recursive semi-closed system with a Kernel-Ring representation, a Compile-Open-Participate cycle, and a typed residual comparing actual with claimed continuation. Under explicit finite or affine contracts, we establish relative consistency and conditional non-redundancy of U/I/L, characterize a contract-relative semantic quotient, construct an exact joint stochastic refinement, derive a constrained residual contraction, prove finite-horizon continued-service viability, and give an executed-intervention identification result with an observational-confounding boundary. We define GRC-Close as the generative and repair schema for this contract. The framework also gives finite contracts for action-effect-feedback loop re-entry, partial failure, duplicate-effect idempotency, replay, concurrent delivery, causal uncertainty, and threshold-radix state representation. KREIT, the Kernel-Ring Equilibrium Information Theory layer, treats information as a typed, resource-bounded distinction; the control layer authorizes, executes, audits, and updates actions across cloud-edge-end scales. These results establish a common contract-level vocabulary for representation, relation, memory, action, communication, explanation, coordination, and growth, while marking the assumptions and open boundaries required for later generalization.

papers.title: Multi-Turn Semantic Caching for Low-Cost LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Semantic caching lowers the cost of serving large language models (LLMs) by reusing stored responses for similar requests. In multi-turn conversations, whether a cached response is acceptable depends on both conversations' histories, which embedding similarity of requests and histories predicts poorly (AUC 0.62--0.74 on five workloads). We therefore learn the \emph{reuse risk}, the probability that a cached response is unacceptable, from judge feedback, and choose a budgeted set of conversation states to cache by weighing the generation cost a reuse avoids against a price for unacceptable reuse. We propose CUCB-SC-MT, which learns a cache from logged conversations with a suboptimality guarantee, and CLCB-LS-MT, which learns online and has $\tilde O(\sqrt N)$ regret over $N$ requests when conversation states recur. On math-tutoring (SocraTeach) and movie-ticketing (Taskmaster-3) conversations, both achieve lower loss than prior semantic caching approaches: ContextCache, multi-turn variants of ElastiCache and vCache, and single-turn semantic caching at every cache budget. With 1,000 cache entries, CLCB-LS-MT avoids 35--41\% of the generation cost through acceptable reuses, against at most 22--25\% for the baselines, and lowers estimated serving latency by 19--35\%.

translation.title: 面向低成本LLM服务的多轮语义缓存
translation.abstract: 语义缓存通过为相似请求复用存储的响应来降低大语言模型（LLM）服务成本。在多轮对话中，缓存的响应是否可接受取决于两个对话的历史，而请求和历史的嵌入相似度对此预测能力差（五个工作负载上AUC为0.62-0.74）。因此我们从裁判反馈中学习复用风险（即缓存响应不可接受的概率），并通过权衡复用所避免的生成成本与不可接受复用的代价，选择一个有预算的对话状态集合进行缓存。我们提出CUCB-SC-MT，它从记录的对话中学习缓存并具有次优性保证；以及CLCB-LS-MT，它在线学习，当对话状态重复出现时在N个请求上具有O~(√N)遗憾。在数学辅导（SocraTeach）和电影订票（Taskmaster-3）对话上，两者在所有缓存预算下都比已有语义缓存方法（ContextCache、ElastiCache和vCache的多轮变体以及逐轮单轮语义缓存）取得更低损失。在1,000个缓存条目下，CLCB-LS-MT通过可接受复用避免35-41%的生成成本，而基线最多为22-25%，并将估计服务延迟降低19-35%。
translation.brief: 解决多轮对话中语义缓存复用决策不可靠的问题，核心方法是从裁判反馈学习复用风险并据此进行有预算的缓存状态选择。

papers.title: Is That Clear? The Impacts of Clarifying Questions on Human-LLM Interaction
papers.abstract: LLM assistants increasingly ask clarifying questions (CQs) to elicit preferences and tailor recommendations. Although prior work emphasizes improvements in answer quality and user experience, how CQs shape users' subsequent engagement and reliance remains unclear. We conducted a controlled experiment (N=180) across six everyday decision scenarios, comparing human-LLM interaction with and without CQs. We further manipulated whether responses violated explicit constraints and whether violations occurred in the sub-decisions the CQs addressed, while preserving elicited preferences. CQs increased perceived understanding and satisfaction, yet participants spent less time reviewing and evaluating responses and accepted more responses unchanged, including erroneous ones. Within the CQ condition, participants more often accepted responses containing CQ-adjacent violations than nonadjacent violations. These findings demonstrate that LLM's proactive CQs shape subsequent engagement and reliance with preference elicitation. We discuss implications for designing and evaluating proactive assistants that support continued user scrutiny of answers alongside personalization.

papers.title: The Blind Spots of Detection: Adversarial Perturbation Attacks against Watchdogs in Distributed LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Decentralizing large language model (LLM) inference across untrusted Web nodes requires robust verification to ensure computational integrity. Existing activation-based verification and detection mechanisms validate intermediate outputs against reference values, permitting bounded numerical deviations to accommodate benign cross-hardware discrepancies. However, a critical security question remains: what can a malicious worker achieve while operating within these tolerance bounds? In this work, we introduce Hush-Up, a stealthy availability attack against distributed LLM inference, where a single malicious worker halts generation while evading attribution. The attacker first profiles its local execution to model an empirical bound of benign hardware errors. Using this error bound as a feasibility constraint, the attacker optimizes an adversarial perturbation on its output activations to maximize the final-layer probability of the end-of-sequence (EOS) token, i.e., to hush up the model. Across diverse models and benchmarks, Hush-Up effectively forces premature generation termination and collapses model capabilities. Furthermore, the attack hushes up the watchdogs themselves: existing defenses often fail to detect the sabotage entirely or falsely attribute the amplified downstream anomalies to honest workers. Our findings expose a fundamental gap between local numerical verification and end-to-end accountability: perturbations too small to indict a worker locally can nevertheless be powerful enough to break distributed inference globally.
