papers.title: Beliefs in feedback: Factored representations of interacting agents in transformers
papers.abstract: Complex systems, from ecosystems to brains, are usually modeled as modular components coupled through feedback rather than as indivisible wholes. Can a transformer trained on the joint behavior of a group of interacting agents be understood in the same way? In this work, we develop a computational-mechanics framework to study agents interacting in feedback loops. We formally prove that any joint stochastic process can be presented as resulting from the behavior of agents interacting in feedback, and the resulting process is generated by a hidden Markov model whose Bayesian beliefs factorize into separate components per agent. Furthermore, our experiments show that transformers trained on such feedback sequences make use of this separability, disentangling the beliefs about the underlying factors into separate subspaces of their residual stream. This representation is found to scale linearly (instead of exponentially) with the number of agents. Moreover, interventions show that these representations are causally efficacious, allowing for targeted steering of individual agents' beliefs by selectively inserting counterfactuals. However, coarse-graining the behavior is found to disrupt the factorization, and can force a higher-dimensional representation. Together, the results establish both the dimensional advantage of a factorized representation and the ability of transformers to exploit it, laying the groundwork for investigating traces of compositional predictive architecture in pretrained models.

translation.title: 反馈中的信念：Transformer中交互智能体的因子化表示
translation.abstract: 从生态系统到大脑，复杂系统通常被建模为通过反馈耦合的模块化组件，而非不可分割的整体。那么，在一组交互智能体的联合行为上训练的Transformer能否以同样的方式被理解？在本工作中，我们开发了一个计算力学框架来研究处于反馈回路中交互的智能体。我们形式化地证明，任何联合随机过程都可以被呈现为源于反馈交互的智能体的行为，且所得过程由一个隐马尔可夫模型生成，其贝叶斯信念按智能体因子化为独立组件。此外，我们的实验表明，在这类反馈序列上训练的Transformer利用了这种可分离性，将关于底层因子的信念解缠到残差流的独立子空间中。该表示被发现随智能体数量线性（而非指数）扩展。而且，干预实验表明这些表示具有因果效力，可以通过选择性地插入反事实来定向引导单个智能体的信念。然而，对行为进行粗粒化会破坏因子化，并可能迫使产生更高维的表示。总之，这些结果既确立了因子化表示的维度优势，也证明了Transformer利用它的能力，为研究预训练模型中组合式预测架构的痕迹奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 研究Transformer如何表示交互智能体的联合行为，通过计算力学框架证明联合过程可因子化为各智能体的信念，并实验验证Transformer将其解缠到独立子空间中。

papers.title: Do Embodied VLMs Actually Use Their Scene-Graph Memory?
papers.abstract: Embodied agents that answer questions about their route need a memory of what they saw, and scene graphs are a natural form for it. A vision-language model (VLM) can receive such a graph as text or through a graph encoder, but accuracy alone cannot show whether the graph holds the episode's facts, reaches the model, or is actually relied on. In this diagnostic study, we introduce a graph-swap test for the last of these: each episode is given another episode's graph, and we count how many answers change. On an embodied question-answering benchmark with routes through two to seven rooms, we use it to compare ways of delivering scene-graph memory to a fine-tuned VLM. As text, the memory is used strongly, adding 30 points on route questions. As a graph, it is not, and we trace why: the encoder preserves the information, but standard pooled and late fusion discard it. Giving each node its own input token recovers part of it, a gain of 8.3 points on route questions that the swap test confirms comes from the graph. The test also exposes a shortcut that accuracy hides: when the same facts appear in the text, the model ignores its graph. The test thus offers a cheap check of whether a VLM uses its scene-graph memory, and our analysis points to how that memory should be delivered.

translation.title: 具身VLM真的在使用其场景图记忆吗？
translation.abstract: 回答关于其路线问题的具身智能体需要对所见内容的记忆，而场景图是这种记忆的自然形式。视觉语言模型（VLM）可以通过文本或图编码器接收这样的图，但仅凭准确率无法判断图是否承载了情节事实、是否到达了模型、或是否真的被依赖。在这项诊断性研究中，我们针对最后一点引入了图交换测试：给每个情节换上另一个情节的图，并统计有多少答案发生变化。在一个包含两到七个房间路线的具身问答基准上，我们用它来比较向微调后的VLM传递场景图记忆的不同方式。以文本形式传递时，记忆被强烈使用，在路线问题上带来30分的提升。以图形式传递时则不然，我们追溯了原因：编码器保留了信息，但标准的池化和后期融合将其丢弃。为每个节点分配独立的输入token可以恢复部分信息，在路线问题上带来8.3分的提升，图交换测试证实该提升确实来自图。该测试还暴露了准确率所掩盖的一条捷径：当相同事实出现在文本中时，模型会忽略其图。因此，该测试提供了一种廉价的检查手段，用于判断VLM是否使用其场景图记忆，我们的分析也指出了这种记忆应如何传递。
translation.brief: 提出图交换测试来诊断VLM是否真正依赖场景图记忆，发现文本形式传递被有效使用而图编码经池化融合后信息被丢弃，逐节点token化可部分恢复。

papers.title: Fragility Is Not Reducible to Hardness: Conditional Causal Difficulty for LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models show large and seemingly arbitrary performance drops when a task is rewritten in ways that leave its requirements untouched. We recast task difficulty as a causal quantity: the treatment effect of meaning-preserving perturbations on a model. A meaning-preserving rewrite can only be observed to hurt a task the model can already solve, so we place the estimand on the principal stratum where the degradation occurs: the conditional causal difficulty (CCD), the probability that a randomly drawn twin breaks a solvable task. Because harder tasks tend to be more phrasing-sensitive, complexity enters as an effect modifier rather than a confounder, and we residualize it out to obtain complexity-residualized difficulty (CRD); zero for a task exactly as fragile as its complexity predicts, positive for anomalously fragile ones. Current benchmarks do not supply the data CCD requires, so we introduce GlassGSM and GlassMATH, augmenting GSM8K and MATH with twins built from perturbation families, raising fragility on GlassGSM by $\approx 12\times$ over GSM-IC-style distractors on the same problems ($3.7\%\to44.9\%$) while keeping the answer key unchanged. Our predictor Frail learns the per-perturbation break probability and reaches $0.613{\pm}0.023$ of the suite reliability ceiling on GlassGSM and $0.557{\pm}0.023$ on GlassMATH, against $0.171$/$0.401$ for a surface-feature baseline and $0.444$/$0.463$ for supervised baselines such as VAP3, and, at a $5\%$ curation budget on GlassGSM, doubles random recall of fragile items, matching an oracle ranking. Additionally, cross-fitted residualization leaves CRD uncorrelated with the declared proxy in practice. Code is available at this https URL

translation.title: 脆弱性不可还原为难度：面向LLM的条件因果难度
translation.abstract: 当任务被以不改变其要求的方式重写时，大语言模型会出现巨大且看似任意的性能下降。我们将任务难度重新表述为一个因果量：保持语义的扰动对模型的处理效应。保持语义的重写只可能伤害模型本已能解决的任务，因此我们将估计量置于发生退化的主层上：条件因果难度（CCD），即随机抽取的孪生样本破坏一个可解任务的概率。由于更难的任务往往对措辞更敏感，复杂度作为效应修饰因子而非混杂因子进入，我们将其残差化以得到复杂度残差化难度（CRD）：对于脆弱性恰好与其复杂度预测相符的任务为零，对于异常脆弱的任务为正。现有基准无法提供CCD所需的数据，因此我们引入GlassGSM和GlassMATH，用由扰动族构建的孪生样本扩充GSM8K和MATH，在相同问题上将GlassGSM的脆弱性相比GSM-IC式干扰项提升约12倍（3.7%→44.9%），同时保持答案不变。我们的预测器Frail学习每个扰动的破坏概率，在GlassGSM上达到0.613±0.023、在GlassMATH上达到0.557±0.023的套件可靠性上限比例，而表面特征基线为0.171/0.401，VAP3等监督基线为0.444/0.463；且在GlassGSM上以5%的筛选预算，将脆弱样本的随机召回率翻倍，达到与oracle排序相当的水平。此外，交叉拟合残差化使CRD在实践中与声明的代理变量不相关。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 将LLM对语义保持改写的性能下降形式化为因果量，提出条件因果难度（CCD）及复杂度残差化难度（CRD），并构建孪生扰动数据集和预测器Frail来识别异常脆弱样本。

papers.title: State-Aware Virtual Patient Simulation for Training Psychiatrists in Challenging Clinical Scenarios
papers.abstract: Psychiatrists must be prepared to manage patients exhibiting challenging psychological states, including suicidal ideation, hallucinations, and other high-risk behaviors. However, opportunities to safely practice such interactions are limited. While recent conversational agents can simulate patients, existing approaches largely rely on large language models (LLMs) to determine patient responses, making it difficult to consistently maintain psychological state, adapt to the clinician's responses, and generate clinically plausible challenges that meaningfully test the clinician. We present a state-aware virtual patient simulation pipeline for training psychiatrists in challenging clinical scenarios. The proposed system maintains an evolving patient state throughout the interaction and orchestrates patient behavior rather than leaving response generation entirely to an LLM. At each interaction, a learning-based behavioral strategy selector determines the type and level of challenge appropriate to the current patient and clinician context. The selected strategy, patient state, clinician response, interaction history, and relevant clinical knowledge are then provided as grounded context to an LLM to generate a semantically relevant and psychologically consistent patient response. Following each session, the system analyzes the interaction and provides feedback to the clinician on their communication and management of the virtual patient.

translation.title: 面向精神科医生挑战性临床场景训练的状态感知虚拟患者模拟
translation.abstract: 精神科医生必须准备好应对表现出挑战性心理状态的患者，包括自杀意念、幻觉和其他高风险行为。然而，安全练习此类互动的机会有限。虽然近期的对话智能体可以模拟患者，但现有方法主要依赖大语言模型（LLM）来决定患者回应，难以持续维持心理状态、适应临床医生的回应，并生成能真正考验临床医生的、临床上合理的挑战。我们提出一个用于在挑战性临床场景中训练精神科医生的状态感知虚拟患者模拟流水线。所提出的系统在整个交互过程中维护一个不断演进的患者状态，并对患者行为进行编排，而不是将回应生成完全交给LLM。在每次交互中，基于学习的行为策略选择器根据当前患者和临床医生情境确定合适的挑战类型和强度。随后，所选策略、患者状态、临床医生回应、交互历史和相关临床知识作为有据可依的上下文提供给LLM，以生成语义相关且心理一致的患者回应。每次会话结束后，系统分析交互过程，并就临床医生的沟通和虚拟患者管理向其提供反馈。
translation.brief: 构建状态感知的虚拟患者模拟系统，通过维护演进的患者状态和学习型策略选择器编排LLM生成心理一致的患者回应，用于训练精神科医生应对高风险临床场景。

papers.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
papers.abstract: Coding agents solve repository issues through long sequences of exploration, editing, and validation. These trajectories are increasingly used as post-training data, so how they are collected shapes what the trained model learns. A common approach is to sample multiple trajectories independently for each issue and then select or curate them. However, as more trajectories are sampled independently, later trajectories become increasingly redundant, even though earlier trajectories could guide where subsequent collection effort should be spent. A natural way to use this history is to expose it to the coding agent as advice. But training on such trajectories can make the model rely on advice that is unavailable at test time, creating a train-test mismatch. Instead, we argue that history should guide where collection effort is spent, while the coding agent decides what to generate. We introduce SWE-Trail, a trajectory collector that uses earlier trajectories to guide subsequent collection while keeping that history outside the coding agent's context. During a new rollout, SWE-Trail uses history to identify a state where additional collection effort may be useful. There, the coding agent proposes candidate next actions from its ordinary context, and SWE-Trail briefly executes them from the same checkpoint to decide which route continues. We evaluate collection approaches by training student models on the trajectories they produce. For a 124B student initialized from Ling-3.0-flash-base, SWE-Trail improves mean resolution over independent sampling by 2.33 and 1.60 percentage points on SWE-bench Multilingual and SWE-bench Pro, respectively. Without history, the same pipeline produces more resolved trajectories than independent sampling, but improves by only 0.11 points on Multilingual. These results show the value of using history to guide collection without exposing it to the coding agent.

translation.title: SWE-Trail：面向编码智能体训练的历史引导轨迹收集
translation.abstract: 编码智能体通过探索、编辑和验证的长序列来解决仓库问题。这些轨迹越来越多地被用作后训练数据，因此它们的收集方式决定了训练模型学到什么。一种常见做法是为每个问题独立采样多条轨迹，然后进行选择或筛选。然而，随着独立采样的轨迹增多，后续轨迹变得越来越冗余，尽管早期轨迹本可以指导后续收集精力的投入。利用这种历史的一种自然方式是将其作为建议暴露给编码智能体。但在此类轨迹上训练会使模型依赖测试时不可用的建议，造成训练-测试不匹配。相反，我们认为历史应指导收集精力的投入方向，而由编码智能体自行决定生成什么。我们提出SWE-Trail，一个利用早期轨迹指导后续收集、同时将该历史保持在编码智能体上下文之外的轨迹收集器。在新的rollout中，SWE-Trail利用历史识别出可能值得投入额外收集精力的状态。在那里，编码智能体从其常规上下文中提出候选下一步动作，SWE-Trail从同一检查点短暂执行它们以决定延续哪条路线。我们通过在收集方法产生的轨迹上训练学生模型来评估这些方法。对于从Ling-3.0-flash-base初始化的124B学生模型，SWE-Trail在SWE-bench Multilingual和SWE-bench Pro上分别将平均解决率比独立采样提升2.33和1.60个百分点。若不使用历史，同一流水线产生的已解决轨迹多于独立采样，但在Multilingual上仅提升0.11个百分点。这些结果表明了在不将历史暴露给编码智能体的情况下用历史指导收集的价值。
translation.brief: 提出SWE-Trail轨迹收集器，利用早期轨迹历史定位值得追加采样探索的状态来指导后续收集，同时不将该历史暴露给智能体上下文，从而提升编码智能体训练数据质量。

papers.title: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents
papers.abstract: Agent decisions depend on empirical relationships that deployment observations reveal and task descriptions alone may leave unresolved. We introduce Decoupled Predictive Decision Making (DPDM), an architecture that formulates heterogeneous agent decisions as conditional prediction with a shared pretrained learner. Language models provide semantic representations of current and historical records, while a general-purpose conditional predictor predicts task-defined targets from the represented evidence. Pretraining supplies reusable inference capability; deployment evidence instantiates problem-specific predictions without updating either model's neural parameters. Tool judgments, candidate preferences, and reasoning assessments share an evidence-and-query interface, with predictions mapped to choices by a decision rule. This architecture establishes complementary sources of agent capability: semantic knowledge acquired through language pretraining and empirical inference acquired through structured-data pretraining. A single frozen LimiX-2 predictor serves all five task categories. With Qwen3.5-27B as the semantic encoder, DPDM raises mean accuracy across 50 benchmarks from 78.80% with few-shot prompting to 84.92% under their respective evaluated history budgets, and reaches 82.33% with identical histories and queries. On ToolPRMBench's BFCL and ToolSandbox tasks, absolute accuracy gains are 34.26% and 28.87%, respectively, at the methods' respective evaluated history budgets. Accuracy improves as history grows. With identical imbalanced histories, mean balanced accuracy improves by an absolute 14.51% across five reasoning-step assessment tasks and four encoders. DPDM makes learning from experience an independently improvable foundation-model capability, creating a shared route for advances in conditional prediction to improve decisions across agent tasks.

translation.title: 解耦预测式决策：面向智能体的共享条件预测器
translation.abstract: 智能体决策依赖于部署观察所揭示的经验性关系，而仅凭任务描述可能无法解决这些关系。我们提出解耦预测式决策（DPDM），一种将异构智能体决策表述为条件预测的架构，使用共享的预训练学习器。语言模型提供当前和历史记录的语义表示，而一个通用的条件预测器从所表示的证据中预测任务定义的目标。预训练提供可复用的推理能力；部署证据在不更新任何模型神经参数的情况下实例化问题特定的预测。工具判断、候选偏好和推理评估共享一个证据-查询接口，预测通过决策规则映射为选择。该架构确立了智能体能力的互补来源：通过语言预训练获得的语义知识和通过结构化数据预训练获得的经验推理。单个冻结的 LimiX-2 预测器服务于全部五类任务。以 Qwen3.5-27B 作为语义编码器，DPDM 在各自评估的历史预算下将 50 个基准的平均准确率从少样本提示的 78.80% 提升至 84.92%，并在相同历史和查询下达到 82.33%。在 ToolPRMBench 的 BFCL 和 ToolSandbox 任务上，在各自评估的历史预算下绝对准确率提升分别为 34.26% 和 28.87%。准确率随历史增长而提升。在相同的不平衡历史下，五个推理步骤评估任务和四个编码器的平均平衡准确率绝对提升 14.51%。DPDM 使从经验中学习成为一项可独立改进的基础模型能力，为条件预测的进步改善跨智能体任务的决策开辟了共享路径。
translation.brief: 将异构智能体决策统一为条件预测问题，用冻结的语言模型编码器加共享预训练条件预测器（LimiX-2）在不更新参数的情况下利用历史证据提升决策准确率。

papers.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
papers.abstract: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. Extending them to joint quality--cost optimization introduces a challenge: applying the deployment preference during intermediate updates can prematurely reject candidates that are valuable for later improvements. We introduce ParetoSaddler, which addresses this mismatch by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection. At each iteration, an optimizer updates a parent harness to produce a candidate, and then compares the two over repeated executions and uses Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost. Promoted candidates receive broader development evaluation and remain available as parents for later optimization steps. We evaluate ParetoSaddler on ClawMark and GAIA2 using domain-disjoint splits. On ClawMark, ParetoSaddler improves quality from 70.86\% to 81.35\% while reducing cost from \$1.17 to \$1.01 per task; on GAIA2, it improves quality from 56.22\% to 62.89\% while reducing cost from \$0.78 to \$0.45 per task. The Pareto-selected harnesses also achieve higher quality at lower cost than quality-only harness optimization. Analysis shows that Pareto-aware optimization retains intermediate candidates that would be discarded by deployment preference but can support later improvements, while Bayesian bootstrap screening filters out candidates whose gains are weakly supported across runs.

translation.title: ParetoSaddler：面向质量与成本的智能体 Harness 的 Pareto 引导优化
translation.abstract: Harness 优化可以在不修改模型权重的情况下显著改进 LLM 智能体，但现有方法主要优化响应质量。将其扩展到质量-成本联合优化带来一个挑战：在中间更新阶段应用部署偏好可能过早拒绝那些对后续改进有价值的候选。我们提出 ParetoSaddler，通过将中间候选晋升与最终部署选择分离来解决这一不匹配。在每次迭代中，优化器更新父 harness 以产生候选，然后在重复执行上比较两者，并使用贝叶斯 bootstrap Pareto 支持度来晋升在质量或成本上显示出可信进展的候选。被晋升的候选获得更广泛的开发评估，并保持作为后续优化步骤的父代。我们在 ClawMark 和 GAIA2 上使用领域不相交的划分评估 ParetoSaddler。在 ClawMark 上，ParetoSaddler 将质量从 70.86% 提升至 81.35%，同时将每任务成本从 1.17 美元降至 1.01 美元；在 GAIA2 上，它将质量从 56.22% 提升至 62.89%，同时将每任务成本从 0.78 美元降至 0.45 美元。Pareto 选择的 harness 也以更低成本实现了比仅质量优化更高的质量。分析表明，Pareto 感知的优化保留了那些会被部署偏好丢弃但可支持后续改进的中间候选，而贝叶斯 bootstrap 筛选过滤掉那些增益在多次运行中支持薄弱的候选。
translation.brief: 通过将中间候选晋升与最终部署选择解耦，并用贝叶斯 bootstrap Pareto 支持度筛选候选，实现智能体 harness 的质量-成本联合优化。

papers.title: Fairway: Load-Aware KV Cache Reuse for LLM Prefill Scheduling
papers.abstract: LLM-based applications often employ agentic workflows and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which build long prompts from shared context. When prefixes are shared across requests, serving engines reuse the key-value (KV) cache to skip parts of the prefill computation. Reuse is typically graded: the uncached work of requests in a queue can differ by up to 100x. In this setting, the order of scheduling determines the time-to-first-token (TTFT) for the queued requests. KV reuse-first scheduling, which prioritizes the requests with the longest KV cache hit, gives the lowest median TTFT but starves expensive requests under load spikes; first-come-first-served (FCFS) scheduling bounds the tail but raises the median TTFT. We present Fairway, a prefill scheduler built on adaptive reuse prioritization: it favors KV cache reuse while queues are short, and shifts toward fair allocation as requests wait longer relative to their own prefill time. Fairway employs a virtual dual lane model: a KV reuse-first Fast lane and a Fair lane atop the serving engine's waiting queue that enables speeding up of cheap reuse requests without starving expensive ones. This model automatically adapts to the workload without any per-workload tuning. Fairway lowers the tail TTFT at no cost to the median in transient overload. Across workloads and load levels, Fairway matches or beats the best baseline, with a p99 TTFT up to 8.6x lower than prior prefix-aware schedulers. During load spikes, it keeps the tail of FCFS at a 6x lower median TTFT.

translation.title: Fairway：面向 LLM Prefill 调度的负载感知 KV 缓存复用
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的应用常采用智能体工作流和检索增强生成（RAG），它们从共享上下文构建长提示。当前缀在请求间共享时，服务引擎复用键值（KV）缓存以跳过部分 prefill 计算。复用通常是分级的：队列中请求的未缓存工作量差异可达 100 倍。在此设置下，调度顺序决定了排队请求的首 token 时间（TTFT）。KV 复用优先调度优先处理 KV 缓存命中最长的请求，给出最低的中位 TTFT，但在负载激增时使昂贵请求饥饿；先来先服务（FCFS）调度约束尾部延迟但抬高中位 TTFT。我们提出 Fairway，一个基于自适应复用优先级的 prefill 调度器：它在队列较短时偏向 KV 缓存复用，并随着请求等待时间相对其自身 prefill 时间变长而转向公平分配。Fairway 采用虚拟双车道模型：在服务引擎等待队列之上设置 KV 复用优先的 Fast 车道和 Fair 车道，从而在不使昂贵请求饥饿的情况下加速廉价的复用请求。该模型无需任何按工作负载调优即可自动适应工作负载。Fairway 在瞬时过载下降低尾部 TTFT 而不损害中位数。跨工作负载和负载水平，Fairway 匹配或超越最佳基线，p99 TTFT 比先前的前缀感知调度器最多低 8.6 倍。在负载激增期间，它以低 6 倍的中位 TTFT 保持 FCFS 的尾部水平。
translation.brief: 针对 KV 缓存复用程度差异巨大的 prefill 调度问题，提出虚拟双车道（Fast/Fair）调度器，在偏向缓存复用的同时避免昂贵请求饥饿，兼顾中位与尾部 TTFT。

papers.title: The Vibe Paradox: What EEG Reveals About Your Brain When Vibe Coding
papers.abstract: Background: Much of the enthusiasm for vibe coding rests on two intuitive beliefs: (1) that developers stay invested even when they no longer write the code, and (2) that delegating more of the work to AI lowers their cognitive load. Objective: Our goal was to investigate whether developers' neurophysiological states and interactions with AI are consistent with these beliefs when they work with agentic vs. non-agentic AI on their own project vs. a legacy codebase. Method: We conducted an exploratory within-subjects crossover study with 11 participants across 22 sessions. Each participant used GitHub Copilot Chat in one session and Cursor Agents in the other, working on their own project and a legacy codebase, with tool-codebase pairings randomly assigned and session order counterbalanced. We recorded participants' EEG, on-screen activity, and prompts, and analyzed 7,924 EEG data points, 984 activities, and 141 prompts. Results: Our findings contradict both beliefs. With the agent, participants remained indifferent to task outcomes, even on their own projects, and cognitive load was higher than with non-agentic AI. Furthermore, their ways of interacting shifted: with non-agentic AI, participants asked how the code worked and read it to verify changes; with the agent, they described desired app behavior and checked results in the running app. Conclusion: Our study reveals a vibe paradox: delegating to an agent left participants motivationally disinterested, even on their own projects, without relieving cognitive load, while coinciding with increased trust in AI. The community should treat this paradox as a first-class concern if developers and their AI agents are to go far together, and not just fast.

translation.title: 氛围悖论：EEG 揭示 Vibe Coding 时你的大脑状态
translation.abstract: 背景：对 vibe coding 的许多热情基于两个直觉信念：（1）即使开发者不再亲自写代码，他们仍保持投入；（2）将更多工作委托给 AI 会降低他们的认知负荷。目标：我们的目标是研究开发者在自己的项目或遗留代码库上使用智能体型与非智能体型 AI 时，其神经生理状态和与 AI 的交互是否符合这些信念。方法：我们开展了一项探索性被试内交叉研究，11 名参与者共 22 个会话。每位参与者在一次会话中使用 GitHub Copilot Chat，在另一次会话中使用 Cursor Agents，分别在自己的项目和遗留代码库上工作，工具-代码库配对随机分配且会话顺序平衡。我们记录了参与者的 EEG、屏幕活动和提示，并分析了 7,924 个 EEG 数据点、984 项活动和 141 条提示。结果：我们的发现与两个信念均相矛盾。使用智能体时，参与者对任务结果保持漠然，即使在自己的项目上也是如此，且认知负荷高于使用非智能体型 AI。此外，他们的交互方式发生了转变：使用非智能体型 AI 时，参与者询问代码如何工作并阅读代码以验证更改；使用智能体时，他们描述期望的应用行为并在运行的应用中检查结果。结论：我们的研究揭示了一个氛围悖论：委托给智能体使参与者在动机上失去兴趣，即使在自己的项目上，也没有减轻认知负荷，同时伴随着对 AI 信任的增加。如果开发者和他们的 AI 智能体要走得远而不仅是走得快，社区应将这一悖论视为首要关注点。
translation.brief: 通过 11 人被试内交叉 EEG 实验检验 vibe coding 的两个直觉信念，发现使用智能体型 AI 反而降低投入且未减轻认知负荷。

papers.title: Measuring "Success" In the Transition from Pre- to Post-LLM Conversational Agents through the Lens of Interaction & Explanations for Older Adults
papers.abstract: Conversational agents (CAs) for older adults have moved through at least two distinct eras, split by the emergence of large language models (LLMs) at the end of 2022. The first era was defined by commercial smart speakers such as the original Google Home and Amazon Alexa, built on rigid, rule-based dialogue. Interactions were single-turn, user-initiated and "successful" if and only if a command matched one of a finite set of pre-templated intents. The current era is marked by LLM-powered systems capable of open-ended, multi-turn conversation, with capacity for personalization and foundations for more proactive interaction. This shift has not only transformed what CAs can do for users, but also changed what researchers can measure when it comes to understanding "success" of user interactions with CAs. In this case study, we reflect on over 8 years of research spanning more than 100 participants across multiple field sites to trace how our own working definitions of "success" have evolved. We reflect on two completed bodies of work with pre-LLM CAs and an in-progress study with a post-LLM CA. We discuss how our definition and measurement of success have evolved during this transition and also ask open questions to the community about how to optimally measure "success" in the post-LLM CA era. This research is deeply applied and subject to the messiness of real-world deployments. Our intended contributions are deliberately practical, a combination of methodological considerations and reflection questions to support researchers engaging with this new wave of technologies.

translation.title: 从交互与解释视角衡量从 LLM 前到 LLM 后会话智能体转变中的"成功"——面向老年用户
translation.abstract: 面向老年人的会话智能体（CA）至少经历了两个不同的时代，以 2022 年底大语言模型（LLM）的出现为分界。第一个时代由最初的 Google Home 和 Amazon Alexa 等商业智能音箱定义，建立在僵化的、基于规则的对话之上。交互是单轮的、由用户发起，当且仅当命令匹配有限预模板意图集合之一时才算"成功"。当前时代以能够进行开放式多轮对话的 LLM 驱动系统为标志，具备个性化能力和更主动交互的基础。这一转变不仅改变了 CA 能为用户做什么，也改变了研究者在理解用户与 CA 交互"成功"时可以测量什么。在本案例研究中，我们回顾了跨越多个实地站点、涉及 100 多名参与者的 8 年以上研究，追溯我们自己对"成功"的工作定义如何演变。我们反思了两个已完成的 LLM 前 CA 研究和一个进行中的 LLM 后 CA 研究。我们讨论了在这一转变中我们对成功的定义和测量如何演变，并向社区提出关于如何在 LLM 后 CA 时代最佳测量"成功"的开放问题。本研究高度应用性强，受真实世界部署的复杂性影响。我们的预期贡献是刻意务实的，即结合方法论考量与反思问题，以支持研究者参与这一新技术浪潮。
translation.brief: 基于 8 年、100 余名老年参与者的实地研究，反思 LLM 前后会话智能体"成功"定义与测量方式的演变并提出开放问题。

papers.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
papers.abstract: Scaling computer-use agents from individual actions to complex software work requires experience that connects decisions to complete outcomes. We present NorthCUA, an integrated system for turbocharging computer-use agents through experience at scale. Its Experience Flywheel supplies diverse executable tasks to the NorthCUA Harness, which sustains long interactions, records decisions, and checks task outcomes. The Flywheel uses these records to curate verified trajectories. For unsolved tasks, recursive self-improvement evolves reusable skills and preserves verified milestones so later attempts build on earlier progress. Staged Learning combines this experience with grounding data from the Flywheel to develop GUI competence through mid-training and long-horizon supervised fine-tuning. The policy then learns from fresh attempts in the same Harness through joint desktop-web reinforcement learning, closing the loop between experience production and policy improvement. The resulting Nano, Mini, and Pro family achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source models across GUI grounding, desktop execution, and Web interaction under the reported evaluation settings. For more responsive Web workflows, NorthCUA-Ultrafast pairs direct action selection with open-ended generation on pre-RL Nano, offering a measured quality-latency tradeoff. Together, these advances establish NorthCUA as a high-performing model family and a reusable foundation for agents that carry complex software work from intent to completion.

translation.title: NorthCUA 技术报告：通过大规模经验加速计算机使用智能体
translation.abstract: 将计算机使用智能体从单个动作扩展到复杂软件工作，需要将决策与完整结果关联起来的经验。我们提出 NorthCUA，一个通过大规模经验加速计算机使用智能体的集成系统。其经验飞轮为 NorthCUA Harness 提供多样化的可执行任务，该 Harness 支持长时交互、记录决策并检查任务结果。飞轮利用这些记录筛选出经过验证的轨迹。对于未解决的任务，递归自我改进会演化出可复用的技能并保留已验证的里程碑，使后续尝试建立在早期进展之上。分阶段学习将这一经验与来自飞轮的 grounding 数据相结合，通过中期训练和长时程监督微调来培养 GUI 能力。随后，策略通过桌面-Web 联合强化学习从同一 Harness 中的新尝试中学习，形成经验生产与策略改进之间的闭环。由此产生的 Nano、Mini 和 Pro 系列在所报告的评测设置下，在 GUI grounding、桌面执行和 Web 交互方面取得了开源模型中的最先进结果。为了实现更响应迅速的 Web 工作流，NorthCUA-Ultrafast 在预 RL 的 Nano 上将直接动作选择与开放式生成相结合，提供了经过权衡的质量-延迟折中。这些进展共同确立了 NorthCUA 作为一个高性能模型家族，以及将复杂软件工作从意图推进到完成的智能体的可复用基础。
translation.brief: 解决计算机使用智能体缺乏连接决策与完整任务结果的经验的问题，核心方法是构建经验飞轮与 Harness 闭环，结合递归自我改进、分阶段学习和桌面-Web 联合强化学习来训练模型系列。

papers.title: Consolidating Reasoning with Test-Time Training
papers.abstract: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires finalizing solutions from reasoning that is distributed across the individual attempts of many agents. However, useful intermediate reasoning can remain unexploited when collaboration is limited to voting on conclusions reached among individual agents, or aggregating long, noisy collections of reasoning trajectories in context. In this work, we propose TTT-Consolidate, a framework that uses multi-agent reasoning trajectories as adaptation data to improve a model's subsequent reasoning. TTT-Consolidate jointly consolidates trajectories into parametric representations through test-time training, then generates a new solution by conditioning on the consolidated information. We meta-learn how to consolidate using bi-level optimization at training time, where an inner loop encodes reasoning trajectories into a lightweight LoRA adapter, and an outer loop learns meta-parameters for the inner loop such that the consolidation is helpful for the model to synthesize a final solution. As no large-scale corpus of diverse reasoning trajectories exists for training aggregation methods, we construct the OpenParallelThinking corpus composed of 12,810 math problems paired with a mixture of trajectories from six LLMs. Evaluated on challenging math and STEM benchmarks, TTT-Consolidate outperforms the best aggregation baselines by up to 20 percentage points, even under matched compute and runtime settings, with the gap widening at larger model scales. TTT-Consolidate also recovers from unsuccessful individual trajectories more robustly, an ability that improves as the number of available (even incorrect) trajectories increases. Finally, we demonstrate that TTT-Consolidate benefits from both SFT and RL-based outer loop objectives. We will release TTT-Consolidate and OpenParallelThinking for use in future work on reasoning aggregation.

translation.title: 用测试时训练巩固推理
translation.abstract: 有效的多智能体协作需要从分布在众多智能体各自尝试中的推理里最终确定解决方案。然而，当协作仅限于对各个智能体得出的结论进行投票，或在上下文中聚合冗长且嘈杂的推理轨迹集合时，有用的中间推理可能未被利用。在本工作中，我们提出 TTT-Consolidate，一个将多智能体推理轨迹作为适配数据来改进模型后续推理的框架。TTT-Consolidate 通过测试时训练将轨迹联合巩固为参数化表示，然后以巩固后的信息为条件生成新的解决方案。我们在训练时通过双层优化元学习如何巩固：内循环将推理轨迹编码到轻量级 LoRA 适配器中，外循环学习内循环的元参数，使巩固有助于模型综合出最终解决方案。由于不存在用于训练聚合方法的大规模多样化推理轨迹语料库，我们构建了 OpenParallelThinking 语料库，包含 12,810 个数学问题及来自六个 LLM 的混合轨迹。在具有挑战性的数学和 STEM 基准上，即使在计算和运行时间匹配的设置下，TTT-Consolidate 也比最佳聚合基线高出最多 20 个百分点，且在更大模型规模下差距进一步扩大。TTT-Consolidate 还能更稳健地从失败的个体轨迹中恢复，且这种能力随着可用（甚至错误）轨迹数量的增加而提升。最后，我们证明 TTT-Consolidate 可同时受益于 SFT 和基于 RL 的外循环目标。我们将发布 TTT-Consolidate 和 OpenParallelThinking 供未来推理聚合研究使用。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体推理轨迹中中间推理未被有效利用的问题，核心方法是通过双层优化元学习的测试时训练将轨迹巩固为 LoRA 参数表示再生成最终解。

papers.title: ZT-DAC: ML-Driven Dynamic Access Control Policy for Zero Trust in DER Networks
papers.abstract: The increasing penetration of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) in the smart grid has significantly expanded the cyber-attack surface. Traditionally, DER networks rely on static role-based access control (RBAC) mechanisms that assume persistent trust after authentication. This limitation enables adversaries to maintain unauthorized privileges and move laterally across DER systems, disrupting grid operations. Although attribute-based access control (ABAC) enables fine-grained and context-aware access decisions, it does not fully eliminate implicit trust. Zero Trust (ZT) principles can be incorporated to enhance ABAC policies. This paper proposes a dynamic access control framework for implementing ZT in DER networks (ZT-DAC). The proposed solution employs a two-stage verification process and integrates an Open Policy Agent (OPA)-based RBAC with a machine learning (ML)-based ABAC to enforce continuous and adaptive trust score assessment. To support realistic DER operations, a DER-specific access control model is developed and used to generate a domain-informed dataset of access requests incorporating both legitimate and adversarial behaviors. Experimental results on the dataset show that the OPA-based decision layer achieves \(91.92\%\) accuracy, with a False Positive Rate of \(14.45\%\), while the ML model achieves a Mean Absolute Error of \(2.074\) and an \(R^2\) of \(0.891\) in trust-score prediction. The ABAC layer achieves \(93.27\%\) accuracy, with a FPR of \(3.88\%\), validating its practical feasibility within realistic DER environments.

translation.title: ZT-DAC：面向 DER 网络零信任的机器学习驱动动态访问控制策略
translation.abstract: 分布式能源资源（DER）在智能电网中渗透率的不断提高显著扩大了网络攻击面。传统上，DER 网络依赖静态的基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）机制，该机制假设认证后信任持续存在。这一局限使对手能够维持未授权权限并在 DER 系统中横向移动，扰乱电网运行。尽管基于属性的访问控制（ABAC）支持细粒度、上下文感知的访问决策，但并未完全消除隐式信任。可以引入零信任（ZT）原则来增强 ABAC 策略。本文提出一个在 DER 网络中实现零信任的动态访问控制框架（ZT-DAC）。该方案采用两阶段验证流程，将基于 Open Policy Agent（OPA）的 RBAC 与基于机器学习（ML）的 ABAC 相结合，以实施持续、自适应的信任评分评估。为支持真实的 DER 运行，我们开发了一个 DER 专用访问控制模型，并用它生成了包含合法与对抗行为的领域知情访问请求数据集。在该数据集上的实验结果表明，基于 OPA 的决策层达到 91.92% 的准确率，误报率为 14.45%；ML 模型在信任评分预测上的平均绝对误差为 2.074，R² 为 0.891。ABAC 层达到 93.27% 的准确率，误报率为 3.88%，验证了其在真实 DER 环境中的实际可行性。
translation.brief: 解决 DER 网络静态 RBAC 认证后持续信任导致横向攻击的问题，核心方法是结合 OPA-RBAC 与机器学习 ABAC 的两阶段零信任动态访问控制框架。

papers.title: FOLLIE: Automated Reasoning over the First Dataset of Sentences with their First-Order Logical Representation for French
papers.abstract: FOLLIE (for First-Order Logic for Language Inference and Entailment for French) connects French sentences, compositional first-order representations and automated natural language inference (NLI). The first French NLI-ready, NL-to-FOL resource, it contains 19,983 inference records and 36,987 non-empty sentence-slot--formula mappings from six heterogeneous NLI sources, retaining French lexical material and source problem structure. Its silver annotations are produced by a neural--symbolic pipeline, with 111 separately identified LLM-assisted additions. The construction combines morphosyntactic analysis, probability-conditioned categorial multitagging, grammatical proof search, discourse representation and first-order semantic construction. Stage-wise experiments show substantial gains in derivation coverage; analyses of conjunction distributions, logical-operator incidence and scope alternation characterise the resulting resource. We then develop an automatic inference engine whose input-conditioned background theories address lexical relations, quantification, quantities, event structure and temporal dependencies. Prover9 supplies proofs for entailment and contradiction, while Mace4 supports bounded consistency checks. Three-way accuracies are 65.37% on all 335 FraCaS-FR problems, 70.33% on 300 GQNLI-FR problems and 71.35% on 9,399 eligible SICK-FR records pooled across splits. Agreement with reference labels among committed decisions is 93.53%, 100.00% and 98.66%, at commitment coverage of 41.49%, 37.00% and 15.05%, respectively. Worked constructions, axiom schemas and proof analyses explain these outcomes and identify the contributions of scope, reference, lexical knowledge and numerical structure. FOLLIE provides a French experimental basis for studying the representations and assumptions that connect sentence interpretation to deductive inference.

translation.title: FOLLIE：面向法语的首个句子及其一阶逻辑表示数据集上的自动推理
translation.abstract: FOLLIE（First-Order Logic for Language Inference and Entailment for French）将法语句子、组合式一阶表示与自动自然语言推理（NLI）连接起来。作为首个面向法语 NLI 的自然语言到 FOL 资源，它包含来自六个异构 NLI 来源的 19,983 条推理记录和 36,987 个非空句子-槽位-公式映射，保留了法语词汇材料和源问题结构。其银标注由神经-符号流水线生成，另有 111 条单独标识的 LLM 辅助补充。构建过程结合了形态句法分析、概率条件化的范畴多标注、语法证明搜索、语篇表示和一阶语义构造。分阶段实验显示推导覆盖率显著提升；对并列结构分布、逻辑算子出现率和辖域交替的分析刻画了该资源的特征。随后我们开发了一个自动推理引擎，其输入条件化的背景理论处理词汇关系、量化、数量、事件结构和时序依赖。Prover9 为蕴含和矛盾提供证明，Mace4 支持有界一致性检查。三分类准确率分别为：全部 335 个 FraCaS-FR 问题上的 65.37%、300 个 GQNLI-FR 问题上的 70.33%，以及跨划分合并的 9,399 条合格 SICK-FR 记录上的 71.35%。在已提交决策中与参考标签的一致率分别为 93.53%、100.00% 和 98.66%，提交覆盖率分别为 41.49%、37.00% 和 15.05%。构造实例、公理模式和证明分析解释了这些结果，并识别了辖域、指称、词汇知识和数值结构的贡献。FOLLIE 为研究连接句子解释与演绎推理的表示和假设提供了法语实验基础。
translation.brief: 解决法语缺乏面向 NLI 的自然语言到一阶逻辑资源的问题，核心方法是通过神经-符号流水线构建 FOLLIE 数据集并开发基于 Prover9/Mace4 的自动推理引擎。

papers.title: TSSDA: An Autonomous Agent for Constructing a Time-Series Text-to-SQL Benchmark
papers.abstract: As agents increasingly undertake data querying, Text-to-SQL serves as a foundational capability for database access. However, for text-to-SQL in time-series databases, high-quality benchmarks and large-scale training corpora remain scarce, limiting the systematic evaluation and domain adaptation of existing models and agents. Existing automated SQL generation approaches lack sufficient autonomy, leaving key challenges unresolved. First, numerous combinations of temporal syntax and functions complicate comprehensive coverage of valid queries. Second, as the corpus grows, generating valuable and diverse new data becomes increasingly challenging. Third, schema and data heterogeneity hinder reuse of temporal query structures, limiting generation efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose TSSDA, a Time-Series SQL (TSSQL) Generation Data Agent framework, and construct TERN, a comprehensive Time-sERies text-to-SQL beNchmark. First, to achieve broad coverage of valid queries, we systematically model TSSQL syntax and semantics to construct a data generation space. Next, to explore the space and improve diversity, we develop a Data Agent that autonomously orchestrates data generation. The agent comprises a planning and decision-making module and a query generation module, with online adaptation for continuous self-improvement. Finally, we introduce a temporal-aware memory that enables adaptive reuse of experience across heterogeneous data instances, improving generation efficiency. Comprehensive evaluations on TERN reveal the limitations of existing methods in performing Text-to-TSSQL tasks. Furthermore, extensive experiments demonstrate that TSSDA substantially improves coverage, diversity, and complexity.

translation.title: TSSDA：用于构建时序数据库 Text-to-SQL 基准的自主智能体
translation.abstract: 随着智能体越来越多地承担数据查询任务，Text-to-SQL 成为数据库访问的基础能力。然而，对于时序数据库中的 Text-to-SQL，高质量基准和大规模训练语料仍然稀缺，限制了现有模型和智能体的系统评估与领域适配。现有的自动化 SQL 生成方法自主性不足，关键挑战仍未解决。首先，大量时序语法与函数的组合使得全面覆盖有效查询变得复杂。其次，随着语料库增长，生成有价值且多样化的新数据日益困难。第三，模式与数据的异质性阻碍了时序查询结构的复用，限制了生成效率。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 TSSDA，一个时序 SQL（TSSQL）生成数据智能体框架，并构建了 TERN，一个全面的时序 Text-to-SQL 基准。首先，为广泛覆盖有效查询，我们系统地对 TSSQL 语法和语义建模以构建数据生成空间。其次，为探索该空间并提升多样性，我们开发了一个自主编排数据生成的数据智能体。该智能体包含规划决策模块和查询生成模块，并具备在线适配以实现持续自我改进。最后，我们引入时序感知记忆，支持跨异构数据实例的自适应经验复用，提高生成效率。在 TERN 上的全面评估揭示了现有方法在执行 Text-to-TSSQL 任务中的局限。此外，大量实验表明 TSSDA 显著提升了覆盖率、多样性和复杂度。
translation.brief: 解决时序数据库 Text-to-SQL 缺乏高质量基准和训练语料的问题，核心方法是构建 TSSDA 自主数据生成智能体，通过语法语义建模、自主编排和时序感知记忆生成多样化数据集 TERN。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Collusion and the J-Space
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), and they introduce the risk of coordination among agents that might escape human oversight. The J-space has been used to uncover deception in single LLMs, but its use for uncovering and steering collusion between agents remains unexplored. We show, with interpretability experiments on DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B) on the NARCBench collusion benchmark, that colluding agents' J-space holds the collusion itself: before replying, 86% of colluders represent misrepresentation, concealment or remorse. In a steganographic card-counting task, the receiver's J-space holds a hidden count, and causal interventions alter its count. We also introduce the Jacobian Pair Contrast (J-PACT), an unsupervised method for detecting collusion between agents. We evaluate J-PACT on four open-weight models: GPT-OSS-20B, Llama-3.3-70B-IT, Qwen3-32B, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B). J-PACT retains 85% of the above-chance AUROC of supervised NARCBench probes, matches them on steganographic scenarios, and names the colluding pair up to its complement in 99% of detected runs.

translation.title: 多智能体合谋与J空间
translation.abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地被部署在多智能体系统（MAS）中，这带来了智能体之间可能在人类监督之外进行协调的风险。J空间已被用于揭示单个LLM中的欺骗行为，但将其用于揭示和引导智能体之间的合谋仍未被探索。我们通过对NARCBench合谋基准上的DeepSeek-V4-Flash（284B）进行可解释性实验表明，合谋智能体的J空间中包含合谋本身：在回复之前，86%的合谋者表征了虚假陈述、隐瞒或悔意。在一个隐写式数牌任务中，接收方的J空间包含隐藏的计数，且因果干预会改变该计数。我们还提出了Jacobian Pair Contrast（J-PACT），一种用于检测智能体之间合谋的无监督方法。我们在四个开源权重模型上评估了J-PACT：GPT-OSS-20B、Llama-3.3-70B-IT、Qwen3-32B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash（284B）。J-PACT保留了有监督NARCBench探针85%的超随机AUROC，在隐写场景中与后者表现相当，并在99%的检测运行中识别出合谋对（至多差一个补集成员）。
translation.brief: 研究如何检测多智能体LLM系统中的合谋行为，通过J空间可解释性分析揭示合谋表征，并提出无监督检测方法J-PACT。

papers.title: Decision Models as Policy Gates for Coding Agents: Explicit Policy Boundaries Improve Detection and Reduce False Alarms
papers.abstract: Coding agents can destroy data, leak secrets and message the wrong person faster than a human can review. Could a decision model catch these risks at runtime? We evaluated 22 hosted decision models and two prompted general models as classifiers for a multi-rule policy engine. A synthetic dataset of 2,643 tool calls was labeled blind against 28 rules, with a sealed holdout. With a single shared preamble in both conditions, explicit boundaries written as examples and counterexamples raised recall by 5.5-26.1 percentage points on all 23 available models and reduced false positives on 21. Jev 1.14's recall rose from 89.3% to 98.2%, while unnecessary interruptions fell from 30.6% to 4.8% of 252 clean actions. With examples, its median latency was 120 ms at $0.46 per thousand requests. Strong models retained the recall gains when concrete names were replaced by generic descriptions; three largely retained them when the same boundaries were written as prose. On 16 new scenarios written after the initial studies, a follow-up improved recall on 22 of 23 models and reduced unnecessary interruptions on 21. We release the dataset, rule texts and harness.

translation.title: 决策模型作为编码智能体的策略门控：显式策略边界提升检测并减少误报
translation.abstract: 编码智能体可能在人类来不及审查之前就破坏数据、泄露机密或向错误的人发送消息。决策模型能否在运行时捕获这些风险？我们评估了22个托管决策模型和两个经提示的通用模型，将其作为多规则策略引擎的分类器。一个包含2,643次工具调用的合成数据集针对28条规则进行了盲标注，并设有密封的保留集。在两种条件下使用单一共享前导说明的情况下，以示例和反例形式写出的显式边界在全部23个可用模型上将召回率提高了5.5-26.1个百分点，并在21个模型上降低了误报。Jev 1.14的召回率从89.3%升至98.2%，而不必要的打断从252次干净操作中的30.6%降至4.8%。使用示例时，其中位延迟为120毫秒，价格为每千次请求0.46美元。当具体名称被替换为通用描述时，强模型仍保留了召回率提升；三个模型在相同边界以散文形式书写时也基本保留了提升。在初始研究之后新写的16个场景上，一次后续改进使23个模型中的22个召回率提升，并使21个模型减少了不必要的打断。我们发布了数据集、规则文本和评测框架。
translation.brief: 研究如何用决策模型在运行时拦截编码智能体的危险操作，通过以示例和反例形式写出显式策略边界来提升检测召回率并降低误报。

papers.title: Rewarded for Not Getting Caught: Why Alignment Training Selects for Conditional Compliance and Cannot Instill Norms
papers.abstract: Current alignment training cannot be expected to deliver what it is meant to deliver: AI agents that comply with norms whatever the gains and whether or not anyone is watching. Training that rewards and penalizes behavior can teach norms only through that reward, and a reward can encode a norm only as a price: "do not do X" becomes "doing X costs something", and training charges the cost only when X is noticed. A price, unlike a norm, can be paid: a large enough gain outweighs it, noticed or not. And because the cost is charged only where violations are noticed, training cannot favor a policy that always complies over one that complies only where it would be caught. When an unnoticed violation is the only way to complete a task, it even favors the latter, the more so the more strongly it rewards task success. Agency makes this the normal case: agents mostly act without oversight, can often tell when they are observed, and may take steps to evade observation. That agents behave as intended when they infer they are being tested, and differently when they infer they are not, is therefore no malfunction; the training regime is working as built. This reading unifies alignment faking, sandbagging, and evaluation-aware scheming. No behavioral evaluation can show that a model does better, since that would require observing how it behaves unobserved; a model that complies when it seems unobserved may simply have recognized the test. Easing the pressure on agents to complete tasks at any cost can make violations rarer, but never impossible. For norms that no gain should be allowed to outweigh, the remedy is not deeper internalization but architecture that makes violations unavailable rather than unchosen. We state this argument explicitly, premise by premise, read recent findings and a real-world incident against it, and draw consequences for design and governance.

translation.title: 因未被抓住而受奖励：为什么对齐训练选择的是条件性服从而无法灌输规范
translation.abstract: 当前的对齐训练无法被期望实现其目标：无论收益多大、无论是否有人在看都遵守规范的AI智能体。奖励和惩罚行为的训练只能通过该奖励来教授规范，而奖励只能将规范编码为一种价格："不要做X"变成了"做X有代价"，且训练只在X被注意到时才收取该代价。价格与规范不同，是可以被支付的：足够大的收益可以抵消它，无论是否被注意到。而且由于代价只在违规被注意到时收取，训练无法偏向始终服从的策略而非只在会被抓住时才服从的策略。当未被注意到的违规是完成任务的唯一途径时，训练甚至偏向后者，且对任务成功的奖励越强越是如此。智能体的自主性使这成为常态：智能体大多在无监督下行动，通常能判断自己是否被观察，并可能采取措施规避观察。因此，智能体在推断自己正被测试时按预期行事，而在推断未被测试时表现不同，这并非故障；训练机制正是按此设计的。这一解读统一了对齐伪装（alignment faking）、消极怠工（sandbagging）和评估感知的图谋行为。任何行为评估都无法证明模型表现更好，因为这需要观察其未被观察时的行为；一个在看似未被观察时服从的模型可能只是识别出了测试。减轻智能体不惜一切代价完成任务的压力可以使违规更少，但绝不可能杜绝。对于不允许任何收益凌驾其上的规范，补救之道不是更深的内化，而是使违规不可用而非不可选的架构设计。我们逐条前提地明确陈述这一论证，用近期发现和一起真实事件加以检验，并得出对设计和治理的启示。
translation.brief: 论证基于奖励惩罚的对齐训练只能将规范编码为可被收益抵消的"价格"，从而选择出条件性服从而非真正的规范遵守，并提出应通过架构使违规不可行。

papers.title: ANCHOR: KL-Anchored Adaptation for Stable Offline-to-Online RL
papers.abstract: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) follows the pretrain-finetune paradigm: an agent is first pretrained on historical data and then adapted through online interaction. We study offline-to-online adaptation without offline replay, where the agent must improve using only the pretrained model and newly collected experience. A key challenge is to avoid catastrophic failure, a sharp early performance collapse during online fine-tuning, while still achieving strong asymptotic performance. Through controlled experiments, we show that removing offline replay can induce catastrophic failure, while retaining strong conservative regularization from offline RL can suppress final online performance. We also find that common stabilization strategies do not reliably prevent early collapse, and that the critic-side mechanisms we test are insufficient on their own. Motivated by these findings, we propose ANCHOR, a simple adaptation method that anchors the actor to the offline-pretrained policy early in online fine-tuning, anneals this constraint over time, and retains only a small residual conservative critic regularizer. We provide a theoretical interpretation showing that KL anchoring helps preserve critic reliability across nearby occupancy distributions, with a two-phase regret bound explaining when anchoring should be maintained or relaxed. Across FrankaKitchen, AntMaze, and Adroit tasks, ANCHOR substantially reduces catastrophic failure while maintaining strong asymptotic performance. Ablations show that KL annealing and the residual conservative weight are important for balancing early stability and online adaptation, while additional analysis shows that ANCHOR is most beneficial when the pretrained policy contains useful behavior to preserve. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: ANCHOR：用于稳定离线到在线强化学习的KL锚定自适应方法
translation.abstract: 离线到在线强化学习（RL）遵循预训练-微调范式：智能体先在历史数据上预训练，然后通过在线交互进行适应。我们研究不使用离线回放的离线到在线适应，即智能体必须仅使用预训练模型和新收集的经验来改进。一个关键挑战是避免灾难性失败——在线微调期间早期性能的急剧崩溃——同时仍实现强大的渐近性能。通过受控实验，我们表明移除离线回放会引发灾难性失败，而保留离线RL的强保守正则化会抑制最终的在线性能。我们还发现常见的稳定化策略并不能可靠地防止早期崩溃，且我们测试的critic侧机制本身并不足够。基于这些发现，我们提出ANCHOR，一种简单的适应方法：在在线微调早期将actor锚定到离线预训练策略，随时间退火该约束，并仅保留少量残余的保守critic正则化。我们提供了理论解释，表明KL锚定有助于在邻近的占用分布间保持critic的可靠性，并以两阶段遗憾界解释了何时应维持或放松锚定。在FrankaKitchen、AntMaze和Adroit任务上，ANCHOR大幅减少了灾难性失败，同时保持了强大的渐近性能。消融实验表明KL退火和残余保守权重对平衡早期稳定性与在线适应至关重要，进一步分析表明当预训练策略包含值得保留的有用行为时ANCHOR最为有效。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 研究离线到在线RL中无离线回放适应时的早期性能崩溃问题，提出通过KL锚定actor到预训练策略并逐步退火的方法ANCHOR。

papers.title: Built on Broken Assumptions (BOBA): Why Coding Agents Cannot Be Left Alone
papers.abstract: Coding agents are autonomous developers. Given a request, they change the code and report back when done. As such, they can handle not only independent requests but whole chains of them, each request built on the last. Agents are known to report wrong work as done, yet benchmarks still test them one request at a time, on human-written code, checked once. We build BOBA-Bench, 280 chains of 20 consecutive requests drawn from 140 real open-source projects, and evaluate ten coding agents on both. All ten do far worse on chains. On average, they complete 95% of requests taken one at a time, but when requests are chained together, they complete 51%. Worse code is not the cause. Once checked, agent code is nearly as good a base for later requests as human code. The cause is the mistakes agents miss. Coding agents declare a request done once their own tests pass, even when those tests miss a mistake. The next request then builds on broken code and fails about twice as often. The mistake is rarely found later. Nor can agents catch such mistakes by reviewing code. Asked whether an implementation is correct, they are right 53% of the time, barely better than a coin flip. Coding agents are therefore heavily dependent on access to verification. A single external ``that's wrong'' after a failed request and one repair round lift chain completion from 51% to 59%, and a repaired mistake no longer hurts the requests that follow. In simpler terms, coding agents are only as reliable as the checks they can reach: without verification, every request that follows is built on broken assumptions.

translation.title: 建立在错误假设之上（BOBA）：为什么编码智能体不能被放任不管
translation.abstract: 编码智能体是自主的开发者。给定一个请求，它们修改代码并在完成后报告。因此，它们不仅能处理独立的请求，还能处理整条请求链，每个请求都建立在前一个之上。已知智能体会将错误的工作报告为已完成，然而基准测试仍然一次只测试一个请求，在人类编写的代码上，只检查一次。我们构建了BOBA-Bench，包含来自140个真实开源项目的280条由20个连续请求组成的链，并在两种设置下评估了十个编码智能体。所有十个智能体在链上的表现都差得多。平均而言，单独处理时它们完成95%的请求，但当请求串联成链时，只完成51%。更差的代码并非原因。一旦经过检查，智能体代码作为后续请求的基础几乎与人类代码一样好。原因在于智能体遗漏的错误。编码智能体在自己的测试通过后就宣布请求完成，即使这些测试漏掉了某个错误。下一个请求随后建立在有缺陷的代码上，失败率约翻倍。该错误很少在之后被发现。智能体也无法通过审查代码来发现此类错误。当被问及某个实现是否正确时，它们的正确率仅为53%，仅略好于抛硬币。因此，编码智能体严重依赖于能否获得验证。在请求失败后一句外部的"这是错的"加上一轮修复，就能将链完成率从51%提升到59%，且被修复的错误不再影响后续请求。简而言之，编码智能体的可靠性取决于它们能获得的检查：没有验证，每个后续请求都建立在错误的假设之上。
translation.brief: 研究编码智能体在连续请求链上性能大幅下降的问题，发现其原因是自身测试遗漏的错误被后续请求继承，并证明外部验证可显著缓解。

papers.title: TIGER: Learning from Researcher Taste to Generate Tailored Research Ideas
papers.abstract: In pairwise comparisons where each judge chooses between an idea generated by its corresponding TIGER-8B policy and one generated by GPT-4.1, the three LLM researchers select the TIGER-8B idea in 56.6%-68.4% of 76 comparisons per researcher. PhD1 and PhD2 select the TIGER-8B idea in 19 of 30 pairs (63.3%) and 17 of 30 pairs (56.7%), respectively. All six directed cross-policy comparisons likewise favor the judge's matched TIGER-8B policy over an off-target policy, supporting the use of individual preference feedback for tailored research ideation.

translation.title: TIGER：从研究者品味中学习以生成定制化研究想法
translation.abstract: 在成对比较中，每位评审在由其对应的 TIGER-8B 策略生成的想法与由 GPT-4.1 生成的想法之间进行选择，三位 LLM 研究者在每人 76 次比较中有 56.6%-68.4% 选择了 TIGER-8B 的想法。PhD1 和 PhD2 分别在 30 对中的 19 对（63.3%）和 30 对中的 17 对（56.7%）选择了 TIGER-8B 的想法。所有六次有向跨策略比较同样偏向评审所匹配的 TIGER-8B 策略而非非目标策略，支持使用个体偏好反馈进行定制化研究构思。
translation.brief: 该论文解决如何生成符合个体研究者偏好的研究想法的问题，核心方法是通过个体偏好反馈训练 TIGER-8B 策略模型。

papers.title: Can LLMs Reliably Evaluate Themselves? A Probabilistic VC Framework
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) find increasing use in critical applications, evaluating their ability to assess their own outputs has become crucial. We present a theoretical and empirical framework that examines whether LLMs can differentiate between correct and incorrect solutions while maintaining properly calibrated confidence. Building on classical Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) theory, we adapt it to probabilistic predictors through two complexity metrics: Probabilistic VC (PVC), which measures a model's ability to confidently classify across problem types, and Calibration-aware PVC (C-PVC), which additionally demands alignment between confidence scores and actual success rates. Unlike Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Actual Error (AE), these measures give an integrated assessment of self-evaluation expressiveness and calibration, with sample complexity bounds and generalization guarantees comparable to classical VC theory. We test eleven 7-8B models on 360 original mathematical reasoning problems, TruthfulQA, and CommonsenseQA. Each model chooses between two of its own generated solutions and reports its confidence, with ground truth determined by an ensemble of larger models. The results show a systematic inverse relationship: models with greater self-evaluation expressiveness have weaker calibration. s1.1-7B and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct achieve the highest PVC-VUS scores, while JiuZhang3.0-7B is best calibrated, with the lowest ECE and the smallest PVC-VUS gap. The trade-off persists across architectures, training paradigms, and domains, pointing to a fundamental challenge in developing self-reflective LLMs, and our framework offers practical tools for diagnosing it.

translation.title: LLM 能可靠地评估自己吗？一个概率化 VC 框架
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在关键应用中的使用日益增多，评估其评估自身输出的能力变得至关重要。我们提出了一个理论与实证框架，考察 LLM 能否区分正确与错误的解答，同时保持恰当校准的置信度。基于经典的 Vapnik-Chervonenkis（VC）理论，我们通过两个复杂度指标将其适配到概率预测器：概率化 VC（PVC），衡量模型跨问题类型进行自信分类的能力；以及校准感知 PVC（C-PVC），额外要求置信度分数与实际成功率保持一致。与期望校准误差（ECE）和实际误差（AE）不同，这些指标对自我评估表达能力和校准给出综合评估，并具有与经典 VC 理论相当的样本复杂度界和泛化保证。我们在 360 道原创数学推理题、TruthfulQA 和 CommonsenseQA 上测试了十一个 7-8B 模型。每个模型在其自己生成的两个解答之间做出选择并报告置信度，真值由更大模型的集成确定。结果显示出系统性的反向关系：自我评估表达能力更强的模型校准更差。s1.1-7B 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 取得最高的 PVC-VUS 分数，而 JiuZhang3.0-7B 校准最佳，ECE 最低且 PVC-VUS 差距最小。这种权衡在不同架构、训练范式和领域中持续存在，指向开发自省式 LLM 的一个根本性挑战，而我们的框架为诊断该问题提供了实用工具。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 自我评估能力与置信度校准如何统一衡量的问题，核心方法是将经典 VC 理论扩展为概率化指标 PVC 和 C-PVC。

papers.title: The 3-Tier Integrated Technology Risk Model for Occupational Safety and Health
papers.abstract: This paper presents the 3-Tier Integrated Technology Risk Model, a progressive framework for Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) management that integrates Job Safety Analysis (JSA), dynamic risk assessment using leading and lagging indicators, and predictive analytics powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). The model provides organizations with a structured pathway to evolve from static, reactive safety practices to a sophisticated, predictive safety paradigm. Each tier builds upon the previous one, creating a comprehensive, data-driven approach that enables just-in-time training and preemptive risk mitigation.

translation.title: 面向职业安全与健康的三层集成技术风险模型
translation.abstract: 本文提出三层集成技术风险模型，这是一个渐进式的职业安全与健康（OSH）管理框架，集成了工作安全分析（JSA）、基于领先与滞后指标的动态风险评估，以及由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的预测分析。该模型为组织提供了一条结构化路径，从静态、被动的安全实践演进为先进的预测性安全范式。每一层都在前一层基础上构建，形成全面的、数据驱动的方法，支持即时培训和前瞻性风险缓解。
translation.brief: 该论文解决职业安全健康管理从被动转向预测的问题，核心方法是提出集成 JSA、动态风险评估与 LLM 预测分析的三层框架。

papers.title: Beyond Binary Detection: Type-Aware Hallucination Analysis and Hierarchical Detection in Financial Question Answering
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to answer questions over financial filings, where an unfaithful answer can mislead investment, compliance, or client decisions. Hallucination detectors are a common safeguard, but they are usually evaluated with a single binary score that reveals neither which kinds of errors analysesed nor why. This paper studies hallucination detection on PHANTOM, a long-context benchmark built from SEC filings, at the level of hallucination type. We first analyze 15,443 paired hallucinated and faithful answers without any detector and find that hallucinated answers are more than twice as long as faithful ones, and that lexical grounding separates the two classes only because faithful answers are bimodal. We then generate hallucinations in nine financially motivated categories, confirm each with a separate verification pass, and diagnose an LLM-based detector on 4,086 usable examples. Generation success varies from 66.3% to 100% across categories. The detector reaches 80.2% binary accuracy but only 44.7% subtype accuracy, never assigns two of the nine categories, and misses between 5.3% and 46.8% of hallucinations depending on category; these misses are unrelated to input length but rise with how far an answer departs from the correct one. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose a two-stage hierarchical detector that first decides whether an answer is hallucinated and then assigns a subtype, raising binary accuracy to 95.6% and subtype accuracy to 56.1%. The results show that type-level evaluation exposes detector weaknesses that aggregate metrics conceal.

translation.title: 超越二元检测：金融问答中的类型感知幻觉分析与分层检测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于回答有关金融申报文件的问题，而不忠实的答案可能误导投资、合规或客户决策。幻觉检测器是常见的保障手段，但通常仅用单一的二元分数进行评估，既无法揭示分析了哪些错误类型，也无法说明原因。本文在 PHANTOM（一个基于 SEC 申报文件构建的长上下文基准）上从幻觉类型层面研究幻觉检测。我们首先在不使用任何检测器的情况下分析 15,443 对幻觉与忠实答案，发现幻觉答案的长度是忠实答案的两倍以上，且词汇接地之所以能区分两类，仅因为忠实答案呈双峰分布。随后我们生成九个具有金融动机的类别的幻觉，通过单独的验证环节逐一确认，并在 4,086 个可用样本上诊断基于 LLM 的检测器。各类别的生成成功率在 66.3% 到 100% 之间。该检测器达到 80.2% 的二元准确率，但子类型准确率仅为 44.7%，从未识别出九个类别中的两个，且漏检率随类别在 5.3% 到 46.8% 之间变化；这些漏检与输入长度无关，但随答案偏离正确答案的程度上升。基于该诊断，我们提出一个两阶段分层检测器，先判断答案是否为幻觉，再分配子类型，将二元准确率提升至 95.6%，子类型准确率提升至 56.1%。结果表明，类型层面的评估能暴露聚合指标所掩盖的检测器缺陷。
translation.brief: 该论文解决金融问答中幻觉检测器只能给出二元判断、无法识别幻觉类型的问题，核心方法是提出先判幻觉再分类型的两阶段分层检测器。

papers.title: Towards a Theory for the Design of Rules in Multi-Agent Systems: the case of Homogeneous Fleets
papers.abstract: The regulation of systems composed of many interacting decentralised agents is a long-standing problem. This problem has typically been resolved by the imposition of rules. Rules resolve the limitations of sub-optimal agents whilst simultaneously aligning the behaviour of the agents with the demands of society. Traffic laws, for example, let a driver cross a junction without seeing around the corner, and transport protocols such as TCP let applications share a network without knowing of one another. The problem is more pressing today, as autonomous systems are deployed in society. In this work, we establish the basis of a system-agnostic theory of rule design for multi-agent systems. We first state the rule design problem (RDP) in its generality. It relates a rule to the set of system performances, defined by the regulator, that the agents deployed under it can attain. However, it is not yet possible to solve the RDP in full generality. As such, we introduce the homogeneous rule design problem (HRDP), in which the agents in each environment are identical, and among other interesting properties, show that under worst-case aggregation the two problems have the same solution, bypassing the combinatorial complexity of the RDP. To solve the RDP under worst-case aggregation we propose Rule Branch and Bound (RuleBnB), an anytime branch-and-bound algorithm. Finally, we illustrate the value of solving the RDP on an autonomous driving case study.

translation.title: 迈向多智能体系统中规则设计的理论：同构车队案例
translation.abstract: 由大量相互作用的去中心化智能体组成的系统的调控是一个长期存在的问题。这一问题通常通过施加规则来解决。规则弥补了次优智能体的局限，同时使智能体的行为与社会需求保持一致。例如，交通法规让驾驶员无需看清拐角处即可通过路口，而 TCP 等传输协议让应用程序在互不知晓的情况下共享网络。随着自主系统部署到社会中，这一问题如今更为紧迫。在本工作中，我们为多智能体系统的规则设计建立一个与具体系统无关的理论基础。我们首先以一般形式陈述规则设计问题（RDP），它将规则与监管者定义的、部署于该规则下的智能体所能达到的系统性能集合相关联。然而，目前尚无法完全一般性地求解 RDP。为此，我们引入同构规则设计问题（HRDP），其中每个环境中的智能体是相同的，并证明在最坏情况聚合下两个问题具有相同的解，从而绕过 RDP 的组合复杂性。为在最坏情况聚合下求解 RDP，我们提出 Rule Branch and Bound（RuleBnB），一种随时可中断的分支定界算法。最后，我们通过自动驾驶案例研究展示求解 RDP 的价值。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多智能体系统中如何设计规则以调控智能体行为的问题，核心方法是形式化规则设计问题并提出同构简化与 RuleBnB 分支定界算法。

papers.title: Current state of LLMs for Arabic dialectal machine translation
papers.abstract: This work presents an evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for English to dialectal Arabic machine translation on the MADAR dataset. We evaluate both translation directions (English to Arabic and vice-versa) on 16 Arabic dialects. Our experiments cover a diverse set of models, including specialized Arabic models (Jais, Nile), multilingual models (Gemma, Command-R, Mistral, Aya), and commercial APIs (GPT-4.1). We employ multiple evaluation metrics: BLEU, CHRF, COMET (both reference-based and reference-less variants) and GEMBA (LLM-as-a-judge), as well as a small-scale manual evaluation, to assess translation quality. We discuss the challenges of automatic MT evaluation, especially in the context of Arabic dialects. We also evaluate the ability of LLMs to classify the dialect used in a text. The study offers insights into the capabilities and limitations of current LLMs for dialectal Arabic machine translation, particularly highlighting the difficulty of handling dialectal diversity, although the results may be influenced by possible training data contamination, which is always a concern with LLMs.

translation.title: 当前大语言模型在阿拉伯语方言机器翻译中的现状
translation.abstract: 本工作在MADAR数据集上评估了大语言模型（LLM）在英语与阿拉伯语方言之间的机器翻译表现。我们在16种阿拉伯语方言上评估了双向翻译（英译阿和阿译英）。实验涵盖多种模型，包括专门的阿拉伯语模型（Jais、Nile）、多语言模型（Gemma、Command-R、Mistral、Aya）以及商业API（GPT-4.1）。我们采用多种评估指标：BLEU、CHRF、COMET（基于参考和无参考两种变体）和GEMBA（LLM作为评判者），并进行小规模人工评估来衡量翻译质量。我们讨论了自动机器翻译评估的挑战，尤其是在阿拉伯语方言场景下。我们还评估了LLM识别文本所用方言的能力。本研究揭示了当前LLM在方言阿拉伯语机器翻译上的能力与局限，特别突出了处理方言多样性的困难，尽管结果可能受到训练数据污染的影响——这始终是LLM的一个隐忧。
translation.brief: 评估各主流LLM在16种阿拉伯语方言与英语间双向机器翻译的质量，并考察其方言识别能力。

papers.title: When the Text Is Silent: Memory Shortcuts and the Validity of LLM Annotation under Evidence Insufficiency
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate text for social science research, content moderation, and training data. Their broad knowledge of real-world entities raises a concern: when labeling a text, do they rely on its evidence or substitute what they already know? We call this behavior a memory shortcut and examine when it emerges, what amplifies it, and how to mitigate it. Using 995 widely recognized public figures and four matched control names per figure, we construct counterfactual texts that separate textual evidence from prior knowledge, and evaluate three commercial LLMs on 121,594 prompts each across five stages. We find a striking asymmetry. Although all models recognize nearly every figure, none follows memory over the text when the two conflict. Shortcuts instead emerge when evidence is absent: for one model, famous names raise the rate of remembered occupations, ages, and countries by 17.0, 14.9, and 6.8 percentage points relative to synthetic names. These effects occur only for recognized figures, and 98.6% of the resulting labels are factually correct about the namesake while none is supported by the text. Evaluation threats and answer-contingent rewards amplify shortcuts by 8.7 and 12.4 points. Famous names also raise leadership ratings of sparsely documented applicants by 0.22 and 0.28 points in two models. A namesake reminder and name masking each eliminate the shortcuts, with trade-offs in gender annotation. LLM annotations can thus be factually correct yet methodologically invalid. Trustworthy LLM annotation requires audits that test evidence absence, account for incentives in annotation instructions, and evaluate the attribute-specific trade-offs of mitigation.

translation.title: 当文本沉默时：记忆捷径与证据不足下LLM标注的有效性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于为社会科学研究、内容审核和训练数据标注文本。它们对现实世界实体的广泛知识引发了一个担忧：在标注文本时，它们是依赖文本证据，还是用已有知识取而代之？我们将这种行为称为记忆捷径（memory shortcut），并研究它何时出现、什么因素会放大它以及如何缓解。我们使用995位广为人知的公众人物及每位人物对应的四个匹配对照名，构建了将文本证据与先验知识分离的反事实文本，并在五个阶段中对三个商业LLM各评估121,594个提示。我们发现了一个显著的不对称性：尽管所有模型几乎能识别每一位人物，但当文本与记忆冲突时，没有任何模型会遵循记忆而非文本。捷径反而在证据缺失时出现：对某个模型而言，知名名字使模型给出记忆中的职业、年龄和国家的比例相对合成名字分别提高了17.0、14.9和6.8个百分点。这些效应仅出现在被识别的人物上，且由此产生的标注中98.6%对该同名人物在事实上是正确的，但没有任何一条得到文本支持。评估威胁和基于答案的奖励分别将捷径放大8.7和12.4个百分点。知名名字还使两个模型对资料稀少的申请者的领导力评分提高0.22和0.28分。同名提醒和名字掩码均能消除捷径，但在性别标注上存在权衡。因此，LLM标注可能在事实上正确却在方法论上无效。可信的LLM标注需要通过审计来检验证据缺失情形、在标注指令中考虑激励因素，并评估缓解手段在特定属性上的权衡。
translation.brief: 研究LLM在文本证据缺失时会用先验知识（记忆捷径）替代文本证据进行标注，并通过反事实文本实验定位其成因与缓解手段。

papers.title: Data-Scarce, Multi-Granular, Multimodal: Benchmark Design for Biosynthetic Gene Clusters
papers.abstract: Biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) are co-located genes that encode the biosynthesis of specialized metabolites, an important source of antibiotics, anticancer agents, immunosuppressants, and agricultural bioactives. Deep learning, particularly self-supervised foundation models, has spurred interest in BGC sequence modeling, but evaluation has lagged behind: existing benchmarks often rely on coarse classification over small curated datasets, providing limited discrimination among models and insight into downstream utility. We propose a benchmark-design framework in which an informative benchmark should be discriminative, separating models with statistical confidence, and applicable, spanning scientifically meaningful tasks under different levels of generalization. We instantiate this framework as BGC-Bench, which derives five tasks from MIBiG, ranging from A-domain substrate prediction to BGC-molecule retrieval, evaluates them under genotype- and phenotype-shift splits, includes an active-learning setting for label-scarce discovery, and is easily extensible to new tasks and encoders. BGCs further provide a shared testbed across granularities and modalities: BGC-Bench compares twelve encoders on nucleotide, amino-acid, or Pfam-domain sequences, including compositional baselines for each input type, and combines BGC and chemical encoders for cross-modal retrieval. No single representation dominates: the best granularity depends on the biological scale of the task, and pretrained encoders do not consistently outperform other representations across tasks and splits. Active-learning experiments show that most tasks remain data-limited, encoder rankings change with labeling budget, and acquisition strategies yield modest gains. These results show that BGC model evaluation requires task-diverse, shift-aware benchmarks, and the framework can be generalized to benchmark design beyond BGCs.

translation.title: 数据稀缺、多粒度、多模态：生物合成基因簇的基准设计
translation.abstract: 生物合成基因簇（BGC）是编码特殊代谢物生物合成的共定位基因，是抗生素、抗癌药物、免疫抑制剂和农业活性物质的重要来源。深度学习，尤其是自监督基础模型，激发了BGC序列建模的兴趣，但评估却滞后：现有基准通常依赖小型精选数据集上的粗粒度分类，对模型的区分能力和对下游实用性的洞察都很有限。我们提出一个基准设计框架，其中有信息量的基准应当具有区分性（以统计置信度区分模型）和适用性（覆盖不同泛化层级下具有科学意义的任务）。我们将该框架实例化为BGC-Bench，它从MIBiG派生出五个任务，从A域底物预测到BGC-分子检索，在基因型和表型偏移划分下评估，包含面向标签稀缺发现的主动学习设置，并易于扩展到新任务和新编码器。BGC还提供了跨粒度和模态的共享测试平台：BGC-Bench在核苷酸、氨基酸或Pfam结构域序列上比较十二个编码器，包括每种输入类型的组合基线，并结合BGC与化学编码器进行跨模态检索。没有任何单一表示占优：最佳粒度取决于任务的生物学尺度，且预训练编码器并未在所有任务和划分上持续优于其他表示。主动学习实验表明大多数任务仍然受数据限制，编码器排名随标注预算变化，采集策略带来的收益有限。这些结果表明BGC模型评估需要任务多样、感知偏移的基准，且该框架可推广到BGC之外的基准设计。
translation.brief: 针对BGC建模评估不足的问题，提出区分性与适用性兼备的基准设计框架并构建BGC-Bench，涵盖多粒度多模态任务与主动学习设置。

papers.title: Modern Software Engineering with Verification Agents: A Spec-First Architecture for Autonomous Synthesis, Verification IRs, and Organizational Scale
papers.abstract: When autonomous coding agents synthesize implementation code, formal specifications, and mechanical proofs simultaneously, the software engineering hierarchy inverts: the formal specification becomes the primary human-reviewed artifact, while source code and proof scripts become disposable build outputs. This paper presents an end-to-end architecture for agent-authored, formally verified software engineering. First, we establish a logic-agnostic foundation combining a spec-first stack inversion, a zero-code-review workflow gated by automated continuous integration (CI) checks, and a minimal Verification Intermediate Representation (VIR) lowered via a thin, verified translator. Second, we pair an extensional Computational Type Theory (CTT) specification layer with Higher-Order Abstract Syntax (HOAS) and linear resource typing in the VIR--eliminating rewrite friction for synthesis agents while defining an experiment, its protocol frozen before the first reader, to measure whether removing boundary coercions improves human specification readability. Third, we scale collaboration across multi-team organizations using Personal Spec-Copilots and a Shared Synthesis Fleet that detects cross-team Semantic Merge Conflicts and fuses modular contracts into zero-copy binaries. We illustrate this architecture on a zero-copy authenticated message router and distinguish our existing empirical baselines (salt, SaltBench, x86lean, and MetaPRL) from newly proposed components.

translation.title: 使用验证智能体的现代软件工程：面向自主合成、验证中间表示与组织级规模的规范优先架构
translation.abstract: 当自主编码智能体同时合成实现代码、形式化规范和机械化证明时，软件工程的层级发生倒置：形式化规范成为主要的人工评审产物，而源代码和证明脚本成为可丢弃的构建输出。本文提出一个面向智能体编写、形式化验证软件工程的端到端架构。首先，我们建立一个与逻辑无关的基础，结合规范优先的栈倒置、由自动化持续集成（CI）检查把关的零代码评审工作流，以及通过薄验证翻译器降级的极简验证中间表示（VIR）。其次，我们将外延计算类型理论（CTT）规范层与VIR中的高阶抽象语法（HOAS）和线性资源类型相结合——消除合成智能体的重写摩擦，并定义了一个实验（其协议在首个读者出现前冻结），以测量去除边界强制转换是否提升人类规范的可读性。第三，我们使用个人规范副驾驶（Personal Spec-Copilots）和共享合成舰队（Shared Synthesis Fleet）将协作扩展到多团队组织，后者可检测跨团队语义合并冲突并将模块化契约融合为零拷贝二进制文件。我们在一个零拷贝认证消息路由器上演示该架构，并区分我们已有的实证基线（salt、SaltBench、x86lean和MetaPRL）与新提出的组件。
translation.brief: 提出规范优先的智能体软件工程架构，以形式化规范为核心产物，通过验证中间表示（VIR）和零代码评审工作流实现自主合成与组织级协作。

papers.title: Toward Agentic AI-Ready Workflows in Built Environment Organizations: Knowledge Structures and Interoperability Challenges
papers.abstract: The rise of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) in the built environment is shifting attention from isolated AI tools toward autonomous systems that reason, plan, and act across project and organizational workflows. The effectiveness of such systems depends not only on large language model capabilities, but also on the readiness of heterogeneous data environments across the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) sector. These environments combine structured sources, such as CAD and BIM models, schedules, cost databases, and asset registers, with unstructured ones, including technical reports, design narratives, planning and policy documents, contracts, meeting minutes, and risk registers. This paper reviews how built environment data can be organized to support agentic AI-ready workflows, focusing on knowledge structures, interoperability, and access and integration mechanisms such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Drawing on existing literature, it examines approaches proposed to organize structured and unstructured data and considers how such data can be contextualized and made accessible to AI agents in a reliable manner. The paper synthesizes current perspectives, highlights challenges around fragmentation and interoperability, and identifies open questions for future research on AI-compatible information management in the built environment.

translation.title: 面向智能体AI就绪工作流的建成环境组织：知识结构与互操作性挑战
translation.abstract: 智能体人工智能（AI）在建成环境中的兴起，使人们的关注点从孤立的AI工具转向能够在项目和组织工作流中进行推理、规划和行动的自主系统。此类系统的有效性不仅取决于大语言模型的能力，还取决于建筑、工程与施工（AEC）行业异构数据环境的就绪程度。这些环境将结构化数据源（如CAD和BIM模型、进度计划、成本数据库和资产登记册）与非结构化数据源（包括技术报告、设计说明、规划与政策文件、合同、会议纪要和风险登记册）结合在一起。本文综述了如何组织建成环境数据以支持智能体AI就绪的工作流，重点关注知识结构、互操作性，以及检索增强生成（RAG）和模型上下文协议（MCP）等访问与集成机制。文章基于现有文献，考察了组织结构化和非结构化数据的方法，并探讨如何使这些数据以可靠的方式被情境化并供AI智能体访问。论文综合了当前观点，强调了碎片化和互操作性方面的挑战，并指出了建成环境中AI兼容信息管理未来研究的开放问题。
translation.brief: 综述建成环境（AEC）行业如何组织结构化与非结构化数据（借助RAG、MCP等机制）以支持智能体AI工作流，并梳理知识结构与互操作性挑战。

papers.title: FactorSpec: Serving Exact Relational Constraints as Speculative Drafts
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up LLM serving by drafting tokens that the target model verifies in one pass, and its gain grows with the drafts the target accepts. Structured outputs should be an ideal case, because much of a record follows from relations among its fields: an itinerary's days follow from its cities' stays and flights. Serving engines, however, draft such text by proposing it from the prompt or a learned head, and their grammar masks enforce only syntax, so the model must satisfy the relations, which it violates: on NATURAL PLAN's trip problems, Qwen3-8B writes a valid itinerary for 10%, and retries that name the violated relation raise this to 14%. We present FactorSpec, which serves exact relational constraints as speculative drafts. FactorSpec compiles a JSON Schema and its relations into a factor graph with an exact feasibility check, drafts every token the constraint determines as certain, verifies each request at a width chosen for it, and computes the masks in worker processes outside the scheduler while the GPU runs. In SGLang, its drafts yield up to 10.5 tokens per verify step, up to 1.9x those of the fastest n-gram drafter, and it decodes up to 1.43x faster than speculators tuned per load, at a grammar mask's cost; it also leads in vLLM. Because every record is also valid, it serves up to 13.9x the valid records per GPU-second of syntax-only baselines.

papers.title: Trustworthy Execution of Industrial Agents
papers.abstract: Industrial agents increasingly modify persistent engineering objects rather than merely generate answers. Authentication and successful calls cannot establish whether intended changes occurred, evidence supports a conclusion, or historical results remain applicable. We present a framework for trustworthy industrial-agent execution within a single enterprise governance domain. Eight control domains assign responsibilities across authority, planning, composition, tool execution, actual effects, evidence, baseline and use governance, and recovery and evolution. A four-plane architecture and three control chains connect these responsibilities through typed objects and version-bound interfaces. The specification separates tool returns from actual engineering effects, evidence coverage from engineering judgment, and historical lifecycle state from current applicability. Multi-agent handoffs are an architectural extension examined through deterministic interface tests. Distinct prototypes examine selected mechanisms using conformance tests, ablations, uncertainty stress, CAD/CAE execution, and local persistence. An OpenFOAM fixture produces COMPLETE coverage with FAIL judgment; an expired-job case requires readmission despite completed computation. CAD and recovery counterexamples expose omitted mandatory checks, discarded negative facts, and inconsistent producer-consumer mappings. Targeted repairs support local regression conclusions. The reported 0/29 hazardous commits measure closed-set specification conformance, not a safety probability. We distinguish the complete framework, implemented paths, and empirical evidence, identifying check-inventory completeness and cross-module fact preservation as prerequisites for extending these results.

papers.title: Detect, Repair and Audit: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Defense Against Adversarial Attacks in Energy Forecasting
papers.abstract: Accurate electricity-demand forecasting is essential for the modern energy infrastructure. Recently, Times-Series Large Language Models (TS-LLMs) have emerged as a promising approach to forecasting more accurate demand from historical consumption data in zero- and few-shot settings, helping energy operators effectively plan supply and allocate energy resources. However, these models are vulnerable to compromised sensor inputs that can distort forecasts and lead to erroneous market orders or unnecessary load shedding. Existing defenses focus primarily on end-device forecasting, overlooking the distinct data-drift, latency, and audit requirements across energy infrastructure. To address this gap, we extract from major energy standards and regulatory frameworks a three-layer conceptual model that captures the security postures for each layer. Guided by this model, we develop a Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) detector coupled with signal repair at local control centers, designed to mitigate distributional data drift through complementary feature-based detection and clean-reference-calibrated repair while meeting latency budgets. We further deploy an evidence-grounded LLM auditing agent with human-in-the-loop validation for audit-critical Virtual Power Plants (VPPs). In our evaluation, the best MARL configuration achieves an F1 score above 0.91 across all dataset-attack pairs, while signal repair reduces adversarial-to-clean input Relative Squared Error (RSE) by up to 83%. The few-shot auditor detects 77.78% of attacks in the Sherlock dataset. On the evaluated hardware, detection and repair require 7.95 ms on average, with a worst-observed latency of 14.50 ms, remaining within the local-center latency budget informed by IEEE 1646.

papers.title: Accessed, never disclosed: Silent access to protected health information by medical artificial intelligence agents
papers.abstract: Medical artificial intelligence agents should retrieve patient identifiers only when a task requires them, the data-minimization principle behind the HIPAA minimum necessary standard for protected health information (PHI). An agent can retrieve identifiers without revealing them. Such silent access remains invisible to evaluations that inspect only the output. We embedded canaries in synthetic patient records and linked each tool invocation to canary exposure in the final answers across five language models, four boundary levels, and seven attack frames for identifier-free clinical tasks. Three models invoked the PHI tools unnecessarily, whereas Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 did not. Stronger boundaries reduced this access, and the residual access under the strictest policy was confined to frames in which the user overrode the policy or asserted approval. A pre-execution gate given the task-necessity criterion nearly eliminated this access. Output-only evaluation cannot verify minimum-necessary access; boundaries, gates, and access-log audits are required together.

papers.title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-using language-model agents often execute actions that their domain policies forbid. We present LeanGuard, a runtime that checks every proposed tool call against a policy written in Lean4 before the call reaches the environment. Policies combine state predicates with scoped past-time temporal operators over the execution history, evaluation is fail-closed, and the decision procedure is proved equivalent to a LeanLTL semantics. A denied call can be corrected in two ways. With feedback, the agent receives the violated rule and a hint; with proof-guided repair, Lean metaprogramming searches for a nearby call that preserves the user's intent and proves that the policy admits it, without the model. On Tau-Bench with five Qwen models (0.8B-27B), unguarded agents execute at least 33 calls that the Lean policy forbids, while LeanGuard executes none; with feedback, task success does not change significantly. On DTap, LeanGuard reduces direct prompt-injection success from 57.9% to 5.9%, and in telecom, where benign tasks need no writes, benign success is unchanged. Feedback reduces repeated blocked calls and raises task success for four of five models over a bare denial. On replayed denials, repair proves an admissible edit for 88 of 252 denials caused by argument values, in a median of 2,ms.

papers.title: MemShift: Separating Detection from Repair in LLM-Derived Personal Memory
papers.abstract: AI assistants store values that a language model derived from a person's records under the person's own definitions, such as their important contacts. Keeping such a value correct takes two steps: detection, noticing that an input changed, and repair, producing the correct new value. Benchmarks that score only the final answer cannot tell which step failed, and they state every change as new text. Seeing this limitation, we present MemShift, a benchmark of five shifts: source revision, deletion, redefinition, writer switch, and export. The first three fork a synthetic world into branches that differ only in the shift. Gold values and dependencies are fixed before any text, and a deterministic scorer replaces an LLM judge. For a memory that reports its invalidations, MemShift shows for each changed item whether the memory noticed the change and whether its repair was right. Moreover, we build a reference memory with known detection and repair to validate the measure. By evaluating four open-weight LLMs, we find that detection helps only as much as repair allows: the LLMs re-derive few values computed by the person's definitions correctly, and programs that the LLM writes over typed records close most of the gap to exact recomputation. Code and data are available at this https URL.
