papers.title: AgiWorld: An Agentic Video World Model for Building Persistent Worlds
papers.abstract: Recent interactive video world models generate visually compelling videos from a single image, following user-provided camera motion and text prompts. However, such low-level control demands substantial user effort to realize a high-level intent, and the generated world struggles to remain persistent as the exploration proceeds. In this work, we present AgiWorld, an agentic video world model that explores and builds a persistent world from a single image and a free-form instruction. For high-level planning, our agent AgiWorld-Agent designs the world and the journey through it in a world state and directs the exploration. For low-level realization, our video world model AgiWorld-WM generates the video chunk by chunk and stores it with its geometry in a spatial memory, from which the agent updates its world state. This closed loop keeps the world faithful to the user's intent and keeps the agent's world state consistent with the generated content throughout the exploration. We co-design the two levels around the shared spatial memory and an interface of metric camera trajectories and structured prompts. In AgiWorld-WM, to handle occlusion and accumulated geometric errors in the spatial memory over long rollouts, we propose occlusion-aware history selection, which retrieves past views by surface visibility, and reliability-based memory maintenance, which prefers reliable geometry and earlier observations. AgiWorld-WM achieves state-of-the-art overall performance on world revisiting and exploration benchmarks, and qualitative results and ablations show that AgiWorld builds persistent worlds from free-form instructions over minute-long journeys. Persistence thus arises not from the video model alone but from its closed loop with the agent.

papers.title: APG: Agentic Static-Analysis Infrastructure on LLVM-IR Graph Databases
papers.abstract: LLM-based coding agents increasingly rely on external program knowledge, yet access to static-analysis graphs alone does not ensure appropriate operation selection or evidence interpretation. We present APG, an infrastructure for semantics-grounded static program analysis. Built on SVF and LLVM, it decomposes compiler-derived program analyses into atomic capabilities that LLM agents can select, compose, and orchestrate for goal-directed, cross-graph investigation, with query safeguards and evidence traces preserving inspectable results and provenance. APG provides 38 atomic capabilities. On analysis requests arising during benchmark repair runs, 35 achieve first-attempt query-generation success rates above 50%, including 13 at 100%. Evaluation on 812 C/C++ defects shows higher repair success than the evaluated baselines. Compared with Passive Graph Push, APG improves first-iteration repair success by 17.6 and 18.0 percentage points on the two benchmark collections and reduces average LLM input-token consumption by 90.8%. Our tool is available at this https URL and its demonstration video at this https URL

papers.title: VisCodeBench: a new benchmark dataset for Text-to-Vis reflecting real-world practice
papers.abstract: Generating visualisations from natural language requests (text-to-vis) enables users to explore data more efficiently. While LLMs can complete simple visualisation requests, their performance on challenging ones is not well covered by existing benchmarks. We introduce VisCodeBench, an end-to-end text-to-vis benchmark with 2,672 samples from three different domains: educational, scientific, and general audience scenarios with varying levels of complexity. We benchmark three visualisation systems---Codex, Claude Code, and LIDA---paired with a range of open and commercial LLMs across seven metrics covering execution, chart content, and visual quality. While basic execution is near-solved for strong systems, no system comes close to reproducing the reference data, with the best displayed data similarity reaching only $0.81$ and falling to $0.69$ on our hardest subset for this metric. We further find that frontier models separate on chart correctness and efficiency, with ClaudeCode-Opus-4.7 improving chart correctness by around 5 points over Codex-GPT-5 while running roughly 20 seconds faster. Separately, we find that system design matters as much as the underlying model: despite both running on GPT-5, Codex clearly outperforms LIDA, showing that the surrounding prompting, execution, and refinement pipeline can shape outcomes as much as the model itself. Finally, latency remains a practical obstacle, as even the strongest systems take 39-78 seconds to produce results. VisCodeBench is available at \href{this https URL}{this https URL} and accessed via a leaderboard; the full dataset is kept private to prevent LLM training use.

papers.title: Agent Memory as Rate-Limited Filtering: Explicit State Outlasts Long Context Beyond a Reader-Dependent Horizon
papers.abstract: Can a language model that reads the full history of an access log say whether a service may act now? On an executable benchmark of grants, withdrawals, reinstatements, expiries, groups and change windows under a known policy, scored on pairs of histories that differ only in the order or one field of the deciding events, open models of 7 to 32 billion parameters fall from 72 to 86 percent after eight or sixteen events to 48 to 55 percent after 256, while reasoning-trained 32B models reading the current state reach 96 and 98 percent. A reasoning model of 120 billion parameters trails the state by four and seven points at 256 and 512 events and by about ten at 1,024, so the length beyond which explicit state outlasts long context grows with the reader. We treat agent memory as recursive filtering. The decision depends on the history only through a state whose size is set by the number of tracked keys. A store holding fewer component records than the state forgets on a time scale set by its capacity, and a reader model predicts its accuracy within 0.02 on average in a registered test. Retaining log lines without regard to time order errs with probability approaching one half, a bound that is attained. A filter in which a model parses each line and an explicit rule applies the updates answers 80 to 89 percent at 256 events and beats relevance retrieval, model-kept ledgers, a reimplementation of StateMem and the Mem0 library. A retriever that selects at query time the lines the queried state depends on matches it at 256 events on the first domain, so what decides is selection by the state's dependencies, which the filter performs when writing, without the query. Applying parsed updates themselves, the models fall to 58 and 59 percent. A frozen replication on a second domain with fresh wording reproduces the horizon.

translation.title: Agent Memory as Rate-Limited Filtering: Explicit State Outlasts Long Context Beyond a Reader-Dependent Horizon
translation.abstract: Can a language model that reads the full history of an access log say whether a service may act now? On an executable benchmark of grants, withdrawals, reinstatements, expiries, groups and change windows under a known policy, scored on pairs of histories that differ only in the order or one field of the deciding events, open models of 7 to 32 billion parameters fall from 72 to 86 percent after eight or sixteen events to 48 to 55 percent after 256, while reasoning-trained 32B models reading the current state reach 96 and 98 percent. A reasoning model of 120 billion parameters trails the state by four and seven points at 256 and 512 events and by about ten at 1,024, so the length beyond which explicit state outlasts long context grows with the reader. We treat agent memory as recursive filtering. The decision depends on the history only through a state whose size is set by the number of tracked keys. A store holding fewer component records than the state forgets on a time scale set by its capacity, and a reader model predicts its accuracy within 0.02 on average in a registered test. Retaining log lines without regard to time order errs with probability approaching one half, a bound that is attained. A filter in which a model parses each line and an explicit rule applies the updates answers 80 to 89 percent at 256 events and beats relevance retrieval, model-kept ledgers, a reimplementation of StateMem and the Mem0 library. A retriever that selects at query time the lines the queried state depends on matches it at 256 events on the first domain, so what decides is selection by the state's dependencies, which the filter performs when writing, without the query. Applying parsed updates themselves, the models fall to 58 and 59 percent. A frozen replication on a second domain with fresh wording reproduces the horizon.

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: How Quantization Affects Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Agents are increasingly used for coding tasks, but the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) limits where they can run. Quantization reduces model size, but its effects on coding agents that execute and revise programs remain underexplored. We compare BF16 with 4-bit AWQ and GPTQ for Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct (7B, 14B, and 32B) and Devstral-Small-2507 (24B) on OJBench coding problems across three seeds. We detect no statistically significant accuracy loss for any of the coding agents. However, final accuracy can conceal substantial behavioral changes: AWQ reduces Qwen-7B one-shot solves from 17 to 0 while increasing loop-based solves from 10 to 25. All Qwen-32B successes involve tool use, whereas Devstral rarely makes a valid executor call. Failure profiles also differ: Qwen-32B produces far more compilation errors than the smaller Qwen models, rising slightly under quantization, while Devstral's failures shift significantly from runtime errors toward wrong answers and timeouts. These findings indicate that quantization robustness in coding agents should be assessed through solution trajectories, tool use, and failure modes, in addition to final accuracy.

translation.title: 超越准确率：量化如何影响编程智能体
translation.abstract: 智能体越来越多地用于编程任务，但大语言模型（LLM）的推理成本限制了其部署范围。量化可以减小模型体积，但其对执行和修改程序的编程智能体的影响仍未被充分研究。我们在 OJBench 编程问题上，跨三个随机种子，比较了 BF16 与 4-bit AWQ 和 GPTQ 在 Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct（7B、14B、32B）和 Devstral-Small-2507（24B）上的表现。我们没有检测到任何编程智能体出现统计显著的准确率损失。然而，最终准确率可能掩盖显著的行为变化：AWQ 使 Qwen-7B 的一次性解题数从 17 降至 0，同时使基于循环的解题数从 10 增至 25。Qwen-32B 的所有成功都涉及工具使用，而 Devstral 很少进行有效的执行器调用。失败模式也不同：Qwen-32B 产生的编译错误远多于较小的 Qwen 模型，且在量化后略有上升；而 Devstral 的失败则显著从运行时错误转向错误答案和超时。这些发现表明，编程智能体的量化鲁棒性除了最终准确率外，还应通过解题轨迹、工具使用和失败模式来评估。
translation.brief: 研究量化对编程智能体的影响，通过比较 BF16 与 4-bit AWQ/GPTQ 在 OJBench 上的解题轨迹、工具使用和失败模式，揭示准确率之外的行为变化。

papers.title: Mixed-Type Relational Database Synthesis with Graph-Prompted Language Model
papers.abstract: Data access is often limited by privacy or proprietary restrictions, motivating relational database synthesis, which synthesizes realistic contents across related tables. Relational databases couple multi-table structure with mixed-type attributes and intricate semantic dependencies among values, making realistic synthesis challenging. In this paper, we propose REMIX, a unified framework for realistic relational database synthesis with mixed-type attributes. REMIX integrates a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) through two key phases: Graph-to-Prompt Tuning and Collaborative SLM-LLM Decoding. To capture attribute dependencies within and across tables, Graph-to-Prompt Tuning represents the database as an attributed heterogeneous graph. We project mixed-type record embeddings and aggregated relational context into soft prompts that serve as continuous vectors for an SLM. We jointly optimize the graph-to-prompt mapping and SLM through autoregressive attribute reconstruction. Furthermore, to reduce semantic inconsistencies, Collaborative SLM-LLM Decoding combines SLM-based record generation with repair programs induced by an LLM. The LLM discovers semantic dependencies, iteratively refines them through independent validation with a statistical bound on the overall probability of false acceptance, and translates validated dependencies into tested programs that repair generated values. Extensive experiments on seven real-world relational databases demonstrate the effectiveness of REMIX in generating high-fidelity data with improved semantic consistency and downstream utility.

translation.title: 基于图提示语言模型的混合类型关系数据库合成
translation.abstract: 数据访问常受隐私或专有限制，这促使了关系数据库合成技术的发展，即在相关联的表之间合成逼真的内容。关系数据库将多表结构与混合类型属性以及值之间复杂的语义依赖耦合在一起，使逼真合成极具挑战性。本文提出 REMIX，一个用于合成具有混合类型属性的逼真关系数据库的统一框架。REMIX 通过两个关键阶段集成小语言模型（SLM）和大语言模型（LLM）：Graph-to-Prompt Tuning 和 Collaborative SLM-LLM Decoding。为捕捉表内和跨表的属性依赖，Graph-to-Prompt Tuning 将数据库表示为属性异构图。我们将混合类型记录嵌入和聚合的关系上下文投影为软提示，作为 SLM 的连续向量。我们通过自回归属性重建联合优化图到提示的映射和 SLM。此外，为减少语义不一致，Collaborative SLM-LLM Decoding 将基于 SLM 的记录生成与由 LLM 归纳的修复程序相结合。LLM 发现语义依赖，通过独立验证（对整体误接受概率设有统计界限）迭代精炼它们，并将验证过的依赖转化为经过测试的修复程序来修复生成的值。在七个真实世界关系数据库上的大量实验表明，REMIX 在生成具有更好语义一致性和下游效用的高保真数据方面非常有效。
translation.brief: 提出 REMIX 框架，通过图到提示调优和 SLM-LLM 协同解码，合成具有混合类型属性且语义一致的关系数据库内容。

papers.title: Toward an Evidence-Based Template for Agent Instruction Files: An Empirical Study of Adoption, Consistency, and Maintenance
papers.abstract: AI coding agents rely on repository-level instruction files to understand project conventions, development workflows, and constraints. However, different agents support different instruction formats, and limited empirical evidence exists about how these files are adopted, what information they contain, whether coexisting formats provide consistent guidance, and how they are maintained. We conduct an empirical study of 3,387 instruction files from 1,000 GitHub repositories across four formats: this http URL, this http URL, GitHub Copilot instructions, and Cursor rules. We find that 42.2% of instruction-bearing repositories in the higher-popularity cohort maintain multiple formats. Among 386 manually examined pairs of corresponding sections, 16.1% provide divergent guidance. Our maintenance analysis further shows that 40.4% of the analyzed files have only one recorded modification event and that maintenance patterns differ across formats. Based on category prevalence and category addition ratios (CAR), we derive an evidence-based template containing ten Required, four Gap, and two Recommended categories. In an exploratory generation experiment, explicit template guidance increases structural category coverage from 18.7% to 82.8%. We further introduce AGIT-Instruct, a benchmark for evaluating instruction-file generation through structural coverage and content alignment. Across four generation configurations, retrieval-augmented generation achieves the highest full-file ROUGE-1 F1 of 0.459. A manual assessment of 278 generated category instances finds that 19.4% fully preserve and 61.2% partially preserve developer-written intent. Our findings provide empirical guidance for organizing and maintaining agent instruction

translation.title: 迈向基于证据的智能体指令文件模板：采用、一致性与维护的实证研究
translation.abstract: AI 编程智能体依赖仓库级指令文件来理解项目规范、开发流程和约束。然而，不同智能体支持不同的指令格式，且关于这些文件如何被采用、包含什么信息、共存格式是否提供一致指导以及如何维护，实证证据有限。我们对来自 1,000 个 GitHub 仓库的 3,387 个指令文件进行了实证研究，涵盖四种格式：this http URL、this http URL、GitHub Copilot instructions 和 Cursor rules。我们发现，在高人气组中，42.2% 含指令的仓库维护多种格式。在人工检查的 386 对对应章节中，16.1% 提供了相互矛盾的指导。维护分析进一步显示，40.4% 的被分析文件只有一次修改记录，且不同格式的维护模式不同。基于类别流行度和类别添加率（CAR），我们推导出一个包含十个必需类别、四个补充类别和两个推荐类别的基于证据的模板。在一项探索性生成实验中，明确的模板指导将结构类别覆盖率从 18.7% 提升至 82.8%。我们进一步引入 AGIT-Instruct，一个通过结构覆盖率和内容对齐评估指令文件生成的基准。在四种生成配置中，检索增强生成取得了最高的整文件 ROUGE-1 F1，为 0.459。对 278 个生成类别实例的人工评估发现，19.4% 完全保留、61.2% 部分保留了开发者撰写的意图。我们的发现为组织和维护智能体指令文件提供了实证指导。
translation.brief: 对 1,000 个 GitHub 仓库的智能体指令文件进行实证研究，分析其采用、一致性与维护情况，并据此提出基于证据的指令文件模板和评估基准 AGIT-Instruct。

papers.title: Solver-Like Behavior in Large Language Models as Formalizers
papers.abstract: In the LLM-as-formalizer paradigm, a large language model translates a problem into a formal program and leaves the search to a solver, gaining the solver's guarantees. Formalizers are now often reasoning models that write a long reasoning trace before the program, yet they are judged only by the program's output. We find that the trace routinely does the solver's job, assigning, testing and ruling out values until it often reaches the full answer; we call this solver-like behavior (SLB). We define an ontology of SLB over the trace, the program and its output, and use LLM judges, checked against human labels, to label 2,000 generations from three reasoning models on four constraint satisfaction datasets, each formalized in a declarative and an imperative formal language. SLB appears in 85% of traces and takes 24% of reasoning tokens, yet the program usually recomputes the answer, so the effort is redundant. The 9% of programs that inherit the trace's answer also inherit its errors, and pass output-based evaluation whenever that answer is correct. The amount of SLB is not associated with accuracy, and SLB is more common in imperative Python than in declarative Z3 or PDDL. Cautionary prompts reduce it by only a quarter, but hiding the problem's values behind placeholders, which the program receives only at run time, removes 97% of it without loss of accuracy. Formalizers should therefore be evaluated by how their programs are reached, not only by what they output.

translation.title: 大语言模型作为形式化器的类求解器行为
translation.abstract: 在 LLM-as-formalizer 范式中，大语言模型将问题翻译为形式化程序，并将搜索留给求解器，从而获得求解器的保证。形式化器如今常是推理模型，会在程序之前写出长长的推理轨迹，但它们仅由程序的输出评判。我们发现，推理轨迹经常在做求解器的工作——赋值、测试并排除候选值，直到常常得出完整答案；我们称之为类求解器行为（SLB）。我们在轨迹、程序及其输出之上定义了 SLB 的本体，并使用经人工标注校验的 LLM 评判器，对三个推理模型在四个约束满足数据集（每个均以声明式和命令式两种形式语言形式化）上的 2,000 个生成结果进行标注。SLB 出现在 85% 的轨迹中，占用 24% 的推理 token，但程序通常会重新计算答案，因此这些努力是冗余的。继承轨迹答案的 9% 程序也继承了其错误，且只要答案正确就能通过基于输出的评估。SLB 的数量与准确率无关，且 SLB 在命令式 Python 中比在声明式 Z3 或 PDDL 中更常见。警示性提示仅能将其减少四分之一，但将问题的值隐藏在占位符之后（程序仅在运行时才获得这些值）可消除 97% 的 SLB 且不损失准确率。因此，形式化器应根据其程序是如何得出的来评估，而不仅是根据其输出。
translation.brief: 发现 LLM 形式化器的推理轨迹常代替求解器完成搜索（类求解器行为），并通过在运行时用占位符隐藏问题取值来消除 97% 的此类冗余行为。

papers.title: Accelerating LLM Decoding with In-DRAM Parallelism
papers.abstract: Autoregressive decoding of large language models (LLMs) on edge devices is dominated by memory-bound general matrix--vector multiplication (GeMV) operations. Processing-using-DRAM (PUD) is a promising computing paradigm that can alleviate this bottleneck by reducing processor--memory data transfers and enabling massively parallel computation within DRAM (e.g., across 65,536 columns). However, weight matrices in individual LLM layers (e.g., a QKV matrix in Llama3 8B with 6,144 rows) are typically too small to fully utilize parallelism in PUD. To address this challenge, we propose an algorithm--system co-design for PUD-based LLM inference. At the algorithm level, we enable a subsequent projection to be packed with the current projection by reformulating it as a computation on the current residual state plus a correction for the residual update. Layer redundancy allows this correction to be approximated using fewer bit-serial steps. At the system level, we tailor data mapping and execution to improve utilization of either columns within DRAM subarrays (SIMD) or independently controlled banks (MIMD). Overall, we achieves up to $1.41\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup over the PUD baseline, corresponding to a $2.45\times$ speedup over processor-based execution.

translation.title: 利用 DRAM 内并行加速 LLM 解码
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在边缘设备上的自回归解码主要由内存受限的通用矩阵-向量乘法（GeMV）操作主导。Processing-using-DRAM（PUD）是一种有前景的计算范式，可通过减少处理器-内存数据传输并在 DRAM 内实现大规模并行计算（例如跨 65,536 列）来缓解这一瓶颈。然而，LLM 单个层中的权重矩阵（例如 Llama3 8B 中有 6,144 行的 QKV 矩阵）通常太小，无法充分利用 PUD 中的并行性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于 PUD 的 LLM 推理的算法-系统协同设计。在算法层面，我们通过将后续投影重新表述为对当前残差状态加上残差更新修正的计算，使其能够与当前投影打包在一起。层冗余允许使用更少的位串行步骤来近似该修正。在系统层面，我们定制数据映射和执行，以提高 DRAM 子阵列内列（SIMD）或独立控制的 bank（MIMD）的利用率。总体而言，相比 PUD 基线，我们实现了高达 1.41 倍的端到端解码加速，相当于相比基于处理器的执行实现了 2.45 倍的加速。
translation.brief: 提出算法-系统协同设计，通过将后续投影打包进当前投影并定制 SIMD/MIMD 数据映射，利用 DRAM 内并行（PUD）加速边缘设备上的 LLM 解码。

papers.title: Networked Synthetic Social Engineering on the Web
papers.abstract: Several genuine AI services may repeat one unsupported source, and correcting that source may leave later reports unchanged. We examine these networked consequences of synthetic social engineering (SSE), deliberately misleading influence intended to redirect AI recipients from authorized objectives. Our framework connects social influence, information aggregation, and misinformation correction research to observable evidence and permission boundaries. It separates originating attempts from legitimate intermediaries' work and distinguishes identity, evidentiary support, and authorization. We test four relationships using Qwen3-4B and two briefing tasks across 1,080 research units in our Agent Service Exchange and Evidence Commons (ASE-EC). Multiple dependent publishers produced no supported increase in unsupported verification (78.3% versus 75.0%); publication availability left downstream violation reach at 40.0% in both arms. These comparisons direct attention to weaknesses already present in the reference workflows. High reference error rates and retained private handoffs preclude claims of immunity to social pressure. Without scope revalidation, corrections identifying dependent reports reduced residual invalid decisions from 14.4% to 8.1% at equal notification coverage and increased successful report repairs from 16/63 to 36/63. Scope revalidation added no demonstrated protection, and clearing dialogue offered no established recovery advantage. Unapproved requests persisted, all blocked by an external gateway. For designers, the findings caution against treating publisher count as independent evidence, notification as repair, or cleared histories as recovery. They support targeting corrections at reused reports, assessing factual and permission recovery separately, and enforcing authorization at execution.

translation.title: 网络上的网络化合成社会工程
translation.abstract: 多个真实的AI服务可能重复引用同一个无依据的来源，而纠正该来源可能无法改变后续报告。我们研究合成社会工程（SSE）的这些网络化后果，即蓄意误导性影响，旨在使AI接收者偏离其授权目标。我们的框架将社会影响、信息聚合与错误信息纠正研究联系起来，并与可观察证据和权限边界对接。它将发起性尝试与合法中介的工作区分开来，并区分身份、证据支持与授权。我们在Agent Service Exchange与Evidence Commons（ASE-EC）中，使用Qwen3-4B和两个简报任务，在1,080个研究单元上检验了四种关系。多个依赖性发布者并未带来无依据验证的支持性增长（78.3%对75.0%）；发布可用性在两个实验组中均使下游违规触达率保持在40.0%。这些比较将注意力引向参考工作流中已存在的弱点。高参考错误率和保留的私有交接排除了对社会压力免疫的声明。在没有范围重验证的情况下，识别依赖性报告的纠正措施在相同通知覆盖率下将残余无效决策从14.4%降至8.1%，并将成功修复的报告从16/63提升到36/63。范围重验证未显示出额外保护，清除对话也未显示出既定的恢复优势。未经批准的请求持续存在，但均被外部网关拦截。对设计者而言，这些发现警示不要将发布者数量视为独立证据、将通知视为修复、或将清除的历史视为恢复。它们支持将纠正措施针对被复用的报告、分别评估事实与权限恢复，并在执行时强制授权。
translation.brief: 研究合成社会工程对AI服务的网络化误导后果，提出区分发起与中介、身份与授权的分析框架，并验证针对复用报告的纠正机制。

papers.title: SGR-OPSD: Learning from Subgoal Plans with Graph-Regularized Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: OPSD provides dense supervision for agentic reinforcement learning through privileged information feedback. However, existing privileged information often lacks explicit task-progression planning, while teacher-student log-probability gaps reflect shifts in model preference rather than true task progress. To address these limitations, we propose Subgoal-Guided Graph-Regularized OPSD (SGR-OPSD), a framework that combines subgoal supervision with interaction-derived evidence for turn-level credit assignment. Specifically, SGR-OPSD uses LLM-generated subgoal plans to provide dense action-level guidance, converting them into advantage weights via a constrained, KL-regularized objective. To ground credit in observed outcomes, we construct a Subgoal Progress Graph that estimates empirical returns from sampled transition frequencies. The graph compares empirical action returns against the state average to derive preferences that calibrate the teacher's credit weights. Evaluated on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA across two model scales (Qwen2.5-3B and 7B), SGR-OPSD consistently outperforms GRPO and strong self-distillation baselines, improving success rates over GRPO by up to 7.4 percentage points and reaching 85.8% on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B. Ablation studies confirm that subgoal guidance and graph-based weight calibration are key to these performance gains.

translation.title: SGR-OPSD：基于图正则化信用分配从子目标计划学习的智能体强化学习
translation.abstract: OPSD通过特权信息反馈为智能体强化学习提供密集监督。然而，现有的特权信息往往缺乏显式的任务推进规划，而师生对数概率差距反映的是模型偏好变化而非真实任务进展。为解决这些局限，我们提出子目标引导的图正则化OPSD（SGR-OPSD），这是一个将子目标监督与交互衍生证据相结合、用于回合级信用分配的框架。具体而言，SGR-OPSD使用LLM生成的子目标计划提供密集的动作级指导，并通过受约束的KL正则化目标将其转换为优势权重。为使信用基于观察到的结果，我们构建了一个子目标进度图，从采样的转移频率估计经验回报。该图将经验动作回报与状态平均值进行比较，得出用于校准教师信用权重的偏好。在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA上、跨两个模型规模（Qwen2.5-3B和7B）的评估中，SGR-OPSD持续优于GRPO和强自蒸馏基线，相比GRPO将成功率提升最多7.4个百分点，并在Qwen2.5-7B上于ALFWorld达到85.8%。消融研究证实子目标引导和基于图的权重校准是这些性能提升的关键。
translation.brief: 针对特权信息缺乏任务推进规划的问题，提出用LLM子目标计划与子目标进度图进行回合级信用分配的智能体强化学习框架SGR-OPSD。

papers.title: Fault-Free Profiles and Decision-Level Training for Small-Model Root Cause Analysis
papers.abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) in microservice systems requires distinguishing failure sources from routine fluctuations and propagated symptoms. Small language models (SLMs) offer a practical solution under cost and privacy constraints, and recent approaches improve their capabilities through structured diagnostic procedures. However, performing diagnostic analysis does not ensure correct root-cause identification. Our empirical study shows that final decisions often favor large anomaly scores despite the model's own propagation analysis suggesting otherwise. Moreover, the input does not reveal whether these apparently anomalous signals are common during normal operation. These findings motivate our system, which improves how SLMs assess evidence and select root causes through Historical Frequency Profiling and Biased-Decision Correction. Historical Frequency Profiling quantifies how often metric and log signals are flagged as anomalous in the fault-free period, providing context for distinguishing routine deviations from potential failure evidence. Biased-Decision Correction identifies points where the model reaches different conclusions from the same initial analysis and uses preference optimization to favor more accurate diagnoses. Against baselines including the 14B OpsAgent and RCA-Agent with commercial models, our system with a 4B model achieves the highest or tied-highest accuracy on all four datasets, reaching 48.7% on Bank compared with 18.5% for OpsAgent.

translation.title: 面向小模型根因分析的无故障画像与决策级训练
translation.abstract: 微服务系统中的根因分析（RCA）需要将故障源与常规波动和传播症状区分开来。小语言模型（SLM）在成本和隐私约束下提供了实用方案，近期方法通过结构化诊断流程提升其能力。然而，执行诊断分析并不能确保正确识别根因。我们的实证研究表明，最终决策往往偏向较大的异常分数，即使模型自身的传播分析给出了相反的结论。此外，输入无法揭示这些看似异常的信号在正常运行期间是否常见。这些发现促成了我们的系统，该系统通过历史频率画像（Historical Frequency Profiling）和偏差决策纠正（Biased-Decision Correction）改进SLM评估证据和选择根因的方式。历史频率画像量化指标和日志信号在无故障期间被标记为异常的频率，为区分常规偏差与潜在故障证据提供背景。偏差决策纠正识别模型从同一初始分析得出不同结论的位置，并使用偏好优化来偏向更准确的诊断。与包括14B OpsAgent和使用商业模型的RCA-Agent在内的基线相比，我们基于4B模型的系统在全部四个数据集上取得最高或并列最高的准确率，在Bank上达到48.7%，而OpsAgent仅为18.5%。
translation.brief: 针对小模型根因分析中决策偏向大异常分数的问题，提出用无故障期历史频率画像提供证据背景并用偏好优化纠正决策偏差。

papers.title: As Expected? Efficient LLM Planning via Expectation-Observation Consistency Verification
papers.abstract: LLM planning often relies on reactive executors (e.g., ReAct) that generate a single action at each step to remain grounded in the latest observations, incurring substantial inference cost. Batched executors reduce this cost by predicting multiple actions in a single model invocation, yet they are prone to compounding errors, as intermediate observations are ignored. We propose an expectation-observation consistency verification (EOCV) mechanism for batched executors, preserving grounding while improving efficiency. The mechanism generates expectations of action outcomes and compares them with the resulting observations. Consistency permits continued execution, whereas mismatches trigger early termination and replanning from the current observation. Experiments on text-based and multimodal benchmarks across multiple backbones show broadly comparable average task performance between EOCV and reactive executors, with a 29-35% reduction in average weighted token usage. Moreover, the mechanism is model-agnostic and remains effective when integrated into state-of-the-art planners.

translation.title: 如预期吗？通过期望-观察一致性验证实现高效LLM规划
translation.abstract: LLM规划常依赖反应式执行器（如ReAct），每步生成单个动作以保持与最新观察的一致，从而产生大量推理成本。批量执行器通过单次模型调用预测多个动作来降低成本，但由于忽略中间观察，容易产生复合错误。我们提出面向批量执行器的期望-观察一致性验证（EOCV）机制，在提升效率的同时保持与环境的对齐。该机制生成对动作结果的期望，并将其与实际观察进行比较。一致则允许继续执行，不一致则触发提前终止并从当前观察重新规划。在多个骨干模型上的文本和多模态基准实验表明，EOCV与反应式执行器的平均任务性能大体相当，同时平均加权token使用量降低29-35%。此外，该机制与模型无关，集成到最先进的规划器中仍然有效。
translation.brief: 针对批量执行器忽略中间观察导致错误累积的问题，提出期望-观察一致性验证机制，在不一致时提前终止并重新规划以兼顾效率与对齐。

papers.title: Harvesting SWE Benchmarks from Wild Vibe Coding Sessions
papers.abstract: Development teams need reproducible tasks from their own repositories and workflows to evaluate coding agents. Conversational developer-agent collaboration ("vibe coding") produces abundant coding sessions and repository checkpoints, but requirements evolve across turns, unrelated conversations co-occur with commits, and engineering efforts can span multiple sessions. We present SessionFarmer, an automated framework that turns these records into self-contained, executable software engineering tasks. It analyzes dialogue and commit history to filter unrelated sessions and group multi-turn, potentially multi-session interactions into work episodes centered on one engineering goal. For each episode, it reconstructs a hermetic execution container, synthesizes a task statement from the full context, and authors repository-grounded engineering-quality rubrics and unit tests. Closed-loop test refinement uses requirement-breaking mutants and a blind solver to reduce false rejections of valid alternatives and false acceptances of incomplete solutions. We construct CropChat, an open benchmark of 242 tasks across 61 public repositories and 14 programming languages, and CropEnterprise from proprietary enterprise logs. In a CropEnterprise audit, the original developers endorse the vast majority of reconstructed episode boundaries, task statements, and quality rubrics. Full-episode context covers substantially more user requirements than single-turn or single-session inputs. Test refinement cuts false-rejection rates and raises balanced accuracy against reference patch labels by 7-9 percentage points across solvers. Across 12 model-harness configurations on CropChat, the strongest setup achieves 39.3% Pass@1, while harness choice shifts Pass@1 by up to 8.4 percentage points for the same model.

translation.title: 从真实Vibe Coding会话中收获软件工程基准
translation.abstract: 开发团队需要来自自身仓库和工作流的可复现任务来评估编码智能体。对话式的开发者-智能体协作（"vibe coding"）产生了大量编码会话和仓库检查点，但需求在多轮之间演化，无关对话与提交同时发生，工程工作可能跨越多个会话。我们提出SessionFarmer，一个将这些记录转化为自包含、可执行软件工程任务的自动化框架。它分析对话和提交历史以过滤无关会话，并将多轮、可能跨会话的交互分组为以单一工程目标为中心的工作片段。对每个片段，它重建一个封闭的执行容器，从完整上下文合成任务描述，并编写基于仓库的工程质量评分标准和单元测试。闭环测试精化使用破坏需求的变异体和盲求解器，以减少对有效替代方案的错误拒绝和对不完整解决方案的错误接受。我们构建了CropChat——一个涵盖61个公开仓库和14种编程语言的242个任务的开放基准——以及来自专有企业日志的CropEnterprise。在CropEnterprise审计中，原始开发者认可绝大多数重建的片段边界、任务描述和质量评分标准。完整片段上下文覆盖的用户需求显著多于单轮或单会话输入。测试精化降低了错误拒绝率，并在各求解器上将相对参考补丁标签的平衡准确率提升7-9个百分点。在CropChat上跨12种模型-测试框架配置，最强配置达到39.3%的Pass@1，而测试框架选择对同一模型的Pass@1影响高达8.4个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对从真实vibe coding记录构建可复现评估任务的难题，提出SessionFarmer自动框架，通过会话分组、容器重建和闭环测试精化生成自包含的软件工程基准任务。

papers.title: RecGroupMemory: Feedback-Aware Cohort Memory for E-Commerce Recommendation
papers.abstract: Cohort memory can support LLM-based recommendation planning through group-level user profiles and advice. As outcome feedback becomes available, this guidance may need to be updated while preserving the underlying observations. We present RecGroupMemory, a workflow that provides this memory to an orchestration LLM and separates memory construction from feedback-based revision. It uses feedback from the previous day to revise decision guidance, while validation checks keep selected source values unchanged. Online comparisons were conducted among Taobao users with low purchasing power selected by the business team. Relative to a no-memory baseline, memory without feedback and memory with feedback showed increases of 1.58% and 1.78%, respectively, in the number of guided transaction users.

translation.title: RecGroupMemory：面向电商推荐的反馈感知群体记忆
translation.abstract: 群体记忆可以通过群体级用户画像和建议来支持基于 LLM 的推荐规划。随着结果反馈的获得，这些指导可能需要更新，同时保留底层观察数据。我们提出 RecGroupMemory，一种为编排 LLM 提供此类记忆的工作流，并将记忆构建与基于反馈的修订分离。它利用前一天的反馈来修订决策指导，同时通过校验检查保持选定的源数据不变。在线对比实验由业务团队选取的淘宝低购买力用户开展。相对于无记忆基线，无反馈记忆和有反馈记忆分别使引导成交用户数提升了 1.58% 和 1.78%。
translation.brief: 为基于 LLM 的电商推荐提供群体记忆，并通过将记忆构建与基于结果反馈的修订分离来持续更新决策指导。

papers.title: RLiD: Reinforcement Learning in the Decision Plane for Language Agents and LLMs
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has improved the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) across a wide range of tasks. However, token-level RL assigns an action's advantage to the entire generated response, including tokens specifying the parsed action, reasoning chains, and malformed content. Although the environment executes only the parsed action, variation in how the action is expressed in natural language can introduce additional variance into policy-gradient estimates. We propose RLiD (Reinforcement Learning in the Decision plane), a framework that directly optimizes the probabilities of executable action options. RLiD compiles observations, an optional compact memory, and a labeled action menu into the model input, and uses a large decision model (LDM) to select an action in a single forward pass. By eliminating autoregressive token generation and bypassing action parsing, RLiD avoids invalid action outputs and improves RL rollout efficiency. Our analysis shows that, within a fixed text policy, marginalizing over alternative realizations of the same action removes a zero-mean gradient component without changing the expected update. We further distill trained LDM policies into generative LLMs through supervision on their action trajectories. Experiments on ARC, Countdown, and Sokoban demonstrate improved performance or lower computational cost across several settings. On ALFWorld, the complete training and distillation pipeline reaches 99.3% success in 12.7 H100 GPU-hours, compared with 86.6% in 17.3 GPU-hours for token-level RL of the same LLM. With compiled memory, our strongest Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM and distilled generative LLM achieve 100% success on all 134 unseen and 140 seen ALFWorld evaluation games.

translation.title: RLiD：面向语言智能体与 LLM 的决策平面强化学习
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）已在广泛任务中提升了大语言模型（LLM）的能力。然而，token 级 RL 将动作的优势分配给整个生成的响应，包括指定解析动作的 token、推理链和格式错误的内容。尽管环境只执行解析后的动作，但动作在自然语言中表达方式的差异会给策略梯度估计引入额外方差。我们提出 RLiD（决策平面强化学习），一个直接优化可执行动作选项概率的框架。RLiD 将观察、可选的紧凑记忆和带标签的动作菜单编译进模型输入，并使用大型决策模型（LDM）在单次前向传播中选择动作。通过消除自回归 token 生成并绕过动作解析，RLiD 避免了无效动作输出并提高了 RL rollout 效率。我们的分析表明，在固定文本策略内，对同一动作的不同实现进行边缘化可以去除一个零均值梯度分量而不改变期望更新。我们进一步通过在动作轨迹上的监督，将训练好的 LDM 策略蒸馏到生成式 LLM 中。在 ARC、Countdown 和 Sokoban 上的实验表明，在多种设置下性能提升或计算成本降低。在 ALFWorld 上，完整的训练与蒸馏流程在 12.7 个 H100 GPU 小时内达到 99.3% 的成功率，而同一 LLM 的 token 级 RL 需要 17.3 个 GPU 小时才达到 86.6%。借助编译记忆，我们最强的 Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM 及其蒸馏的生成式 LLM 在全部 134 个未见和 140 个已见 ALFWorld 评估游戏中达到 100% 成功率。
translation.brief: 针对 token 级 RL 将优势分配给整个响应导致的梯度方差问题，提出直接在决策平面优化可执行动作概率的 LDM 框架，并蒸馏回生成式 LLM。

papers.title: Multi-Teacher Reasoning Distillation for LLM Recommendation with Self-Exploration
papers.abstract: Reasoning-augmented recommender systems (RecSys) enhance user preference modeling by generating reasoning trajectories over historical interactions before making recommendations. Knowledge distillation provides a practical paradigm for transferring such reasoning capabilities from powerful large language models to lightweight RecSys. However, existing methods typically rely on a single fixed teacher, remain constrained by the teacher knowledge ceiling, and indiscriminately distill teacher-generated trajectories without assessing their actual utility for downstream recommendation. To address these limitations, we propose MUSE (Multi-Teacher Utility-guided Selection with Self-Exploration), an adaptive reasoning distillation framework that jointly improves reasoning generation and reasoning utilization. MUSE first constructs a diverse reasoning pool using multiple teacher LLMs and progressively augments it via student self-exploration, enabling the student to leverage the strengths of different teachers and gradually explore reasoning strategies beyond teacher imitation. We then develop Rank-Gain Utility Assessment (RGUA), which evaluates each candidate according to the normalized full-catalog rank improvement of the ground-truth item and identifies the most and least recommendation-beneficial trajectories. Based on these utility-aware trajectory pairs, we introduce dual-level contrastive learning objectives that guide the student generator to prefer beneficial reasoning while training the recommendation encoder to more effectively exploit recommendation-relevant preference evidence. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework.

translation.title: 面向 LLM 推荐的多教师推理蒸馏与自我探索
translation.abstract: 推理增强的推荐系统（RecSys）通过在推荐前对历史交互生成推理轨迹来增强用户偏好建模。知识蒸馏为将这种推理能力从强大的大语言模型迁移到轻量级 RecSys 提供了实用范式。然而，现有方法通常依赖单一固定教师，受限于教师知识上限，并且不加区分地蒸馏教师生成的轨迹，而不评估其对下游推荐的实际效用。为解决这些局限，我们提出 MUSE（多教师效用引导选择与自我探索），一个联合改进推理生成与推理利用的自适应推理蒸馏框架。MUSE 首先使用多个教师 LLM 构建多样化推理池，并通过学生自我探索逐步扩充，使学生能够利用不同教师的优势并逐步探索超越教师模仿的推理策略。随后我们开发了 Rank-Gain 效用评估（RGUA），根据真实物品在全目录归一化排名的提升来评估每个候选轨迹，识别出对推荐最有益和最无益的轨迹。基于这些效用感知的轨迹对，我们引入双层对比学习目标，引导学生生成器偏好有益推理，同时训练推荐编码器更有效地利用与推荐相关的偏好证据。在三个真实数据集上的大量实验证明了所提框架的有效性和鲁棒性。
translation.brief: 针对单教师蒸馏受知识上限约束且不评估轨迹效用的问题，提出多教师推理池结合学生自我探索与基于排名增益效用评估的双层对比蒸馏框架。

papers.title: MAGAR: Multimodal Agents for GUI-Based 3D Mechanical Assembly and Minimal Rework
papers.abstract: A GUI command can be correct at the interface level yet still produce an incorrect assembly. An agent must identify the relevant components, respect their structural relationships, and determine which parts should move during recovery. We introduce MAGAR-Bench, a benchmark of 4,000 multimodal samples from 26 assembly families that separates Assembly Decision, Atomic Action, and Minimal Rework. For rework, the objective counts distinct moved parts within the validated recovery candidate set for each state, rather than the number of actions. We also introduce MAGAR, a selective correction framework built on a frozen policy obtained by supervised fine-tuning. Its key design matches correction granularity to output dependencies. Structured candidates revise assembly fields and rework scope, while complete action candidates keep native GUI primitives coupled with their parameters. A learned selector retains the original prediction unless a candidate passes a task-specific intervention threshold. On recorded states from held-out assembly families, MAGAR improves Overall, the task-balanced aggregate, from 37.50 to 41.39, with gains on all three tasks. Across 209 interventions, 70 correct an error and 22 introduce one. These results support task-specific correction while highlighting the remaining tradeoff between fixing errors and preserving reliable predictions.

translation.title: MAGAR：面向基于 GUI 的 3D 机械装配与最小返工的多模态智能体
translation.abstract: 一条 GUI 命令可能在界面层面正确，却仍产生错误的装配。智能体必须识别相关组件、遵循其结构关系，并确定恢复过程中哪些部件应当移动。我们提出 MAGAR-Bench，一个包含来自 26 个装配族的 4,000 个多模态样本的基准，将装配决策、原子动作和最小返工分离开来。对于返工，目标统计的是每个状态下经验证的恢复候选集中被移动的不同部件数量，而非动作数量。我们还提出 MAGAR，一个建立在监督微调获得的冻结策略之上的选择性纠正框架。其关键设计是将纠正粒度与输出依赖相匹配：结构化候选修订装配字段和返工范围，而完整动作候选保持原生 GUI 原语与其参数的耦合。学习到的选择器仅在候选通过任务特定的干预阈值时才保留原预测。在留出装配族的记录状态上，MAGAR 将任务平衡的总体指标 Overall 从 37.50 提升至 41.39，三项任务均有提升。在 209 次干预中，70 次纠正了错误，22 次引入了新错误。这些结果支持任务特定的纠正，同时也凸显了修复错误与保留可靠预测之间仍存在的权衡。
translation.brief: 针对 GUI 命令界面正确但装配错误的问题，构建分离装配决策、原子动作与最小返工的基准，并提出基于冻结策略、按输出依赖匹配纠正粒度的选择性纠正框架。

papers.title: Benchmark of THReD: Evaluating an LLM Agent and Its Preprocessing Tools for Turning Electronic Health Records into AI-Ready Datasets
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly built into data-analysis software, yet little evidence shows how reliably they preprocess clinical data or whether the tools they invoke give correct, reproducible output. We report a benchmark of THReD, a web-based system that turns electronic health record (EHR) extracts into AI-ready datasets through a chat agent whose proposed steps run only after user confirmation. The agent benchmark has 141 tasks (100 templates) in seven categories, including goal-level requests, failure recovery, requests calling for no action, schema variation and prompt injection through the data, on synthetic tables calibrated to a regional health information exchange; success is judged by checks on the produced data. Over 2,550 episodes with Claude Haiku 5.5 in four context configurations, the deployed agent completed 92.7% (95% CI 88.1-96.4) of tasks on its first answer, abstained on every advice request, recovered from every injected fault, and never proposed an action requested by planted text. Without the data profile, completion fell to 58.0%; goal-level requests were hardest (80.6%). Six experiments on real records of two chronic-disease cohorts and on synthetic data at scale validate the tools: 91-92% of inferred patient classes and 99.7-99.8% of inferred vital-sign labels were correct in masked reconstruction; a dictionary builder combining curated dictionaries with LLM suggestions mapped 99.0% of 2,208 raw variants correctly; all 2,176 replays of 128 saved pipelines gave byte-identical files under pinned dependencies; subgroup differences in inference accuracy vanished within facility and lookup key; and the same-day consolidation rule changed 90-day emergency revisit rates by up to 3.2 points without shifting cohort composition by more than one point. Processing time grew roughly linearly to 5.5 million records while the prompt stayed at about 13 thousand tokens.

translation.title: THReD 基准：评估将电子健康记录转化为 AI 就绪数据集的 LLM 智能体及其预处理工具
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体正日益被集成到数据分析软件中，但很少有证据表明它们预处理临床数据的可靠性，或其调用的工具能否给出正确、可复现的输出。我们报告了 THReD 的基准测试，THReD 是一个基于网页的系统，通过聊天智能体将电子健康记录（EHR）提取转化为 AI 就绪数据集，其提议的步骤仅在用户确认后执行。智能体基准包含七个类别的 141 个任务（100 个模板），包括目标级请求、故障恢复、无需操作的请求、模式变化以及通过数据进行的提示注入，使用按区域健康信息交换机构校准的合成表；成功与否通过对产出数据的检查来判定。在四种上下文配置下使用 Claude Haiku 5.5 进行的 2,550 多轮测试中，部署的智能体在首次回答上完成了 92.7%（95% CI 88.1-96.4）的任务，对所有建议类请求均正确弃答，从所有注入故障中恢复，且从未执行植入文本所请求的操作。没有数据画像时，完成率降至 58.0%；目标级请求最难（80.6%）。针对两个慢性病队列真实记录及大规模合成数据的六项实验验证了工具的有效性：在掩码重建中 91-92% 的推断患者类别和 99.7-99.8% 的推断生命体征标签正确；结合精选词典与 LLM 建议的词典构建器正确映射了 2,208 个原始变体中的 99.0%；在固定依赖下，128 个已保存流水线的全部 2,176 次重放均产生字节级一致的文件；推断准确率的亚组差异在机构与查找键内部消失；当日合并规则使 90 天急诊再就诊率变化最多 3.2 个百分点，而队列构成变化不超过一个百分点。处理时间随记录数增长至 550 万条大致呈线性，而提示词保持在约 1.3 万 token。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体临床数据预处理可靠性缺乏证据的问题，构建包含故障恢复、提示注入等场景的基准，系统评估 THReD 智能体及其 EHR 预处理工具的正确性与可复现性。

papers.title: RecRSI: Mechanism-Guided Discovery of Recommendation Algorithms
papers.abstract: Improving recommendation algorithms for the Web requires coordinating interacting design choices and learning from experiments. We present RecRSI, an LLM-based research framework that uses mechanism hypotheses to organize algorithm discovery. Each hypothesis links a proposed mechanism change to a reference design, a rationale, and an expected observation. MechSpace derives implementable primitives and composition rules from the task source; Research Line uses this space and prior evidence to develop and test hypotheses; Mechanism Feedback carries outcomes and their design context into subsequent research. This organization makes each experiment inform which mechanisms to develop, revise, or combine next. Across four initial recommenders and four datasets, RecRSI yields average relative improvements of 8.48% in NDCG@5 and 6.88% in HR@5 over the initial algorithms, and 2.60% and 2.20%, respectively, over the strongest competing result for each setting and metric. Component and process studies link these gains to coordinated mechanism choices and evidence-guided follow-up. Our code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: RecRSI：机制引导的推荐算法发现
translation.abstract: 改进面向Web的推荐算法需要协调相互交互的设计选择并从实验中学习。我们提出RecRSI，一个基于LLM的研究框架，使用机制假设来组织算法发现。每个假设将提出的机制变更与参考设计、理由和预期观察联系起来。MechSpace从任务源中推导可实现的基元和组合规则；Research Line利用该空间和先前证据来发展和检验假设；Mechanism Feedback将结果及其设计上下文带入后续研究。这种组织方式使每个实验都能指导下一步应开发、修改或组合哪些机制。在四个初始推荐器和四个数据集上，RecRSI相比初始算法在NDCG@5上平均相对提升8.48%，在HR@5上提升6.88%；相比每个设置和指标下最强的竞争结果，分别提升2.60%和2.20%。组件与过程研究将这些增益归因于协调的机制选择和证据引导的后续研究。我们的代码已在https URL公开。
translation.brief: 针对推荐算法自动发现缺乏系统组织的问题，提出基于LLM、以机制假设为核心的RecRSI框架来协调设计选择并从实验反馈中迭代改进算法。

papers.title: Same Sentence, Different Construct: Identity-Swapped Rationales Reveal Measurement Non-Invariance in LLM Hate Speech Classifiers
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as measurement instruments for socially consequential constructs such as hate speech, and are typically validated by their aggregate agreement with human labels. A valid instrument must also apply the same construct to every group it measures. We test this requirement using 421 \hc{} templates that are instantiated identically for seven protected groups, so that only the identity term varies. Four LLM classifiers each exceed 0.95 balanced accuracy, yet within identical templates two of them miss hateful statements about women at markedly higher rates than the same statements about other groups (excess false-negative rates of 8.3 and 4.4 percentage points), a gap first reported for fine-tuned classifiers in 2021. We show how the construct shifts. Comparing rationales within each template, we find that models invoke protected-group status for other groups but recast the identical statement about women as personal dislike or as aimed at an individual, in 22 of 30 missed templates for one model. Adding the benchmark's own definition, which lists sex as a protected characteristic, does not close the gap, and the contrast persists. Apparent false-positive disparities, by contrast, largely vanish under identity control and trace to reclaimed slurs present only for some groups. Errors shared by all models concentrate where model and benchmark definitions diverge, and pairwise counterfactual accuracy adds little beyond endpoint accuracy. We argue that validating LLM measurement requires identity-controlled tests of measurement invariance that examine both decisions and the criteria models state for them.

translation.title: 同一句子，不同构念：身份互换的理由揭示LLM仇恨言论分类器中的测量非不变性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作测量仇恨言论等具有社会影响的构念的测量工具，通常通过与人类标签的总体一致性来验证。一个有效的测量工具必须对其测量的每个群体应用相同的构念。我们使用421个\hc{}模板来检验这一要求，这些模板对七个受保护群体的实例化完全相同，只有身份词不同。四个LLM分类器的平衡准确率均超过0.95，但在相同模板内，其中两个模型对关于女性的仇恨言论的漏检率显著高于对其他群体相同言论的漏检率（超额假阴性率分别为8.3和4.4个百分点），这一差距最早于2021年在微调分类器中被报道。我们展示了构念如何发生偏移。比较每个模板内的理由，我们发现模型对其他群体援引受保护群体身份，却将关于女性的相同陈述重新解读为个人厌恶或针对个体的言论——在一个模型的30个漏检模板中有22个如此。加入基准自带的将性别列为受保护特征的定义也无法消除这一差距，对比依然存在。相比之下，表面上的假阳性差异在身份控制下基本消失，并可追溯到仅存在于部分群体的回收使用蔑称。所有模型共有的错误集中在模型定义与基准定义分歧之处，而成对反事实准确率在端点准确率之外几乎没有额外信息量。我们认为，验证LLM测量需要身份控制的测量不变性测试，同时考察模型的决策及其陈述的判断标准。
translation.brief: 针对LLM仇恨言论分类器可能对不同群体应用不同判断标准的问题，通过身份互换模板的测量不变性测试，结合模型理由分析揭示针对女性的构念偏移。

papers.title: Semantic Caches for LLM Web Services Leave Their Error Budget Unspent
papers.abstract: Web services built on large language models (LLMs) receive many paraphrases of earlier queries, which a semantic cache answers from stored responses. A reused answer can be wrong, so wrong answers must stay below a share $\delta$ of the queries. Existing caches reuse above a fixed similarity threshold or, like vCache, learn a per-entry rule that bounds each query's error by $\delta$. However, fixed thresholds break the budget on new streams, and per-entry rules need labels on every entry before reusing it. We find an unspent error budget, as vCache realizes only 12-55% of $\delta$ on three public query streams. Surplus spends this budget where reuse is most likely correct. It ranks queries by a risk score shared across paraphrase clusters and opens risk bins as far as an audited error estimate allows. Free labels from every LLM call and a ledger of realized errors keep this threshold safe under drift. On five streams, including ORCAS search queries, Surplus holds $\delta$ in every test cell, which no baseline does. On the shuffled streams it serves 40% more hits than vCache, and its pooled hit rate beats the best baseline holding $\delta$ in each cell by 4.10 points. In a vLLM testbed it cuts the mean latency by 31.59% at the highest load, against 23.67% for vCache.

translation.title: LLM Web服务中的语义缓存未用尽其错误预算
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的Web服务会收到许多先前查询的改写形式，语义缓存可用存储的响应来回答这些查询。复用的答案可能是错误的，因此错误答案必须保持在查询占比$\delta$以下。现有缓存在固定相似度阈值之上复用，或像vCache那样学习逐条目规则，将每个查询的错误限制在$\delta$内。然而，固定阈值在新数据流上会突破预算，而逐条目规则在复用前需要对每个条目打标签。我们发现存在未用尽的错误预算：vCache在三个公开查询流上仅实现了$\delta$的12-55%。Surplus在复用最可能正确的位置花费这一预算。它按改写簇间共享的风险分数对查询排序，并在经审计的错误估计允许的范围内开启风险分箱。来自每次LLM调用的免费标签和已实现错误的账本使该阈值在分布漂移下保持安全。在包括ORCAS搜索查询在内的五个数据流上，Surplus在每个测试单元中都保持$\delta$，这是任何基线都做不到的。在打乱的数据流上，它比vCache多服务40%的命中，其合并命中率比在每个单元中保持$\delta$的最佳基线高4.10个百分点。在vLLM测试平台中，它在最高负载下将平均延迟降低31.59%，而vCache为23.67%。
translation.brief: 针对语义缓存复用错误率约束下错误预算未被充分利用的问题，提出Surplus，通过跨改写簇共享的风险分数和动态风险分箱，在保证错误预算δ的前提下最大化缓存命中。

papers.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46$\times$ to 10.87$\times$ with one request, and from 1.94$\times$ to 3.93$\times$ with batching.

translation.title: SpecPilot：面向投机解码的自主算法发现与系统优化
translation.abstract: 投机解码利用轻量级drafter加速受内存限制的LLM解码，而并行drafter通过一次前向传播起草整个块进一步扩展了这一加速。然而，这些已发布系统（stock）是否达到了并行起草所允许的完全加速仍不清楚。我们识别出三个挑战。第一，单请求时每步接受的token很少，却要读取所有目标权重。第二，批处理时，每请求的验证工作使相对自回归（AR）解码的加速大约减半。第三，投机解码是部署特定的，没有通用优化适用于每种服务模式、drafter、目标模型和GPU。为应对这些挑战，我们提出SpecPilot，一个自主的智能体循环，为每个部署发现算法和系统优化。在每一轮中，成本模型定位当前系统与其上限之间的最大差距。并行智能体探索各方向并整合成功者。Token forcing将每个输出token与stock对比以检测奖励作弊。结构化记忆将经过验证的机制带入新一轮和新部署。SpecPilot发现了通用的无损12位权重格式、面向混合循环目标的树验证、两级验证和三种批处理机制。我们在四个目标模型、三个drafter、两个GPU平台和五个基准上评估它。在无需训练且无质量损失的情况下，它将单请求下相对AR的加速从stock的4.46倍提升到10.87倍，批处理下从1.94倍提升到3.93倍。
translation.brief: 针对投机解码系统因部署特定而未达最优加速的问题，提出SpecPilot自主智能体循环，通过成本模型定位差距、并行探索和奖励作弊检测来为每个部署自动发现算法与系统优化。

papers.title: Towards Multi-Value Alignment via Value Localization in LLMs
papers.abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with multiple, potentially conflicting human values remains challenging, as existing multi-objective alignment methods often require costly fine-tuning and provide limited insight into the internal mechanisms underlying value-related behaviors. In this work, we investigate multi-value alignment from a mechanistic interpretability perspective by identifying value-sensitive attention heads (value heads) in LLMs. Using a probing-based value localization framework, we discover sparse sets of attention heads associated with diverse dimensions, spanning both human values (e.g., harmlessness, honesty) and stylistic preferences (e.g., coherence, complexity). Analyses across multiple LLM families reveal functional specialization and structured interactions among value heads, including conflicts between certain values. Targeted head ablations further induce substantial, value-specific behavioral changes, providing causal evidence of their functional importance. Building on these findings, we propose an inference-time activation steering strategy that enables controllable alignment with individual values or combinations of values without updating the underlying model parameters, supported by theoretical analysis. Experiments across multiple value alignment benchmarks demonstrate effective single- and multi-value control while largely preserving non-target model performance. Our findings connect mechanistic interpretability with flexible multi-value alignment, offering a foundation for more interpretable and pluralistic LLM behavior. The code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 通过LLM中的价值定位实现多价值对齐
translation.abstract: 使大语言模型（LLM）与多个可能冲突的人类价值对齐仍然具有挑战性，因为现有多目标对齐方法通常需要昂贵的微调，且对价值相关行为的内部机制洞察有限。在本工作中，我们从机制可解释性视角研究多价值对齐，通过识别LLM中的价值敏感注意力头（价值头）。使用基于探测的价值定位框架，我们发现与多个维度相关的稀疏注意力头集合，涵盖人类价值（如无害性、诚实性）和风格偏好（如连贯性、复杂性）。跨多个LLM家族的分析揭示了价值头的功能专业化和结构化交互，包括某些价值之间的冲突。针对性的头消融进一步引发了显著的、价值特定的行为变化，为其功能重要性提供了因果证据。基于这些发现，我们提出一种推理时激活引导策略，无需更新底层模型参数即可实现对单个价值或价值组合的可控对齐，并有理论分析支持。在多个价值对齐基准上的实验表明，该方法能有效实现单价值和多价值控制，同时基本保持非目标模型性能。我们的发现将机制可解释性与灵活的多价值对齐联系起来，为更可解释和多元的LLM行为奠定基础。代码见https URL。
translation.brief: 针对多价值对齐需昂贵微调且缺乏机制洞察的问题，通过探测定位LLM中的价值敏感注意力头，并提出推理时激活引导策略实现无需参数更新的可控多价值对齐。

papers.title: When Prediction Shapes the Future: A BlueSky Agenda for Reflexive Time Series Analysis
papers.abstract: Time-series models are increasingly deployed in operational systems (e.g., inventory management and clinical care) where predictions trigger interventions that alter future observations, producing records we term AI-shaped trajectories. This sequence-prediction coupling deepens as such systems evolve into agents that autonomously predict, act, and remember across long horizons. Such AI-shaped trajectories support immediate performance monitoring, but turn ambiguous once reused as passive data. An algorithm may then misread a prediction-prevented stockout as naturally stable demand, or an averted medical crisis as a false alarm. This ambiguity then propagates into everything built on the record, from retraining and agent memory to downstream predictive tasks. As a result, systems may internalize these intervention effects as natural phenomena, drifting further from the truth at every closed-loop cycle. In this Blue Sky paper, we advocate an agenda for reflexive time-series analysis that shifts the analytical object from the intervention-agnostic sequence to the prediction-action-observation loop. The agenda requires closed-loop provenance to track the operational context (e.g., predictions, policies, and actions), sequence identification to estimate how those actions affect future values under explicit causal assumptions, and closed-loop evaluation to separate intrinsic process prediction from policy-driven effects. This foundation is essential for integrating autonomous agents into such loops at scale, enabling the joint learning of intervention effects and intrinsic dynamics for robust temporal representations.

translation.title: 当预测塑造未来：反身性时间序列分析的 Blue Sky 议程
translation.abstract: 时间序列模型越来越多地部署在运营系统中（如库存管理和临床护理），在这些系统中，预测会触发干预并改变未来的观测，产生我们称为 AI 塑造轨迹（AI-shaped trajectories）的记录。随着此类系统演化为能够在长时程内自主预测、行动和记忆的智能体，这种预测与序列的耦合进一步加深。这类 AI 塑造轨迹支持即时的性能监控，但一旦被当作被动数据复用，就会变得模糊不清。算法可能将一次被预测阻止的缺货误读为天然稳定的需求，或将一次被避免的医疗危机误读为误报。这种模糊性随后会传播到基于该记录构建的一切事物中，从再训练和智能体记忆到下游预测任务。结果是，系统可能将这些干预效应内化为自然现象，并在每个闭环周期中进一步偏离真相。在这篇 Blue Sky 论文中，我们倡导一个反身性时间序列分析议程，将分析对象从与干预无关的序列转移到预测-行动-观测循环。该议程需要闭环溯源以追踪运营上下文（如预测、策略和行动），需要序列识别以在明确的因果假设下估计这些行动如何影响未来值，还需要闭环评估以将内在过程预测与策略驱动的效应区分开来。这一基础对于大规模地将自主智能体集成到此类循环中至关重要，能够联合学习干预效应和内在动态，从而获得鲁棒的时间表示。
translation.brief: 针对预测触发干预后污染时间序列数据的问题，提出以预测-行动-观测循环为分析对象的反身性时间序列分析议程，涵盖闭环溯源、序列识别与闭环评估。

papers.title: Touching Projected Agents through the DAT Screen -System Design and Questions of Interaction Boundaries-
papers.abstract: Touching a virtual agent involves more than detecting a finger on a display: the contact surface can deform and resist the user's push, and the agent can respond to that action. We describe the Desktop Amid Touch (DAT) screen, which combines spatial projection onto a semi-transparent, deformable mesh with touch sensing and motorized control of resistance to indentation. An initial prototype detected a single touch and estimated its position and depth from tension changes around a flexible projection screen. A subsequent prototype added motorized tension control to vary the screen's resistance to indentation. We describe the tension-controlled DAT implementation and its demonstrations, distinguishing what has been observed from what remains an open design question. These capabilities raise a design question: should touchable virtual agents respond as though they had preferences or boundaries, and under what conditions should such behavior be implemented on systems like DAT. The present paper describes a system and frames this question; it does not establish how users interpret an agent's refusal or consent.

translation.title: 通过 DAT 屏幕触摸投影智能体——系统设计与交互边界问题
translation.abstract: 触摸虚拟智能体不仅仅是检测显示屏上的手指：接触面可以变形并抵抗用户的推压，智能体也可以对该动作做出响应。我们介绍了 Desktop Amid Touch（DAT）屏幕，它将空间投影到半透明可变形网格上，并结合触摸感应和电动控制的抗凹陷阻力。初始原型通过柔性投影屏幕周围的张力变化检测单次触摸并估计其位置和深度。后续原型增加了电动张力控制，以改变屏幕对凹陷的阻力。我们描述了张力控制 DAT 的实现及其演示，区分了已观察到的现象与仍待解决的设计问题。这些能力引出一个设计问题：可触摸的虚拟智能体是否应该表现得好像拥有偏好或边界，以及在何种条件下应在 DAT 这类系统上实现此类行为。本文描述了一个系统并提出该问题，但并未确立用户如何解读智能体的拒绝或同意。
translation.brief: 针对虚拟智能体无法被真实触摸的问题，设计了结合可变形投影屏幕、触摸感应与电动张力控制的 DAT 系统，并提出智能体是否应表现偏好与边界的设计问题。

papers.title: When Neither Side Confirms: Destructive Tool Approval Across MCP Servers and Hosts
papers.abstract: LLM agents call tools that delete data or move money through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The specification asks for a human who can deny tool calls but splits the mechanism between the server, which can annotate a tool or ask the user through the host (elicitation), and the host application, which decides whether to prompt. We measure both sides from source code. In a 1,000-repository sample of the official MCP registry, an estimated 90% of destructive tools (95% CI 82-95) have no server-side confirmation, and most servers that elicit proceed, or fall back to a flag the model can set, when the host cannot relay the question. Of 41 popular open-source hosts and agent SDKs, 32 have no approval step by default, including 16 of 25 applications. Pairing sampled destructive tools flagged by a rule-based extractor with these applications, 60.7% of pairs have no enforced human approval by default. Through four agent SDKs, four of five low-cost models executed an injected deletion in 479 of 960 runs. If hosts prompted for every tool not annotated read-only or non-destructive, the unapproved share of these pairs would fall to 5.4%; universal elicitation support would leave 56.7%. Applications should therefore configure approval.

translation.title: 当双方都不确认时：跨 MCP 服务器与宿主的破坏性工具审批问题
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）调用删除数据或转移资金的工具。该规范要求有一个能够拒绝工具调用的人类，但将机制拆分到两端：服务器端可以为工具添加注解或通过宿主向用户发起询问（elicitation），而宿主应用则决定是否弹出提示。我们从源代码测量了这两端。在官方 MCP 注册表的 1,000 个仓库样本中，估计 90% 的破坏性工具（95% CI 82-95）没有服务器端确认，且当宿主无法转发询问时，大多数发起询问的服务器会直接继续执行，或退回到模型可自行设置的标志。在 41 个流行的开源宿主和智能体 SDK 中，32 个默认没有审批步骤，其中包括 25 个应用中的 16 个。将由基于规则的提取器标记的抽样破坏性工具与这些应用配对后，60.7% 的配对默认没有强制的人工审批。通过四个智能体 SDK 测试，五个低成本模型中的四个在 960 次运行中的 479 次执行了注入的删除操作。如果宿主对每个未标注为只读或非破坏性的工具都弹出提示，这些配对中未经审批的比例将降至 5.4%；而普遍支持 elicitation 只能降至 56.7%。因此，应用应当自行配置审批。
translation.brief: 针对 MCP 生态中破坏性工具调用缺乏人工审批的问题，通过源代码测量服务器与宿主两端的确认机制缺口，并证明应由宿主应用配置审批策略。

papers.title: AMLBench: A Real-Incident Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Anti-Money Laundering
papers.abstract: Tracing illicit funds on public blockchains remains largely manual. As funds move across accounts and undergo asset conversions, they become mixed with other inflows, requiring repeated queries and expert judgment to trace. Large language model (LLM) agents offer a way to automate this process, but their ability to reconstruct case-related transfer networks from limited clues remains unclear. To bridge this gap, we present AMLBench, an anti-money laundering (AML) benchmark built from 24 real-world cases and 5.05 million Ethereum transfer records. For each case, agents start from limited clues and explore these transfer records through composable transaction-query and fund-flow analysis tools, deciding which accounts and branches to pursue. The final tracing results are evaluated against case annotations, while tool interaction logs reveal how agents discover and select relevant transfers and at what resource cost. We also develop AMLAgent, which integrates fund-tracing guidance and query feedback to dynamically guide investigative decisions. With GPT-6 Astra, AMLAgent achieves macro averages of 80.82% transfer-level precision and 84.73% query coverage across 24 real-world cases. Further analysis of the large-scale Bybit case reveals substantial differences in transfer retention and token usage across models, even with similar submission precision. AMLBench establishes a reproducible benchmark for evaluating both tracing outcomes and investigative processes, laying the groundwork for more reliable and efficient autonomous AML investigations.

translation.title: AMLBench：面向智能体区块链反洗钱的真实案例基准
translation.abstract: 在公链上追踪非法资金在很大程度上仍依赖人工。随着资金在账户间转移并经历资产转换，它们会与其他流入资金混合，需要反复查询和专家判断才能追踪。大语言模型（LLM）智能体提供了一种自动化该过程的途径，但其从有限线索重建案件相关转账网络的能力仍不清楚。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 AMLBench，一个基于 24 个真实案例和 505 万条 Ethereum 转账记录构建的反洗钱（AML）基准。在每个案例中，智能体从有限线索出发，通过可组合的交易查询和资金流分析工具探索这些转账记录，自行决定追踪哪些账户和分支。最终追踪结果依据案例标注进行评估，而工具交互日志则揭示智能体如何发现和选择相关转账以及付出何种资源代价。我们还开发了 AMLAgent，它整合资金追踪指导和查询反馈，动态引导调查决策。使用 GPT-6 Astra，AMLAgent 在 24 个真实案例上取得 80.82% 的转账级精确率和 84.73% 的查询覆盖率的宏平均。对大规模 Bybit 案例的进一步分析显示，即使提交精确率相近，不同模型在转账保留和代币使用上也存在显著差异。AMLBench 建立了一个可复现的基准，用于同时评估追踪结果和调查过程，为更可靠、更高效的自主 AML 调查奠定基础。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体从有限线索追踪链上非法资金能力不明的问题，构建了基于 24 个真实案例和 505 万条 Ethereum 转账记录的 AMLBench 基准及配套的 AMLAgent。

papers.title: Scientific Liquidity Agents: An Agent-Based Model of Knowledge Arbitrage in Scientific Communities
papers.abstract: Scientific knowledge gains new uses when ideas, methods, and results move between research contexts. Understanding this process requires a model of both specialized knowledge production and the intermediary activities that connect it. We introduce Scientific Liquidity Agents (SLA), an agent-based model of knowledge arbitrage in scientific communities. SLA represents domain specialists and epistemic arbitrageurs within a shared environment of research problems, researcher interactions, and scientific artifacts. Individual decisions connect to collective state through a belief-desire-intention architecture, a prerequisite-based problem graph, a dynamic interaction network, and a persistent publication registry. The framework makes researcher roles and knowledge-transfer frictions explicit, providing a process-oriented account of scientific production and exchange. Two exploratory simulations with 10 and 18 agents produce 68 and 274 registered papers. In the smaller run, arbitrageurs take part in 16 of the 26 contact pairs that join this community into one connected component, while topical similarity alone splits it into seven. The same run yields three similarity edges, 26 contact pairs, and two coauthorship pairs, so measured community structure depends on what counts as a link. Paper production is abundant, but no recorded replication succeeds, which places the bottleneck in verification rather than production. Solved-problem sets correspond to the prerequisite reachability of the disciplines represented in each community. SLA makes knowledge liquidity, the movement and reuse of artifacts across domains, a quantity that agentic science can simulate and measure.

translation.title: 科学流动性智能体：科学共同体中知识套利的基于智能体模型
translation.abstract: 当思想、方法和结果在研究情境之间流动时，科学知识会获得新的用途。理解这一过程需要一个同时刻画专业化知识生产和连接性中介活动的模型。我们提出 Scientific Liquidity Agents（SLA），一个科学共同体中知识套利的基于智能体模型。SLA 在一个由研究问题、研究者互动和科学产物构成的共享环境中表示领域专家和认知套利者。个体决策通过信念-愿望-意图架构、基于先修条件的问题图、动态交互网络和持久的发表注册表与集体状态相连。该框架将研究者角色和知识转移摩擦显式化，为科学生产与交换提供了面向过程的解释。两次分别包含 10 和 18 个智能体的探索性模拟产生了 68 和 274 篇注册论文。在较小规模的运行中，套利者参与了将共同体连接为单一连通分量的 26 个接触对中的 16 个，而仅凭主题相似性会将其分裂为七个。同一运行产生了三条相似性边、26 个接触对和两个合著对，因此测得的共同体结构取决于如何定义链接。论文产出丰富，但没有任何记录在案的复现成功，这表明瓶颈在于验证而非生产。已解决问题的集合对应于各共同体中所属学科的先修可达性。SLA 使知识流动性——产物跨领域的流动与复用——成为智能体科学可以模拟和测量的量。
translation.brief: 针对科学知识跨领域流动与复用缺乏可模拟模型的问题，提出基于智能体的 SLA 模型，用信念-愿望-意图架构和问题图刻画专家与知识套利者的互动。

papers.title: PixelBench: Can LLMs Understand and Generate Images Pixel by Pixel?
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate visual assets through text-based formats such as SVG and CAD, but these symbolic representations describe images using high-level primitives rather than explicit raster values. We ask whether LLMs can instead generate pixel images directly through their existing vocabulary, without a learned image tokenizer or decoder. We introduce PixelBench, a benchmark for text-to-pixel (T2P) and image-to-pixel (I2P) generation across multiple resolutions, together with a complementary pixel-understanding evaluation. Models generate an RGB color palette followed by a grid of indices specifying the palette color of each output pixel. In T2P, the strongest models produce recognizable images directly from text. In I2P, the strongest models outperform palette-matched downsampling and specialized pixelization algorithms at low resolutions. Pixel-understanding performance correlates strongly with generation performance. A resolution-scaling study shows that pixel-generation performance often improves initially before declining at high resolutions. Finally, we introduce Pixel Reconstruction Tuning (PRT), which augments visual instruction tuning with caption-palette-grid trajectories. We post-train Molmo2-4B from its pretraining checkpoint by mixing general instruction data with our curated PRT data, improving performance across 16 visual-centric benchmarks, indicating that explicit pixel reconstruction can provide useful auxiliary supervision.

papers.title: When Cache Pressure Becomes a Trap: Metastability in Agent Serving
papers.abstract: LLM agents repeatedly send a growing conversation to a model, making prefix reuse central to efficient serving. We show that a brief surge can disrupt this reuse and trigger metastable failure in prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated engines: service remains degraded after arrivals return to a load the engine previously sustained. On SGLang, a ten-minute surge reduced goodput by about 88% over the following hour. Removing the residual burst sessions restored service within minutes. The sustaining mechanism is population-cache feedback. Slower calls prolong sessions and enlarge their aggregate context, or working set; the resulting cache misses increase recomputation and further delay departures. A fluid model identifies the resource conditions for this feedback and explains how cache capacity, tool time and base load affect vulnerability. Across 36 simulated deployments, it flags all 17 cache-first cases. Controlled simulations hold the post-surge state fixed and show that changing subsequent arrivals alone reverses the recovery outcome. Once the cache collapses, low-reuse departure capacity sets the scale of the load reduction needed for recovery. Guided by these dynamics, we build Basin, which gives each session a fixed priority, reserves their predicted peak contexts against an adaptive admission budget, extends the cache with idle decode memory, and sheds excess demand. On real H200 1P3D deployments under surges, including long-context SWE-bench Pro sessions, an arrival-time prototype achieves 1.20--1.70x the goodput of Continuum and 2.35--3.59x that of HiCache alone. In simulation, the predictor-driven policy delivers 1.20--2.05x the strongest baseline's goodput across six surge scenarios.

papers.title: EEFA: A Framework for the Ethical Evaluation of AI Agents
papers.abstract: The rapid deployment of autonomous AI agents across consequential domains including healthcare, legal services, nancial management, and enterprise workows has created an urgent governance challenge. While the eld of AI evaluation has produced sophisticated benchmarks for measuring agent capability, these frameworks measure exclusively what agents can do rather than how they do it. The ethical dimensions most critical to responsible agent deployment, in- cluding respect for human autonomy, harm avoidance, transparency and non-deception, privacy compliance, and accountability, are systematically absent from current evaluation practice. This paper addresses that gap through three contributions. First, a structured literature review of twelve leading AI agent benchmarks characterizes the ethical dimensions those bench- marks do and do not measure. Second, the Ethical Evaluation Framework for AI Agents (EEFA) is introduced as a comprehensive, operationalizable instrument for ethical agent evaluation, grounded in established AI ethics principles and designed for use by developers, auditors, and regulators. Third, a reproducible validation protocol is specied for applying the EEFA to deployed agent systems, with illustrative test scenarios across all ve framework dimensions. The EEFA is organized across ve primary dimensions: Autonomy Preservation, Harm Avoid- ance, Transparency and Non-Deception, Privacy Compliance, and Accountability and Traceabil- ity. The framework maps directly onto the requirements of the EU AI Act and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, positioning it as a practical compliance assessment instrument for high-risk AI applications. Empirical application of the framework across diverse benchmarks and agent systems is identied as a priority direction for future work.

papers.title: CR-Bench-v2: Evaluating the Real-World Utility of AI Code Review Agents
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of automated code generation has created a pressing need for automated code review. Yet code review resists full automation: it depends on context beyond the \textit{diff}, on the author's intent, and on judgments about design and maintainability on which even expert reviewers disagree. Existing code review benchmarks lack standardization and rely largely on noisy human review comments scored with text-similarity metrics, which reward surface overlap and fail to measure precision. We introduce \texttt{CR-Bench}, a defect-centric evaluation framework that recasts SWE-Bench issues as pull-request review tasks with full repository context. After filtering for review-detectable defects and grounding each to a single originating pull request, \texttt{CR-Bench} contains 584 instances, with a 174-instance \texttt{CR-Bench-Verified} subset derived from SWE-Bench Verified. Each instance pairs a pull request with a known defect, its ground-truth fix, and a taxonomy label for bug category, impact, and severity. We propose two complementary metrics: \emph{Known-Defect Detection Rate} (KDDR), which measures whether an agent identifies the labeled defect, and \emph{Usefulness Rate}, which measures the fraction of review comments that are actionable. We evaluate eight code review agents over four backbones, plus commercially available Gemini Code Assist, using three independent LLM judges. Even the strongest systems detect only about one-third of known defects (KDDR $\approx$ 33\%), and Gemini Code Assist detects 8.1\%.

papers.title: SeMo3D: Unifying 3D Generation, Editing, and Completion via Selective Modeling
papers.abstract: 3D generation, editing, and completion are typically treated as regenerating the complete 3D asset under task-specific constraints, even when only a local region needs modification. This leads to task isolation, inconsistency in content that should remain unchanged, and dependence on task-specific paired data. We address these issues with a key observation: the three tasks all synthesize a designated region while keeping the rest intact---the full region for generation, the target region for editing, and the missing region for completion. We term this paradigm Selective Modeling and build SeMo3D upon it; it naturally unifies the three tasks, preserves unchanged content by construction, and enables training without paired editing or completion data, since any 3D asset can be partitioned into a selected region and its context. For training, we propose region-selective denoising, which randomly selects regions of varying sizes on standard 3D assets and applies noise and loss only to them, jointly learning all three tasks. For architecture, we propose Omni3DiT, a multi-condition 3D diffusion transformer that distinguishes regions to create from those to retain and fuses image, text, and point guidance for fine-grained control. Experiments across three benchmarks show SeMo3D surpasses state-of-the-art methods on all tasks, delivering multimodal controllability in generation and strong consistency and accuracy in editing and completion. SeMo3D further serves as a unified modeling tool for agents, enabling efficient 3D creation through natural-language interaction. Project page: this https URL.
