papers.title: Bayesian Sequential Optimal Experimental Design for Single-Pixel Imaging using Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Adaptive compressed sensing (CS) aims to select the most informative measurements sequentially, which is crucial for many modern imaging systems. This task can be formulated as a Bayesian sequential optimal experimental design (sOED) problem, where each new acquisition is chosen to maximally reduce uncertainty about the unknown image given prior information and subsequent data provided by acquisitions. However, in single-pixel imaging (SPI), the large design space consists of all possible binary illumination patterns. Directly optimizing the Bayesian sOED objective over this space using conventional methods is generally challenging. In this work, we reformulate sOED for SPI as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem. In RL, an agent learns a policy through repeated experimental trials to maximize a reward, here given as the expected information gain, the most complete measure of uncertainty reduction in Bayesian OED. This avoids the need to directly optimize complex information-theoretic objectives during a measurement to obtain the next design. Instead, the result is a learned policy function that directly maps the current posterior belief about the image to the next optimal binary measurement pattern, in a computationally efficient way. Using a simple yet representative SPI imaging scenario, this work evaluates the scalability of the learned policy under two different policy parameterizations. Furthermore, we investigate how performance deteriorates when only approximate posterior information is available or the measurements are impaired by noise, and propose several strategies to introduce additional design constraints motivated by biomedical applications. The numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Bayesian sOED-RL framework remains robust and can be extended to more complex, large-scale SPI scenarios.

papers.title: Unlocking Criminal Court Decisions: Flexible Information Extraction for Empirical Legal Research
papers.abstract: Criminal verdicts contain descriptions of criminal behavior that can support quantitative legal research, but structuring them requires attributes and extraction rules that cannot always be fully specified in advance. We present an LLM-based pipeline that builds a structured dataset through attribute exploration, text span extraction, and value normalization, guided by annotation instructions that legal experts can refine. We evaluate it on two traffic offenses: driving under the influence (DUI) and driving despite a ban (DDB). For DUI, revising the instructions was associated with higher extraction accuracy (from 52% to 70% of correctly extracted values) and higher agreement between human annotators. Repeated runs of the same model agreed with each other more than with the gold annotations, showing that consistent output is not necessarily correct, while disagreement between annotators and between models helped reveal unclear instructions. For DDB, where the instructions defined fixed categories and output formats, agreement was high for most attributes.

translation.title: 解锁刑事法院判决：面向实证法学研究的灵活信息抽取
translation.abstract: 刑事判决书包含可支持定量法学研究的犯罪行为描述，但对其进行结构化所需的属性和抽取规则往往无法事先完全确定。我们提出一个基于 LLM 的流水线，通过属性探索、文本片段抽取和值规范化构建结构化数据集，并由法学专家可不断修订的标注指令进行引导。我们在两类交通犯罪上对其进行评估：酒驾（DUI）和禁驾后驾驶（DDB）。对于 DUI，修订指令与更高的抽取准确率（正确抽取值从 52% 提升至 70%）以及更高的人工标注者间一致性相关。同一模型的多次运行彼此之间的一致性高于与金标准标注的一致性，这表明输出一致并不一定正确，而标注者之间及模型之间的分歧有助于揭示不清晰的指令。对于 DDB，由于指令定义了固定类别和输出格式，大多数属性上的一致性都很高。
translation.brief: 解决刑事判决书结构化中属性和规则无法事先完全确定的问题，提出由专家可修订指令引导的基于 LLM 的属性探索与信息抽取流水线。

papers.title: PRIME: Predictive Routing of Interventions by Modeling Effects for Scientific Ideation
papers.abstract: Feedback-driven iteration is widely used to improve LLM-generated scientific ideas, but existing systems either leave revision decisions implicit in generation, align revisions with feedback-localized weaknesses, or restrict action selection to system-specific operations. This is problematic because problems, hypotheses, and solutions are interdependent: the location where a weakness manifests does not itself determine the revision scope that will produce a better successor. We term this phenomenon diagnosis-intervention mismatch. We introduce Predictive Routing of Interventions by Modeling Effects (PRIME), a plug-and-play feedback-to-revision decision layer for existing scientific ideators. PRIME operates in three stages: (1) Structural Attribution interprets feedback over the problem-hypothesis-solution structure without fixing a revision target; (2) Counterfactual Routing constructs alternative scope-conditioned interventions and compares their projected successor utility and risks through lightweight rollouts; and (3) Intervention Execution compiles the selected intervention into an ordered generator-facing plan with semantic actions, preservation constraints, and dependency requirements for successor generation. We validate diagnosis intervention mismatch on 112 human-annotated idea-feedback pairs. Across four benchmarks, two ideators, and fixed- and open-problem settings, PRIME improves successor quality and routing reliability over strong baselines; removing counterfactual routing reduces quality from 3.463 to 1.960 and increases route regret from 0.426 to 1.929, confirming cross-scope effect modeling as the primary source of its gains.

translation.title: PRIME：通过建模干预效果实现科学构思中的预测性干预路由
translation.abstract: 基于反馈的迭代被广泛用于改进 LLM 生成的科学想法，但现有系统要么将修订决策隐含在生成过程中，要么将修订与反馈定位的弱点对齐，要么将动作选择限制在系统特定的操作上。这是有问题的，因为问题、假设和解决方案相互依赖：弱点显现的位置本身并不决定能产生更好后继方案的修订范围。我们将这一现象称为诊断-干预失配。我们提出 PRIME（Predictive Routing of Interventions by Modeling Effects），一个面向现有科学构思系统的即插即用反馈到修订决策层。PRIME 分三个阶段运行：（1）结构归因在问题-假设-解决方案结构上解释反馈，而不固定修订目标；（2）反事实路由构建备选的范围条件化干预，并通过轻量级 rollout 比较其预计的后继效用和风险；（3）干预执行将选定的干预编译为面向生成器的有序计划，包含语义动作、保留约束和依赖要求，用于后继生成。我们在 112 个人工标注的想法-反馈对上验证了诊断-干预失配现象。在四个基准、两个构思系统以及固定问题和开放问题设置上，PRIME 相比强基线提升了后继质量和路由可靠性；移除反事实路由会使质量从 3.463 降至 1.960，路由遗憾从 0.426 升至 1.929，证实跨范围效果建模是其收益的主要来源。
translation.brief: 解决科学构思中弱点诊断位置与有效修订范围不匹配的问题，提出 PRIME 决策层，通过反事实路由比较不同范围干预的预计效果来选择修订方案。

papers.title: Networked AI: Architecture, Theory, and Applications
papers.abstract: Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly large-scale deep learning, have been driven by monolithic or offline training on massive curated datasets. While successful, these approaches face structural limitations: escalating data and computational demands, limited online adaptability, and a lack of system-level intelligence in open, non-stationary environments. This paper presents Networked AI - a networked intelligent system composed of interacting, heterogeneous, and continuously evolving AI agents. We establish a hierarchical layered architecture comprising an Agent Layer for heterogeneous capability construction, an Interaction Layer for signal-processing-guided online data extraction, and a Regulation Layer for stability-constrained collective evolution. Foundations in data science, signal processing, and system control are hereby synthesized into a unified theoretical framework of Networked AI, providing superior data efficiency, intelligence efficiency, interpretability, and scalability. Theoretical and experimental analysis demonstrates that Networked AI can approach near-linear scaling in resource demand, in contrast to the exponential increase in standalone end-to-end systems. It provides not only online adaptation to out-of-distribution environmental novelties, but also the autonomous evolution towards application-specific intelligence. Application frontiers are discussed for IoT spaces, embodied, spatial, and industrial intelligences, as well as the cellular infrastructure and beyond. Key open challenges are identified towards realizing locally autonomous, collectively intelligent, continuously evolving, globally regulated Networked AI.

translation.title: 网络化人工智能：架构、理论与应用
translation.abstract: 人工智能（AI）的最新进展，尤其是大规模深度学习，是由在海量精选数据集上的单体或离线训练驱动的。这些方法虽然成功，但面临结构性局限：数据和计算需求不断攀升、在线适应能力有限、以及在开放非平稳环境中缺乏系统级智能。本文提出网络化人工智能（Networked AI）——一个由相互交互、异构且持续演化的 AI 智能体组成的网络化智能系统。我们建立了一个分层架构，包括用于异构能力构建的智能体层、用于信号处理引导的在线数据抽取的交互层，以及用于稳定性约束下集体演化的调控层。由此将数据科学、信号处理和系统控制的基础融合为网络化人工智能的统一理论框架，提供更优的数据效率、智能效率、可解释性和可扩展性。理论与实验分析表明，网络化人工智能可使资源需求接近线性扩展，而独立端到端系统则呈指数增长。它不仅提供对分布外环境新异性的在线适应，还提供面向特定应用智能的自主演化。本文讨论了物联网空间、具身智能、空间智能和工业智能以及蜂窝基础设施等应用前沿，并指出了实现本地自治、集体智能、持续演化、全局调控的网络化人工智能的关键开放挑战。
translation.brief: 解决单体离线训练 AI 在数据需求、在线适应和系统级智能上的结构性局限，提出由智能体层、交互层和调控层组成的网络化人工智能分层架构与统一理论框架。

papers.title: Towards a Trustworthy and Governable Internet of Agentics: An Architectural Perspective on Protocols, Systems, and Services
papers.abstract: Large language model applications are increasingly being organized as tool-using and multi-agent workflows rather than as isolated chat interfaces. This perspective paper examines the architectural problem that follows from that shift: agents may reason, invoke tools, and delegate work, but dependable deployment still requires interoperability across frameworks, runtimes, data boundaries, and organizational control domains. We study this problem through the lens of the \emph{Internet of Agentics} (IoA), an emerging service-computing view in which heterogeneous agents are treated as governable service participants rather than only as stand-alone model endpoints. The paper organizes the landscape as a three-layer progression: from today's fragmented agent ecosystem, to interoperable agents, and ultimately to trustworthy and governable autonomy. First, it examines the protocol stack centered on the Agentic AI Foundation, including MCP for agent--tool interaction; A2A for agent--agent coordination; this http URL and Skills-style procedural manifests; and discovery, transport, and trust mechanisms such as AGNTCY and SLIM. Second, it reviews the systems abstractions that make agents deployable as service components, including logical agent architectures, orchestration patterns, gateways, registries, runtime control loops, and hardware-aware inference infrastructure. Third, it situates these developments within services computing, arguing that agentic systems reinterpret classical concerns from SOA and microservices---discovery, composition, governance, pricing, and trust---at the level of cognitive capabilities rather than deterministic functions.

translation.title: 迈向可信可治理的智能体互联网：协议、系统与服务的架构视角
translation.abstract: 大语言模型应用正日益被组织为使用工具和多智能体的工作流，而非孤立的聊天界面。本视角论文审视这一转变所引发的架构问题：智能体可以推理、调用工具和委派工作，但可靠的部署仍需要跨框架、运行时、数据边界和组织控制域的互操作性。我们通过智能体互联网（Internet of Agentics, IoA）的视角研究这一问题，这是一种新兴的服务计算观点，将异构智能体视为可治理的服务参与者，而不仅仅是独立的模型端点。本文将这一领域组织为三层递进：从当今碎片化的智能体生态，到可互操作的智能体，最终到可信且可治理的自治。首先，它考察了以 Agentic AI Foundation 为核心的协议栈，包括用于智能体-工具交互的 MCP、用于智能体间协调的 A2A、this http URL 和 Skills 风格的程序化清单，以及 AGNTCY 和 SLIM 等发现、传输和信任机制。其次，它综述了使智能体可作为服务组件部署的系统抽象，包括逻辑智能体架构、编排模式、网关、注册表、运行时控制回路和硬件感知的推理基础设施。第三，它将这些发展置于服务计算的语境中，论证智能体系统在认知能力而非确定性函数的层面上重新诠释了 SOA 和微服务的经典议题——发现、组合、治理、定价和信任。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体应用跨框架、运行时和组织控制域的可信互操作问题，从协议栈、系统抽象和服务计算三个层面梳理智能体互联网的架构演进路径。

papers.title: PACERec: Progressive Adaptation of LLM Item Embeddings with Collaborative Evidence for Recommendation
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) embeddings have been increasingly adopted in sequential recommendation to encode static item attributes and alleviate the limitations of item ID embeddings under sparse interactions. However, these embeddings typically capture only static content similarity while neglecting sequential transitions, and since their adaptation quality relies on sparse per-item updates or global geometric calibration, existing methods still struggle to explicitly transfer preceding interaction contexts from frequent to long-tail items under unevenly distributed behavioral evidence, limiting recommendation effectiveness across the catalog. To address this challenge, we propose PACERec, an ID-free progressive adaptation framework that incorporates preceding interaction contexts into semantic representation adaptation by learning a shared velocity field from items with sufficient interactions via frequency-weighted flow matching. In this way, PACERec progressively guides static LLM embeddings toward collaborative behavioral targets while preserving original item semantics, overcoming sparse per-item updates to effectively generalize sequential transition patterns to long-tail items for both user modeling and candidate scoring. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets across three sequential backbones demonstrate the superiority of our method over competitive baselines in both overall and long-tail recommendation.

translation.title: PACERec：基于协同证据的 LLM 物品嵌入渐进式自适应推荐
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）嵌入在序列推荐中被越来越多地用于编码静态物品属性，以缓解稀疏交互下物品 ID 嵌入的局限。然而，这些嵌入通常只捕捉静态内容相似性而忽略序列转移，且其适配质量依赖于稀疏的逐物品更新或全局几何校准，现有方法仍难以在行为证据分布不均的情况下，将先前交互上下文从高频物品显式迁移到长尾物品，限制了在整个物品目录上的推荐效果。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 PACERec，一个无 ID 的渐进式适配框架，通过频率加权的流匹配从具有充分交互的物品中学习共享速度场，将先前交互上下文融入语义表示适配。这样，PACERec 在保留原始物品语义的同时，渐进地将静态 LLM 嵌入引导至协同行为目标，克服稀疏的逐物品更新，有效地将序列转移模式泛化到长尾物品，用于用户建模和候选打分。在三个真实数据集和三种序列骨干上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在整体推荐和长尾推荐上均优于竞争基线。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 物品嵌入难以将序列交互模式从高频物品迁移到长尾物品的问题，提出通过频率加权流匹配学习共享速度场来渐进适配嵌入的无 ID 框架 PACERec。

papers.title: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
papers.abstract: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. We identify three core research challenges: identity-continuous personalization that carries user preferences across tasks, user-situated evolution through Rehearsal Engineering, and safety mechanisms that combine technical control with accountability and recourse. These directions define a research agenda for reliable decision delegation to personal agents across tasks and over time.

translation.title: Avatar Intelligence：通过持久化个人智能体放大人类能动性
translation.abstract: 个人AI智能体处理跨应用的长周期任务的能力日益增强，但用户往往需要投入大量精力来指定目标、消解歧义和验证结果。我们认为，进步的衡量标准应是智能体放大人类能动性的效果：使人们能够以更少的常规监督追求目标，同时保留对重大决策的控制权。我们倡导Avatar Intelligence，这是一种持久化个人智能体的范式，通过跨情境、跨时间的持续决策委托来代表用户的目标、价值观和约束。我们描述了从人类主导执行到在受托领域内自主运行的成熟度路线图，并引入智能体监督指数（Agentic Oversight Index, AOI）作为评估框架，将交付价值与智能体侧运营成本及人类监督负担进行对比。我们识别出三大核心研究挑战：跨任务延续用户偏好的身份连续个性化、通过Rehearsal Engineering实现的用户情境化演化，以及结合技术控制与问责和救济机制的安全机制。这些方向定义了向个人智能体进行跨任务、跨时间可靠决策委托的研究议程。
translation.brief: 该论文提出Avatar Intelligence范式，通过持久化个人智能体实现跨任务、跨时间的可靠决策委托，以放大人类能动性并降低监督负担。

papers.title: An Experimental Study of Hybrid Retrieval, NLI and Open-source LLMs for Scientific Claim Verification
papers.abstract: Claim verification is the task of deciding whether a source text supports a claim, contradicts it, or lacks sufficient evidence. Natural Language Inference (NLI) models can judge whether a single sentence supports or contradicts a claim, but they struggle when the evidence is spread across several sentences. Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) can reason across sentences, but may draw conclusions the text does not support. In this experimental study, we test whether a conservative fusion rule, labeling a claim Support or Contradict only when both models agree and defaulting to Not Enough Evidence otherwise, combines their strengths. We construct a benchmark of 2,035 claims from SciFact and CliniFact (858 Support, 152 Contradict, 1,025 Not Enough Evidence). We retrieve the top five most relevant sentences per claim using a hybrid of semantic and lexical (BM25) retrieval, which slightly outperforms either method alone. These retrieved sentences are then provided to every verification model. We then compare a DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli NLI baseline against Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen3 8B, and Mistral 7B. Qwen3 achieves the highest Macro-F1 (0.7937), followed by Llama 3.1 (0.7204) and Mistral (0.6388), while the NLI baseline reaches only 0.3157. Contrary to our hypothesis, fusion degrades performance, dropping Macro-F1 to 0.7392, 0.6730, and 0.5991, respectively. To understand this decline, we analyze agreements, disagreements, and common error patterns between the NLI and LLM verifiers. Our error analysis shows that NLI and LLM disagreements often result in correct LLM predictions being overturned.

translation.title: 面向科学论断验证的混合检索、NLI与开源大语言模型实验研究
translation.abstract: 论断验证的任务是判断源文本是支持、反驳某个论断，还是证据不足。自然语言推理（NLI）模型可以判断单个句子是否支持或反驳论断，但当证据分散在多个句子中时表现不佳。相反，大语言模型（LLM）能够跨句子推理，但可能得出文本不支持的结论。在这项实验研究中，我们测试一种保守融合规则：仅当两个模型一致时才标注为支持或反驳，否则默认为证据不足，以期结合两者优势。我们基于SciFact和CliniFact构建了包含2,035条论断的基准（858条支持、152条反驳、1,025条证据不足）。我们使用语义与词法（BM25）混合检索为每条论断获取最相关的前五个句子，其效果略优于任一单独方法。这些检索到的句子被提供给每个验证模型。我们将DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli NLI基线与Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen3 8B和Mistral 7B进行比较。Qwen3取得最高的Macro-F1（0.7937），其次是Llama 3.1（0.7204）和Mistral（0.6388），而NLI基线仅为0.3157。与我们的假设相反，融合反而降低了性能，Macro-F1分别降至0.7392、0.6730和0.5991。为理解这一下降，我们分析了NLI与LLM验证器之间的一致、分歧及常见错误模式。错误分析表明，NLI与LLM的分歧常常导致LLM的正确预测被推翻。
translation.brief: 该论文研究科学论断验证，通过混合检索结合NLI模型与开源LLM，并实验检验保守融合规则能否结合两者优势。

papers.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.

translation.title: DR Pixel：基于视觉语言模型的页面原生深度研究
translation.abstract: 科学论文等复杂文档在表格、图形和公式中包含丰富信息；然而现有的深度研究（DR）智能体通常将论文简化为OCR提取的文本。我们转而探究视觉语言模型（VLM）能否实现页面原生深度研究：直接在渲染的文档页面图像上进行检索和推理。我们提出DR Pixel，这是首个开源端到端多模态DR智能体，以渲染页面图像作为唯一的检索单元和推理单元，运行于106万页的语料库之上。为评估这一设定，我们构建了DRPixelBench，一个要求对文本、图形、表格和公式进行推理的科学论文基准。令人惊讶的是，页面原生DR无需训练即可良好运行，在GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.5-Flash和Qwen3.6-27B等最先进模型上均优于基于OCR的基线，且所需工具调用更少。接下来我们转向DR训练。一个关键挑战是用于智能体监督微调的教师轨迹充满噪声，将关键推理与动作步骤同冗余或失败的尝试混杂在一起。为此，我们提出反事实信用重加权（counterfactual credit reweighting），一种细粒度信用分配方法，根据各推理与动作步骤对最终答案的反事实贡献进行加权。我们的训练在DRPixelBench上将检索召回率提升约15分，最终准确率提升超过10分，并在四个现有基准上优于未训练基线。在分布外的ViDoRe-V3上，DR Pixel与直接给定金标页面的oracle仅相差1.8分。我们的结果表明，传统的先OCR再检索的流水线不仅不必要，而且是次优的：直接在视觉文档页面上检索和推理使复杂DR更有效也更高效。
translation.brief: 该论文提出DR Pixel，直接以渲染页面图像为检索单元进行深度研究，并引入反事实信用重加权方法改进智能体训练。

papers.title: LUCA: A Synthetic World for Experimental Reasoning
papers.abstract: An experimental agent can succeed for the wrong reasons. Evaluations, however, often focus on the outcome, not the experiments, evidence, and inferences that produced it. We introduce LUCA, a configurable synthetic world for evaluating this process under fully known ground truth. Agents learn unknown regulatory systems through budgeted experimentation, then predict unseen interventions, diagnose hidden faults, and attempt rescues. This setup allows us to evaluate experiment selection, prediction, diagnosis, and intervention separately. Across seven frontier LLMs and three baselines, these capabilities dissociate sharply. Agents frequently rescue malfunctioning systems while diagnosing the wrong fault; diagnosis varies 7x across models while prediction varies only 1.4x. Models also adopt surprisingly different experimental strategies, and greater exploration does not reliably yield better performance. In one failure mode, agents often perform the experiment needed to distinguish competing causes, but still fail to use the resulting evidence. LUCA turns these hidden failures into measurable behaviours, providing a controlled environment to study where experimental agents succeed and fail. Code: this https URL.

translation.title: LUCA：一个用于实验推理的合成世界
translation.abstract: 实验智能体可能因错误的原因而成功。然而，评估往往只关注结果，而非产生结果的实验、证据和推理。我们提出LUCA，一个完全已知真值、用于评估这一过程的可配置合成世界。智能体通过预算受限的实验学习未知的调控系统，然后预测未见过的干预、诊断隐藏故障并尝试修复。这一设定使我们能够分别评估实验选择、预测、诊断和干预能力。在七个前沿LLM和三个基线上，这些能力呈现显著分化。智能体经常在修复故障系统的同时诊断出错误的故障；诊断能力在模型间差异达7倍，而预测能力仅差1.4倍。各模型采用的实验策略也大相径庭，且更多探索并不必然带来更好表现。在一种失败模式中，智能体常常执行了区分竞争性原因所需的实验，却仍未能利用由此产生的证据。LUCA将这些隐藏的失败转化为可测量的行为，提供了一个受控环境来研究实验智能体在何处成功、何处失败。代码：this https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文提出LUCA合成世界，在真值完全已知的环境下分别评估LLM智能体的实验选择、预测、诊断与干预能力。

papers.title: COVE: A Task-Adaptive, Code-Based Ensemble for Proactive Verification of LLM Outputs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are now embedded in enterprise workflows, yet their outputs remain prone to hallucinations: plausible-sounding but factually incorrect or malformed content. Most verification approaches are reactive, detecting errors only after generation and often spending additional expensive LLM calls to do so. We present COVE, a task-adaptive, code-based ensemble that takes the opposite stance: it prevents errors before generation and validates structure and consistency afterwards using six deterministic, pure-Python innovations that add no extra LLM calls. On an internal evaluation spanning 11 text datasets (1,020 examples) and 4 image datasets (200 examples), COVE lifts text accuracy from a 45.2% unverified baseline to 82.1% (an 81.7% relative improvement), improves image accuracy by 69.5%, and reduces token usage by 48 to 96% (simulated cost model), at a measured verification overhead of 0.26 ms per output (excluding the LLM call). This article describes the engineering design of each innovation (with pseudocode and the exact parameters we use), the measured impact, an ablation of every component, and the practical lessons learned from deploying code-based verification in enterprise pipelines.

translation.title: COVE：一种任务自适应、基于代码的LLM输出主动验证集成方法
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）如今已嵌入企业工作流，但其输出仍易出现幻觉：听起来合理但事实错误或格式错误的内容。大多数验证方法是被动式的，仅在生成后检测错误，且往往需要额外昂贵的LLM调用。我们提出COVE，一种任务自适应、基于代码的集成方法，采取相反立场：它在生成前预防错误，并在生成后使用六项确定性的纯Python创新技术验证结构与一致性，且不增加任何额外LLM调用。在涵盖11个文本数据集（1,020个样本）和4个图像数据集（200个样本）的内部评估中，COVE将文本准确率从45.2%的未验证基线提升至82.1%（相对提升81.7%），图像准确率提升69.5%，并将token使用量降低48%至96%（模拟成本模型），实测验证开销为每输出0.26毫秒（不含LLM调用）。本文描述了每项创新的工程设计（附伪代码和我们使用的确切参数）、实测影响、每个组件的消融实验，以及在企业流水线中部署基于代码的验证所获得的实践经验。
translation.brief: 该论文提出COVE，用六项纯Python确定性技术在生成前后主动验证LLM输出，无需额外LLM调用即可降低幻觉并节省成本。

papers.title: Preprocessing Choices in Fine-Tuning Data Matter: Utility and Demographic Sensitivity in LLM-Based Recommendation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have introduced a generative approach to recommendation, producing item lists from textual representations of user histories and item information. However, this generative setting raises challenges concerning output validity, prompt consistency, and sensitivity to demographic descriptors. In this work, we investigate how preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior in a generative LLM-based recommender system. We first establish a controlled recommendation pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning, catalog-constrained decoding, and prompt augmentation. We then study three preprocessing choices: item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. Experiments on MovieLens-1M show that the catalog-constrained pipeline eliminates out-of-catalog items and ensures complete ten-item outputs, while prompt augmentation improves prompt consistency and utility. Original MovieLens titles increase HR@10 from 10.67% to 12.47% and Coverage@10 from 41.36% to 47.88%. Fairness-related effects are attribute-dependent: age balancing and knowledge enrichment reduce selected group-level utility gaps while largely preserving utility, whereas gender balancing reduces utility without improving the evaluated gender-related indicators. Overall, preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data should be evaluated jointly in terms of utility, output behavior, and demographic sensitivity.

translation.title: 微调数据预处理选择至关重要：基于LLM的推荐中的效用与人口统计敏感性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）为推荐系统引入了生成式方法，从用户历史和物品信息的文本表示中生成物品列表。然而，这种生成式设定带来了输出有效性、提示一致性和对人口统计描述符敏感性方面的挑战。在本工作中，我们研究了微调数据的预处理选择如何影响基于生成式LLM的推荐系统的推荐效用和公平相关行为。我们首先建立了一个结合监督微调、目录约束解码和提示增强的受控推荐流水线。然后我们研究了三种预处理选择：物品标题表示、人口统计平衡和辅助物品知识增强。在MovieLens-1M上的实验表明，目录约束流水线消除了目录外物品并确保输出完整的十个物品，而提示增强提高了提示一致性和效用。原始MovieLens标题将HR@10从10.67%提升到12.47%，Coverage@10从41.36%提升到47.88%。公平相关效应依赖于属性：年龄平衡和知识增强在基本保持效用的同时减少了选定的群体级效用差距，而性别平衡降低了效用却未改善所评估的性别相关指标。总体而言，微调数据中的预处理选择应在效用、输出行为和人口统计敏感性方面进行联合评估。
translation.brief: 研究生成式LLM推荐系统中微调数据预处理选择（标题表示、人口平衡、知识增强）对推荐效用与公平性的影响，通过构建含目录约束解码与提示增强的受控流水线进行实验分析。

papers.title: From Local Skills to Long-Horizon Web Tasks: Progressive Skill Exploration for LLM Web Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are driving autonomous agents toward real-world environments, with the Web emerging as one of the most representative interaction scenarios. However, training Web agents with naive exploration remains challenging: successful trajectories are rare, and the sparse terminal rewards make it difficult for agents to obtain useful feedback from failed trajectories. Inspired by skill acquisition theory, we propose Skill-Composed Progressive Exploration (SCOPE), a short-to-long learning framework for long-horizon Web agents that decomposes complex task exploration into a gradual expansion process from local skills to complete task-solving capability. Specifically, SCOPE iteratively explores around local skills: Skill Discovery extracts reusable local skills and failure experiences from historical rollouts; Skill Orchestration composes discovered skills into high-level skill chains; and Skill Expansion leverages failure experiences aligned with the current skill chain to guide the agent toward exploring new subskills. Through this process, SCOPE progressively constructs task-completing skill chains across rollouts and internalizes them into the policy parameters through agentic on-policy distillation. Extensive experiments on WebArena, WebVoyager, and WebShop show that SCOPE consistently improves exploration dynamics and achieves 3.9% to 18.6% relative gains over the strongest baselines in each setting.

translation.title: 从局部技能到长程Web任务：LLM Web智能体的渐进式技能探索
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正推动自主智能体走向真实世界环境，Web成为最具代表性的交互场景之一。然而，用朴素探索训练Web智能体仍然充满挑战：成功轨迹稀少，稀疏的终端奖励使智能体难以从失败轨迹中获得有用反馈。受技能习得理论启发，我们提出Skill-Composed Progressive Exploration（SCOPE），一个面向长程Web智能体的由短到长学习框架，将复杂任务探索分解为从局部技能到完整任务解决能力的渐进扩展过程。具体而言，SCOPE围绕局部技能迭代探索：技能发现从历史rollout中提取可复用的局部技能和失败经验；技能编排将发现的技能组合成高层技能链；技能扩展利用与当前技能链对齐的失败经验引导智能体探索新的子技能。通过这一过程，SCOPE在多次rollout中逐步构建完成任务所需的技能链，并通过智能体在策略蒸馏将其内化到策略参数中。在WebArena、WebVoyager和WebShop上的大量实验表明，SCOPE持续改善探索动态，在每种设置下相对最强基线取得3.9%到18.6%的相对提升。
translation.brief: 解决Web智能体训练中成功轨迹稀少、稀疏奖励导致探索困难的问题，提出SCOPE框架，通过技能发现、编排与扩展将复杂任务探索分解为从局部技能到完整任务能力的渐进扩展。

papers.title: ComplianceAtlas: A Taxonomy-Driven Agentic AI Framework for Automated AI Act Gap Analysis and Remediation
papers.abstract: Assessing regulatory compliance for high-risk AI systems requires systematic identification of technical gaps such as missing controls, in- adequate processes, or shallow evaluation of practices. Compliance officers typically admin- ister structured questionnaires collecting evi- dence of current practices, where organizations respond with descriptions of their existing pro- cesses, technical capabilities, and architectural choices. However, translating these compli- ance questionnaire responses into typed, ac- tionable gap diagnoses remains unsystematic. In this paper, we present a literature-grounded taxonomy of technical compliance gaps cover- ing areas such as accuracy, robustness, logging, and human oversight, and embed it in GapTo- Compliance, a two-stage agentic framework coordinating two specialized agents: a Gap Extraction Agent that performs hierarchical rea- soning from compliance areas to specific gap types, and a Remediation Planning Agent that ranks remediation actions from a remediation catalog via multi-signal scoring combining se- mantic similarity, regulatory alignment, and effort estimation. We evaluate this framework against four automatic compliance gap detec- tion baselines across 9 AI systems and 6 AI families. Our approach achieves a gap-type F1 of 0.831 (vs. 0.533 for the strongest baseline) and remediation P@5 of 0.872 (vs. 0.635 for retrieval methods), demonstrating promising potential for automated compliance workflows. The structured agent coordination reveals a path toward human-in-the-loop compliance systems where automated gap extraction reduces expert burden while maintaining auditability, and the taxonomy-driven design enables extension to emerging regulatory frameworks beyond

translation.title: ComplianceAtlas：面向AI法案差距分析与修复的分类体系驱动的智能体AI框架
translation.abstract: 评估高风险AI系统的法规合规性需要系统性地识别技术差距，如缺失的控制措施、不充分的流程或浅层的实践评估。合规官通常通过结构化问卷收集当前实践的证据，组织则以现有流程、技术能力和架构选择的描述进行回应。然而，将这些合规问卷回答转化为类型化、可操作的差距诊断仍然缺乏系统性。本文提出了一个基于文献的技术合规差距分类体系，涵盖准确性、鲁棒性、日志记录和人类监督等领域，并将其嵌入GapToCompliance——一个协调两个专用智能体的两阶段智能体框架：差距提取智能体执行从合规领域到具体差距类型的层次化推理，修复规划智能体通过结合语义相似度、法规对齐和工作量估计的多信号评分，从修复目录中对修复行动进行排序。我们在9个AI系统和6个AI家族上将该框架与四个自动合规差距检测基线进行评估。我们的方法取得了0.831的差距类型F1（最强基线为0.533）和0.872的修复P@5（检索方法为0.635），展示了自动合规工作流的良好潜力。结构化的智能体协调揭示了通向人在回路合规系统的路径——自动差距提取在保持可审计性的同时减轻专家负担，而分类体系驱动的设计使其能够扩展到新兴监管框架。
translation.brief: 解决将合规问卷回答转化为类型化、可操作的AI法案差距诊断缺乏系统性的问题，提出基于分类体系的两阶段智能体框架，由差距提取智能体和修复规划智能体分别完成差距识别与修复行动排序。

papers.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
papers.abstract: Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level, an outer world-data-model flywheel continuously incorporates open-world corpus and leverages evolving model weaknesses to guide subsequent data construction and optimization iterations. At the data level, an inner flywheel couples open-world seeding and autocatalytic propagation. The former mines authentic workflows as seed tasks from instructional videos, and employs visual-semantic dual-path trajectory reconstruction; The latter transforms these seeds into reusable primitives for controllable synthesis of diverse, complex, and verifiable tasks. To enable efficient and reliable trajectory collection, we further introduce a feedback-guided snapshot-rollback retry mechanism in various real environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CUA-Master-27B achieves competitive performance across GUI-only and GUI-CLI hybrid benchmarks, scoring 80.2 on OSWorld Verified, 36.9 on OSWorld 2.0, 43.9 on WeaveBench, and 25.0 on Agents' Last Exam. Our framework also substantially improves the quality and efficiency of data synthesis, and exhibits continuous gains across recursive iterations.

translation.title: CUA-Master：通过开放世界递归改进扩展计算机使用智能体
translation.abstract: 尽管计算机使用智能体（CUA）近期取得进展，其发展仍受限于交互数据的多样性、可控性和可靠性不足。此外，传统优化流水线缺乏迭代反馈，而现有递归改进方法往往依赖自生成经验，限制了能力扩展并导致收益递减。为应对这些挑战，我们提出CUA-Master，一个嵌套双循环递归改进框架。在系统层面，外层的世界-数据-模型飞轮持续纳入开放世界语料，并利用不断演化的模型弱点指导后续的数据构建和优化迭代。在数据层面，内层飞轮耦合开放世界播种与自催化传播。前者从教学视频中挖掘真实工作流作为种子任务，并采用视觉-语义双路径轨迹重建；后者将这些种子转化为可复用原语，用于可控地合成多样、复杂且可验证的任务。为实现高效可靠的轨迹收集，我们进一步在多种真实环境中引入反馈引导的快照回滚重试机制。大量实验表明，CUA-Master-27B在纯GUI和GUI-CLI混合基准上均取得有竞争力的性能，在OSWorld Verified上得分80.2，OSWorld 2.0上36.9，WeaveBench上43.9，Agents' Last Exam上25.0。我们的框架还显著提升了数据合成的质量和效率，并在递归迭代中展现持续增益。
translation.brief: 解决CUA交互数据多样性、可控性和可靠性不足及递归改进依赖自生成经验导致收益递减的问题，提出嵌套双循环递归改进框架，通过世界-数据-模型飞轮和开放世界播种加自催化传播实现数据合成与能力扩展。

papers.title: Controlling Sharpening in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract: LLM post-training via reinforcement learning has shown consistent improvements in accuracy at the cost of reducing behavioral coverage - a phenomenon known as sharpening that can stall progress on difficult tasks. Repeated sampling objectives such as $\mathrm{pass@k}$ and $\mathrm{max@k}$ are known to mitigate sharpening, but the mechanism behind it remains poorly understood. Moreover, existing approaches for $\mathrm{@k}$ optimization use dedicated algorithms, and no general framework exists for adapting established policy optimization methods from $\mathrm{@}1$ to $\mathrm{@k}$. We derive the optimal policies for KL-regularized $\mathrm{pass@k}$ and $\mathrm{max@k}$ objectives in closed form. Our explicit solutions reveal that $\mathrm{@k}$ optimization naturally redistributes learning pressure based on prompt difficulty, directing it toward harder problems. Crucially, we show that standard $\mathrm{@}1$ objectives achieve these exact same optimal policies through prompt-adaptive regularization or reward transformation. Ultimately, this yields an optimizer-independent explanation for why $\mathrm{@k}$ objectives reduce sharpening on easy tasks while prioritizing success on harder ones. Building on these insights, we introduce $\mathrm{@k}$ Adaptive Pressure for Policy Optimization (KAPPO). Following a one-time reference calibration, KAPPO seamlessly adapts existing $\mathrm{@}1$ methods to $\mathrm{@k}$ via prompt-adaptive regularization or reward transformation, without otherwise altering their training procedures. Experiments with several RL methods on mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that KAPPO provides direct control over sharpening. Crucially, we demonstrate that $\mathrm{@k}$ pressure can be fully realized with single completion training, matching the performance of multi-completion $\mathrm{@k}$ optimizers at a fraction of the cost.

translation.title: 控制LLM后训练中的锐化
translation.abstract: 通过强化学习进行的LLM后训练在提升准确率的同时会降低行为覆盖——这一现象被称为锐化，可能阻碍在困难任务上的进展。重复采样目标如$\mathrm{pass@k}$和$\mathrm{max@k}$已知可以缓解锐化，但其背后的机制仍知之甚少。此外，现有的$\mathrm{@k}$优化方法使用专用算法，尚无将既有策略优化方法从$\mathrm{@}1$适配到$\mathrm{@k}$的通用框架。我们以闭式形式推导了KL正则化的$\mathrm{pass@k}$和$\mathrm{max@k}$目标的最优策略。我们的显式解表明，$\mathrm{@k}$优化会根据提示难度自然地重新分配学习压力，将其导向更难的问题。关键的是，我们证明标准$\mathrm{@}1$目标可以通过提示自适应正则化或奖励变换实现完全相同的最优策略。最终，这为$\mathrm{@k}$目标为何减少简单任务上的锐化同时优先保证困难任务的成功提供了一个与优化器无关的解释。基于这些洞察，我们提出$\mathrm{@k}$ Adaptive Pressure for Policy Optimization（KAPPO）。经过一次性的参考校准后，KAPPO通过提示自适应正则化或奖励变换，将现有$\mathrm{@}1$方法无缝适配到$\mathrm{@k}$，而不改变其训练流程。在数学推理和代码生成上使用多种RL方法的实验表明，KAPPO提供了对锐化的直接控制。关键的是，我们证明$\mathrm{@k}$压力可以通过单次补全训练完全实现，以极小的成本匹配多次补全$\mathrm{@k}$优化器的性能。
translation.brief: 解决RL后训练中锐化现象及@k优化缺乏通用框架的问题，通过闭式推导KL正则化@k目标的最优策略，提出KAPPO方法，以提示自适应正则化或奖励变换将现有@1方法适配到@k。

papers.title: Toward Knowledge-Centric AI: Discovering, Internalizing, and Using Explicit Knowledge Across Agents and Generations
papers.abstract: Knowledge is how understanding accumulates across people and generations: durable records that outlive their producers and that others can check, combine, teach, and correct. AI agents are now built and run by many independent users and organizations, and each agent is upgraded, replaced, or retired within months. Yet what an agent learns stays trapped in model parameters, a transient context window, or a system-specific memory store that is appended to and retrieved from rather than processed. We argue that the next generation of AI should be knowledge-centric, built around an explicit, continuously evolving knowledge layer independent of any single agent. In this loop, agents discover knowledge from their environments and trajectories; the layer internalizes it by turning fragmented, heterogeneous records and experience into composable, revisable understanding; and agents across systems and generations use the result and return new outcomes for revision. While discovery and use have advanced rapidly with large language model agents, internalization remains the bottleneck. We argue that internalization should become a persistent object of training and maintenance-centered on condition-preserving conceptualization of events and deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning across noisy, heterogeneous representations (text, tables, graphs, rules, and programs). To power this layer, we call for knowledge foundation models that provide shared neural capacity for knowledge computation, and outline a research agenda showing how an explicit knowledge layer delivers reuse, cost efficiency, auditability, and continuity across agent generations.

papers.title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
papers.abstract: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback. Its three-layer architecture enables direct execution or delegation to Subagents, synchronously or asynchronously, under stable responsibilities. Through a shared application layer, humans and agents inspect and revise the same evolving documents, presentations, CAD models, and Blender scenes, so human-in-the-loop participation can enter both through conversation and through direct modification of the work itself. To sustain continuity across agents and sessions, CoworkOS further introduces hierarchical workspaces and persistent semantic memory, so working files, key decisions, and long-running Job logs remain shareable, reusable, and resumable after interruption. Across 12 benchmarks and 6 categories of real-world applications, CoworkOS proves highly competitive with frontier agent applications such as Codex and DeepSeek Harness. As a sustained-work case study, CoworkOS uses GLM-5.3 as its backbone to conduct RSI-driven automated post-training on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Over five rounds, the model's average score across eight benchmarks rose from 33.19 to 42.95 (+9.76). Looking ahead, we believe CoworkOS opens a meaningful path toward general cowork-agent intelligence.

papers.title: Auto-Research Agent on MSA Organization to Improve Protein-Protein Complex Structure Prediction
papers.abstract: Protein-complex structure prediction with AlphaFold 3 depends on MSA content, depth, and cross-chain pairing. Current pipelines apply uniform recipes, typically maximizing depth and pairing by species, yet even whether cross-chain pairing helps AF3 remains contested. We show that the value of both depth and pairing is strongly target-dependent, so no single recipe is optimal across interfaces. We introduce an autonomous agent that treats a frozen AF3 as a black-box experimental instrument. For each target, the agent formulates biological hypotheses, analyzes and reorganizes the MSA, and iteratively refines sequence selection and pairing using predictor label-free signals alone. On 1{,}015 protein--protein interfaces from three benchmarks released after AF3's training cutoff, the agent improves overall interface DockQ over AF3's default pipeline and fixed MSA recipes on every benchmark, while using on average 60\% fewer MSA sequences than the default. Gains are largest for inter-species heteromers, where species-based pairing is unreliable: mean DockQ increases from 0.465 to 0.612 on FoldBench and from 0.482 to 0.562 on HD439. The improvements arise from both sequence construction and pairing policy, including deliberate this http URL results recast MSA design as a target-specific problem and show that an autonomous agent can adapt it at test time through biological reasoning and self-directed, confidence-guided experimentation.

papers.title: ACTOR: Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents
papers.abstract: Large language agents for literary role-playing are typically modeled around dialogue generation, leaving characters' non-dialogue behaviors and their dynamic evolution over story time underrepresented. In this paper, we propose ACTOR (Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents), an automated framework for constructing such behavior trajectories from raw novel texts. ACTOR extracts dialogue and persona-relevant non-dialogue behaviors, represents each behavior using a Thought-Action-Observation structure, and organizes behavior trajectories according to the internal temporal order of the story. We build a behavior dataset from 143 diverse literary works. For each source behavior, we generate counterfactual behaviors that are contextually plausible yet inconsistent with the character's persona. We find that existing models struggle to reliably infer character-consistent actions from historical behaviors and evolving character states. Using these behavior pairs, we train models with Regularized Preference Optimization (RPO), which augments DPO with a negative log-likelihood loss on the source behavior to jointly optimize behavior preference and generation. We further design a four-way next-behavior selection task to evaluate the model's ability to faithfully mimic character actions. Across 17,560 evaluation instances, the model trained on ACTOR's preference pairs achieves substantially improved accuracy. This result demonstrates that structured, temporally organized supervision enables models to leverage character profiles and prior behaviors to infer subsequent actions, greatly advancing literary role-playing beyond mere dialogue imitation. Code and data are available at this https URL.

papers.title: Verification Allocation in Stylized LLM Agent Pipelines under Hidden Tool Degradation: A Discrete-Time Mean-Field Analysis
papers.abstract: We study a stylized verification-allocation model for role-structured pipelines with binary inherited corruption and hidden tool degradation. Standard contraction arguments give serial and multi-role fixed points and a finite-population deviation bound under independence. When verification actions affect neither future errors nor observations, the belief-state choice is myopic. We characterize a two-action threshold under an explicit monotonicity condition and a restricted four-action interval and tail policy when generation rates are equal and only one check degrades. Synthetic experiments check these model-specific results and find counterexamples outside the restriction. This is conditional model analysis, not a general mean-field-game result or empirical evidence about deployed LLM systems.

papers.title: Finding the Pivots to Repair Broken Source-Test Evolution Using LLMs
papers.abstract: Repairing obsolete tests in response to source code evolution is critical for test suite reliability and software quality assurance. While large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising tools for automating many software development tasks, the effective supply of context and the orchestration of repair pipelines in this source--test co-evolution scenario remain poorly understood. Moreover, although reasoning is found helpful for LLMs on some complex coding tasks, it remains unclear which reasoning steps actually contribute to effective test repairs and how the insights learned from LLMs' behaviors benefit coding agents. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical study of test repair for source-test co-evolution empowered by LLMs, investigating the effective setups and typical LLM behaviors. To support this study, we construct a new benchmark of 500 real-world source-test co-evolution cases from commits submitted between May 2024 and April 2026 across 15 highly-starred open-source Java projects. Our experimental results reveal several key insights for effective LLM-based test repair: the complementary benefits of combining test failure symptoms, source code changes, and supportive code context, as well as the effectiveness of self-repair rounds. We further derive a common reasoning action taxonomy from LLMs' reasoning traces, which proves instrumental in guiding LLMs to repair tests more effectively while at a lower financial cost. Applying our findings to the Codex agent further improves its repair success rate on challenging cases by 66.7%.

translation.title: 利用LLM寻找修复源码-测试演进断裂的关键要素
translation.abstract: 针对源码演进修复过时测试对测试套件可靠性和软件质量保障至关重要。尽管大语言模型（LLM）已成为自动化许多软件开发任务的有前景工具，但在源码-测试协同演进场景中，如何有效提供上下文以及编排修复流程仍知之甚少。此外，虽然推理已被发现有助于LLM完成某些复杂编码任务，但哪些推理步骤真正有助于有效修复测试，以及从LLM行为中获得的洞察如何惠及编码智能体，仍不清楚。本文对LLM赋能的源码-测试协同演进中的测试修复进行了系统性实证研究，考察有效配置和典型LLM行为。为支持该研究，我们构建了一个新基准，包含2024年5月至2026年4月间15个高星开源Java项目提交中的500个真实世界源码-测试协同演进案例。实验结果揭示了有效基于LLM测试修复的若干关键洞察：结合测试失败症状、源码变更和支持性代码上下文的互补收益，以及自修复轮次的有效性。我们进一步从LLM的推理轨迹中推导出通用的推理动作分类法，事实证明它有助于引导LLM更有效地修复测试，同时降低财务成本。将我们的发现应用于Codex智能体，使其在困难案例上的修复成功率提升了66.7%。
translation.brief: 研究LLM测试修复中哪些上下文与推理步骤有效，通过构建500个真实源码-测试协同演进案例的基准进行系统实证，并提炼推理动作分类法指导修复。

papers.title: Cold-Start Pricing of LLM Services under Two-Sided Learning
papers.abstract: Online large language model (LLM) services face a pricing cold start: providers initially lack the historical data and user information needed for precise pricing, while users' willingness to pay evolves with repeated use. We formulate this challenge as a \emph{two-sided learning} problem between a provider and a user. The user learns from private usage experience, whereas the provider incurs a serving cost and dynamically adapts prices using only purchase decisions to maximize cumulative profit. The provider's central challenge is to learn to price against an evolving willingness to pay without observing the private experiences driving that evolution. We establish matching upper and lower bounds on the minimax regret over horizon $T$, identifying two cost-dependent regimes. When serving costs are sufficiently low, our Calibration-and-Tracking (CAT) algorithm achieves the optimal rate $\Theta(T^{1/3})$. In the higher-cost regime, where the provider must learn whether continued service is profitable, Calibration-and-Tracking with Retirement (CAT-R) attains the optimal rate $\Theta(\sqrt{T})$. This phase transition shows that serving costs affect not only profit margins but also the fundamental difficulty of learning to price LLM services. Simulations support the predicted regret scaling and show that our algorithms outperform standard online learning baselines in the evaluated settings.

translation.title: 双边学习下LLM服务的冷启动定价
translation.abstract: 在线大语言模型（LLM）服务面临定价冷启动问题：提供商最初缺乏精确定价所需的历史数据和用户信息，而用户的支付意愿随重复使用而演变。我们将这一挑战形式化为提供商与用户之间的双边学习问题。用户从私有的使用经验中学习，而提供商承担服务成本，仅利用购买决策动态调整价格以最大化累计利润。提供商的核心挑战在于：在观察不到驱动支付意愿演变的私有经验的情况下，学会针对不断演变的支付意愿进行定价。我们建立了时间范围T上极小极大遗憾的匹配上下界，识别出两个依赖成本的机制。当服务成本足够低时，我们的Calibration-and-Tracking（CAT）算法达到最优速率Θ(T^{1/3})。在更高成本的机制下，提供商必须学习持续服务是否有利可图，带退休机制的Calibration-and-Tracking（CAT-R）达到最优速率Θ(√T)。这一相变表明服务成本不仅影响利润率，还影响学习LLM服务定价的根本难度。仿真结果支持预测的遗憾缩放，并表明我们的算法在评估设置中优于标准在线学习基线。
translation.brief: 研究LLM服务在缺乏用户数据时的冷启动定价问题，将其建模为提供商与用户的双边学习问题，并设计CAT/CAT-R算法达到最优遗憾界。

papers.title: CISA: Retrofitting Dense Attention Models with Chunk-Indexed Sparse Attention
papers.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is costly because attention repeatedly reads a growing key-value (KV) history. We introduce Chunk-Indexed Sparse Attention (CISA), which retrofits pretrained dense attention models without gradient updates. CISA selects fixed-size KV chunks using compact summaries of existing keys, avoiding token-level indexing and a separate full-length index cache. It uses one indexing query per KV group and shares selected chunks across queries in that group. During prefill, QShare reuses selections across adjacent queries to reduce indexing cost and improve KV reuse and GPU utilization. We evaluate CISA on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano and Ultra, and Inkling-Small. In one-layer BF16 benchmarks at batch size 32 using Ultra's per-device attention dimensions, core attention is 11.7x faster for prefill queries near the end of a 1M-token prompt and 13.0x faster during decode. Including chunk scoring, selection, and all other measured GPU work, speedups are 8.6x and 3.0x. On Ultra NVFP4 with a 4,096-chunk budget, aggregate scores stay within 1.5 percentage points of dense attention on MRCR, LongBench v2, and GraphWalks. RULER sweeps on Nano and Ultra BF16 up to one million tokens show scores within 2.05 percentage points of dense attention with 8-16x fewer KV reads. Serving million-token prompts with 32 concurrent requests and 4K output tokens per request, CISA achieves 2.29x the end-to-end throughput of dense attention using Nemotron 3 Ultra NVFP4 on four NVIDIA B300 GPUs. Selecting fewer chunks increases throughput to 2.61x; in separate GraphWalks evaluations, the smaller budget widens the aggregate score gap from 1.49 to 3.59 percentage points. These results expose a practical quality-speed tradeoff without sparse training.

translation.title: CISA：用分块索引稀疏注意力改造稠密注意力模型
translation.abstract: 长上下文LLM推理代价高昂，因为注意力反复读取不断增长的键值（KV）历史。我们提出分块索引稀疏注意力（CISA），无需梯度更新即可改造预训练的稠密注意力模型。CISA使用现有键的紧凑摘要选择固定大小的KV块，避免了token级索引和单独的全长索引缓存。它对每个KV组使用一个索引查询，并在该组内的查询间共享所选块。在prefill阶段，QShare在相邻查询间复用选择结果，以降低索引成本并提高KV复用和GPU利用率。我们在NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano和Ultra以及Inkling-Small上评估CISA。在使用Ultra的每设备注意力维度、批大小32的单层BF16基准中，对于接近100万token提示末尾的prefill查询，核心注意力快11.7倍，decode阶段快13.0倍。计入块评分、选择及所有其他测量的GPU工作，加速比分别为8.6倍和3.0倍。在采用4096块预算的Ultra NVFP4上，MRCR、LongBench v2和GraphWalks的聚合分数与稠密注意力差距保持在1.5个百分点以内。在Nano和Ultra BF16上直至一百万token的RULER扫描显示，分数与稠密注意力差距在2.05个百分点以内，同时KV读取减少8-16倍。在4块NVIDIA B300 GPU上使用Nemotron 3 Ultra NVFP4服务百万token提示（32个并发请求、每请求4K输出token），CISA实现稠密注意力2.29倍的端到端吞吐量。选择更少的块可将吞吐量提升至2.61倍；在单独的GraphWalks评估中，更小的预算使聚合分数差距从1.49扩大到3.59个百分点。这些结果展示了无需稀疏训练即可获得的实用质量-速度权衡。
translation.brief: 解决长上下文推理中KV缓存读取开销大的问题，提出无需训练的CISA方法，用紧凑摘要选择固定大小KV块并在查询间共享以加速注意力。

papers.title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
papers.abstract: Recently, harness self-evolution has emerged as an important paradigm for improving agent performance. Prior studies show that evolving the agent harness can effectively enhance agent capabilities without modifying the foundation model's parameters. We find that existing approaches largely study agent evolution on a single task. In practice, coding agents may need to handle multiple task types over time. Whether an agent harness can continuously evolve across multiple tasks without suffering from catastrophic forgetting remains an important open question. In this paper, we investigate this open question through a comprehensive empirical study of continual harness self-evolution. We organize three software engineering task datasets into six different evolution directions and apply two representative harness evolution methods to perform continual evolution along these directions. Our experimental results show that evolution on a subsequent dataset can substantially undermine the performance on previously seen datasets. For example, with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, Meta-Harness improves its performance on SWE-Bench to 94.0% after evolution. However, after further evolution on FeatureBench, its performance on SWE-Bench drops to 32.0% by the fifth round, corresponding to a 66% relative decrease. Finally, based on our experimental findings, we identify several insights, providing directions for the continual self-evolution of agent harnesses. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 编码智能体能否在持续演进中不遗忘？
translation.abstract: 近来，harness自进化已成为提升智能体性能的重要范式。先前研究表明，进化智能体harness可以在不修改基础模型参数的情况下有效增强智能体能力。我们发现现有方法大多在单一任务上研究智能体进化。实践中，编码智能体可能需要随时间处理多种任务类型。智能体harness能否跨多个任务持续进化而不遭受灾难性遗忘，仍是一个重要的开放问题。本文通过对持续harness自进化的全面实证研究来探究这一开放问题。我们将三个软件工程任务数据集组织成六个不同的进化方向，并应用两种代表性的harness进化方法沿这些方向进行持续进化。实验结果表明，在后续数据集上的进化会显著损害在先前数据集上的性能。例如，使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731，Meta-Harness进化后在SWE-Bench上的性能提升至94.0%；然而，在FeatureBench上进一步进化后，其SWE-Bench性能在第五轮降至32.0%，相对下降66%。最后，基于实验发现，我们总结出若干洞察，为智能体harness的持续自进化提供方向。代码可在https URL获取。
translation.brief: 研究编码智能体harness跨多任务持续自进化是否会发生灾难性遗忘，通过六个进化方向上的实证实验揭示性能退化现象。

papers.title: Do Agents Still Follow the Rules? Benchmarking Rule Compliance under Agent Context Compaction
papers.abstract: LLM agents compact long histories to fit their context windows, but the compacted context must still carry the operating rules that govern later actions. Prior work shows that violations rise after compaction, but measures compliance outside a complete agent harness and does not identify where each violation comes from. We introduce ARCBench(Agent Rule Compliance Benchmark), a configurable benchmark built on the open-source pi agent harness. Its tool-calling agent loop lets us measure rule compliance from actions taken during execution, bringing the evaluation closer to deployed agent workflows. Using ARCBench, we examine where violations after compaction come from, and how different compaction configurations and adversarial settings change their sources. We find that compaction rarely deletes the rule: most violations after compaction occur while the rule is still in the compacted history, with the agent treating a later request as permission, ignoring the rule, and proceeding anyway. Where violations come from depends on the configuration: how the rule is delivered decides whether the agent would break it even without compaction, while the compaction strategy and budget decide whether the rule survives. The strongest compactor-targeted attack more than doubles violations by corrupting the rule in the summary and changing how the agents behave, whereas the strongest defense restores the rule in most summary but still violates. Finally, retaining a rule does not guarantee compliance: compacted runs that retain the rule violate more than twice as often as runs with the full history.

translation.title: 智能体还会遵守规则吗？智能体上下文压缩下的规则遵从基准测试
translation.abstract: LLM智能体会压缩长历史以适应其上下文窗口，但压缩后的上下文仍须承载约束后续行为的操作规则。先前工作表明压缩后违规增多，但其合规度量是在不完整的智能体harness之外进行的，且未识别每次违规的来源。我们提出ARCBench（Agent Rule Compliance Benchmark），一个基于开源pi智能体harness构建的可配置基准。其工具调用智能体循环使我们能够从执行期间采取的动作来度量规则遵从，使评估更贴近部署的智能体工作流。利用ARCBench，我们考察压缩后违规的来源，以及不同的压缩配置和对抗设置如何改变其来源。我们发现压缩很少删除规则本身：压缩后的大多数违规发生在规则仍存在于压缩历史中的情况下，智能体将后续请求视为许可、无视规则并继续执行。违规来源取决于配置：规则的交付方式决定智能体即使没有压缩是否也会违反规则，而压缩策略和预算决定规则能否存留。最强的针对压缩器的攻击通过在摘要中破坏规则并改变智能体行为，使违规增加一倍以上；而最强的防御在大多数摘要中恢复了规则，但仍然违规。最后，保留规则并不保证遵从：保留规则的压缩运行比拥有完整历史的运行违规频率高出一倍以上。
translation.brief: 研究上下文压缩后LLM智能体规则违规的来源问题，构建基于pi harness的ARCBench基准，从执行动作中度量合规并分析压缩配置与攻击的影响。

papers.title: What Structurally Breaks an Agent? Auditing Difficulty in Stateful Tool-Use Workflows
papers.abstract: An aggregate task score does not distinguish failures of scheduling, state retention, and candidate selection. We develop a small executable instrument that varies dependency depth, candidate count, active state width, and access to current-state snapshots while holding the number of required operations fixed. Two dependency-graph families show that increasing depth at fixed work changes both scheduling freedom and the number of reachable completion states, so these controls are coupled, and we quantify the coupling. The primary study contains 49,152 generated tasks and 393,216 reference-controller rollouts. A separately frozen follow-on design adds 295,936 rollouts covering retention strategy, snapshot cadence, hidden state resampling, recovery, query locality, candidate indexing, and relabeling. Residue caches and precomputed plans solve tasks that defeat limited raw-value caches, and indexed selection removes the serial-scan branching deficit. Hidden resampling imposes an exact success ceiling that additional state tracking cannot overcome. The contribution is an executable diagnostic instrument, analytic calibration, and an audit of its assumptions. A small local CPU study with a 0.5B model completed no workflows, and a 16-episode Copilot-routed fractional factorial is descriptive only. Neither supports general capability claims.

papers.title: Specification-Driven Governance for Fairness-by-Design in Agentic Software Engineering: How Far Can We Go?
papers.abstract: Agentic AI is shifting developers' responsibilities from software implementation to software governance. While this paradigm improves productivity, it also raises challenges in ensuring that autonomous coding agents preserve developers' intentions. Among these, operationalizing fairness-by-design is largely unexplored, as existing approaches provide limited support for representing and propagating fairness requirements throughout agentic development workflows. In this paper, we investigate whether specification-driven development can operationalize fairness-by-design in the agentic development of machine learning systems. We study three coding agents on four machine learning applications, using four prompts that progressively operationalize fairness through nine Fairness Specification Elements, and analyze the traceability of fairness requirements across the generated artifacts, the fairness-accuracy trade-off of the resulting models, and the agents' design decisions and rationales. The results show that when fairness is operationalized, agents capture almost all fairness requirements in the specification (97.22%) and preserve most of them in the code (82.41%). However, the resulting models are not significantly fairer, as agents implement fairness as a post-hoc audit that neither shapes training nor prevents model delivery. Specifications thus make fairness traceable, but not enforceable, calling for fairness specifications that state what agents should do when requirements are not met, and for workflows that make the fairness decisions agents delegate to developers explicit.

papers.title: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
papers.abstract: We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe. Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning, without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD). The first SFT stage develops strong self-contained reasoning through model-aware data construction, where we synthesize challenging problems and adversarially strengthen them based on the base model's own successful solution strategies. The second stage extends these capabilities to tool-dependent reasoning through a scalable pipeline for constructing diverse and automatically verifiable tasks grounded in real-world data sources and deterministic computation. Finally, reinforcement learning further strengthens long-horizon reasoning and interaction with external tools and environments. Despite this compact training recipe, Axion 1.0 achieves strong performance across a broad suite of agentic benchmarks and is competitive with leading commercial models on several of them. Equally importantly, Axion 1.0 is open beyond model weights: we release the complete recipe, including data construction, generation, filtering, verification, prompts, and training code, enabling the entire development process to be reproduced and extended. Axion 1.0 demonstrates that strong agent foundation models can be both open and simple, offering a practical and reproducible path toward advancing open agentic intelligence.

papers.title: ScienceCUA: Resource-to-Skill Construction and Execution-Guided Skill Evolution for Scientific Computer Use Agents
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents for scientific software require application-specific expertise. Much of this expertise is documented in human-authored software manuals and web pages. However, turning these resources into executable, reusable skills remains challenging due to mismatches between documented and deployed software versions and differences in scope between documentation coverage and task requirements. We introduce ScienceCUA, a two-stage framework combining resource-to-skill construction with execution-guided skill evolution. First, ScienceCUA identifies tasks supported by the software from its documentation, infers operational trajectories, and generalizes them into reusable Skills. Command catalogs, syntax constraints, and shortcuts are organized separately as References for on-demand lookup. Then, ScienceCUA uses execution feedback to drive skill self-evolution by contrasting successful and failed trajectories for the same task, identifying deficiencies, revising existing skills or adding new ones, and updating the skill library only after repeated validation in real environments. To enable reliable evaluation without benchmark noise or task leakage, we introduce two improved benchmarks. ScienceBoard-Verified provides an audited and corrected basis for measuring task performance, while ScienceBoard-VE separates skill evolution from final testing through disjoint evolution and test tasks and further supports native-agent evaluation. Experiments show that the initial Skills and References improve average task success rate by up to 7.23 percentage points over the base model, while skill self-evolution increases the total gain over the baseline to as much as 17.12 percentage points. ScienceCUA turns software documentation into an evolving set of executable skills and queryable references, offering a practical way for general-purpose agents to use scientific software reliably and at scale.

papers.title: Susceptibility optimization for wisdom of crowds: A social power reformulation and realization framework
papers.abstract: Whether social influence makes a crowd wiser or more biased hinges on who yields to others and who holds firm. Such heterogeneous susceptibilities to social influence, together with the influence network, determine the weight each agent's initial estimate carries in the collective estimate, known as social power. This paper studies susceptibility optimization for maximizing the wisdom of crowds under the Friedkin-Johnsen model. Minimizing the squared collective bias over susceptibilities leads to a nonconvex problem. To overcome this nonconvexity, we develop a social power reformulation and realization framework, which decomposes the problem into two stages: first characterizing the social power that minimizes the collective bias, then determining the susceptibilities that induce such social power. Social power reformulation yields a quadratic program over the probability simplex. Under uniform-sign biases, the optimal social power concentrates on the least biased agents and immediately determines the optimal susceptibilities; under mixed-sign biases, its geometry enables a linear-time construction algorithm. For social power realization, we introduce the notions of susceptibility realizability and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for them, under which we derive all optimal susceptibilities in closed form using the Laplacian pseudoinverse and eigenvector centrality. These results yield a unified algorithm that solves the original problem globally, with worst-case complexity cubic in the number of agents when realizability holds. Finally, we develop a fully distributed implementation with linear communication complexity, illustrating how collective intelligence can emerge from local interactions.

papers.title: R$^2$-Omni: Reducing Structural and Precision Redundancy in Omni-LLMs for Long-Form Generation
papers.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) typically process large numbers of multimodal tokens from audio-visual inputs, incurring substantial computational costs and a large memory footprint for the key-value (KV) cache. Aggressive token pruning can alleviate this problem while maintaining competitive performance on multiple-choice tasks, which require only a single option as output. However, we observe substantial quality degradation when generating long-form, open-ended responses. We attribute this gap to query-guided selection, which can retain sufficient evidence for answer selection while discarding details needed for comprehensive generation. This motivates reducing overlapping information across tokens, termed structural redundancy, while preserving diverse content. However, the retained representations may still contain precision redundancy due to unnecessarily high numerical precision in their cached values. To address these two levels of redundancy in token representations, we introduce a training-free framework named R$^2$-Omni. First, Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC) consolidates redundant representations using spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio. Then, Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA) allocates value precision to the retained representations according to the estimated reduction in attention-output error under quantized keys, with query attention and audio-visual alignment providing a semantic prior. Extensive experiments on long-form generation benchmarks demonstrate an average 5.0$\times$ reduction in the memory footprint while preserving 97.98% of baseline generation quality and achieving a 1.48$\times$ end-to-end speedup, highlighting the benefits of jointly reducing structural and precision redundancy.

papers.title: The Cost of Mismatch: Noise Amplification in Zeroth-Order Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a promising approach for memory-efficient large language model (LLM) post-training, yet its reliable application to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) remains largely unexplored. Motivated by the distinct data regimes of on-policy RL and fixed-data optimization, we develop a generic variance-theoretic framework to investigate what limits the reliability of ZO gradient estimation. Our analysis reveals that estimation reliability is structurally determined by whether the two finite-difference evaluations are performed on matched data. On-policy reinforcement learning (RL) under the mismatched-data regime produces a $1/\mu^2$ oracle-noise amplification that sets an irreducible noise floor as the perturbation scale $\mu$ decreases, whereas Boltzmann Targeted SFT (BOLT) under the matched-data regime eliminates this amplification via noise cancellation. We further derive convergence guarantees with explicit constants that cleanly separate the two regimes. These results naturally lead to ZO-BOLT, which applies ZO optimization to BOLT's RLVR-aligned weighted-SFT objective. Controlled perturbation-scale sweeps and matched-versus-mismatched end-to-end comparisons validate the predicted effect of data matching. Experiments across three model variants and two mathematical reasoning benchmarks further show that ZO-BOLT consistently improves over the pretrained baseline while retaining a near-inference memory footprint. The code is publicly available at this https URL.

papers.title: Specificity Bias and the Wikipedia Paradox: An xAI Analysis of AI Text Detectors under Domain Shift
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) demands reliable detection of human-authored versus synthetic text. However, current Transformer-based detectors often experience severe performance degradation during domain shifts and operate as opaque classifiers. This paper investigates the robustness and interpretability of fine-tuned Transformer models (DistilBERT, RoBERTa) by evaluating them against a custom out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset of hyper-local news synthesized via open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma). To analyze model decision boundaries, we apply a tripartite Explainable AI (xAI) framework using SHAP. Our analysis reveals three key phenomena: First, detectors often rely on a "Call-to-Action" syndrome inherent to instruction-tuned LLMs rather than generic machine text. Second, we observe a "Specificity Bias," where LLMs successfully bypass detection by hallucinating specific named entities and mimicking conversational imperfection. Finally, we illustrate the "Wikipedia Paradox," wherein formal, objective human writing is frequently misclassified as AI due to its low statistical burstiness. These findings demonstrate that purely statistical detection paradigms face systematic limitations in highly structured human domains, emphasizing the critical need for semantically-aware, interpretable detection architectures.

papers.title: Top-$k$ Retrieval Leaves Memory Value Undetermined
papers.abstract: A memory-augmented agent must decide which memories to keep, merge and retrieve, and its only evidence of their value is its retrieval log: the memories it retrieved in each episode and whether it succeeded. Existing methods assign every memory a value from this log, even when the log cannot separate one memory's contribution from another's. We treat the log as an experiment that nobody designed and ask which memory values it determines. Two counts answer this before any outcome is observed: how often each memory was retrieved, and how often each pair was retrieved together. From these counts, we prove that top-$k$ retrieval leaves every memory value undetermined, however many episodes are logged, and that a question with its own memories, asked once, determines at most one of their values. On fourteen standard memory benchmarks, no memory value is determined in any of 55 configurations. Both causes are choices about retrieval. We introduce LEDGER, which estimates each determined Shapley value in closed form with a confidence interval and reports every other value as undetermined. It merges memories with identical histories without losing a determined value, and it retrieves so that the next log determines more. On pooled HotpotQA, LEDGER raises the fraction of memories determined from 0.001 to 0.797, at a cost of 2.6 accuracy points on HotpotQA and with a gain of 2.7 on LoCoMo.

papers.title: ENGINE: Endogenous Variational MultiScale Optimization for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient large language model (LLM) fine-tuning, and recent methods incorporate curvature-aware strategies. However, in the high-dimensional parameter space of LLMs, these methods inherently suffer from exploding gradient variance and prohibitive costs. Conversely, confining updates to a low-dimensional subspace reduces variance but discards critical high-dimensional information, degrading performance. This creates a fundamental dilemma: full-space optimization is informative but has high variance, while subspace optimization has low variance but loses information. To break this trade-off, we propose ENGINE (Endogenous Variational MultiScale). Inspired by computational mechanics, we adapt static Variational MultiScale (VMS) theory to dynamic optimization, treating low- and high-dimensional spaces as resolved coarse and unresolved fine scales. Through a multigrid-style V-cycle, ENGINE alternates between spaces, dynamically probing fine-grained information in the high-dimensional space and injecting it to correct the efficient low-dimensional sampling process. Under appropriate assumptions, statistical analysis characterizes variance reduction and correction of curvature-induced bias, and convergence analysis establishes a stationarity bound for the corrected coarse updates. Evaluations on standard LLM benchmarks show that ENGINE achieves higher accuracy and faster convergence than existing ZO methods, achieving up to a $2.61\times$ speed-up in forward passes with zero additional peak memory overhead. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: SQLoom: Set-Contrastive Learning of Syntactic, Semantic, and Logical Dependencies for Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL translates natural language questions into SQL queries, enabling database access without writing SQL. Fine-tuning open-weight large language models (LLMs) is cost-effective, but existing methods treat SQL as ordinary text and optimize token-level likelihood without explicitly modeling its syntactic, semantic, and logical requirements. Thus, a single incorrect alias or comparison operator can invalidate a query while contributing little to training loss. We propose SQLoom, a constraint-aware fine-tuning framework with supervision at three levels: syntactic validity under SQL grammar and database schema, semantic alignment between query decisions and the question, and logical consistency across dependent clause decisions. SQLoom extends supervised fine-tuning with a unified set-contrastive objective favoring sets of correct outputs over minimally different incorrect ones at each level. LLM agents propose this supervision, which a SQL parser and execution on counterexample databases verify. We also release Spider-Refined, a training dataset correcting 378 flawed Spider annotations and enriching database schemas. Experiments on Spider, BIRD, and three perturbed Spider variants show that SQLoom improves execution accuracy for Qwen3-1.7B from 62.9% zero-shot to 88.7% on Spider development, reaching 89.2% on Spider test and 73.4% on BIRD development. It outperforms fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and agent-based baselines with up to 70 billion parameters. On question perturbations, SQLoom loses at most 0.6 accuracy points versus up to 12.1 for agent-based methods. It generates SQL in a single pass at 0.42s per query, 23$\times$ faster than a GPT-4-based agent method. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of set-contrastive supervision over token-level training.

papers.title: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents are controllable, are central to real-world domains such as smart grids, yet lack a principled foundation for reinforcement learning algorithm design. We study this setting through n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), a recent framework for learning in open multi-agent environments. We propose an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity), treating them as structural constraints rather than heuristic design choices. This formulation builds on a novel NAHT decomposition, which characterises the fundamental difference between open and fully controllable multi-agent systems, and establishes a cooperative game-theoretic foundation for learning. We further show that enforcing these axioms on learning individual value functions recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs, providing a principled bridge between reinforcement learning and classical cooperative game theory. Building on this framework, we introduce Shapley Machines and Banzhaf Machines, two generic algorithmic templates that can be instantiated with standard reinforcement learning methods. When applied to strong base algorithms such as IPPO and POAM, our methods consistently improve learning efficiency and generalisation to unseen agent types and conventions across NAHT benchmark tasks. The code of experiments is published on this https URL.

papers.title: LLMs Depend on Specialist Tools for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in MS/MS Structural Elucidation
papers.abstract: A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte's textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM's access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo models both in and out of distribution. These results suggest that LLMs are not effective at de novo MS/MS structural elucidation on their own, and that further gains depend on the specialist tools available to the agent rather than on the LLM itself.
authors: Devesh Shah Antonio H. de O. Fonseca
